prs.title: feat(web-shell): implement the local-daemon workspace artifact library page
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements the accepted workspace artifact library page (#18036) for Web Shell's local daemon mode, reusing the existing persisted artifact-library backend unchanged:

- Wraps the workspace artifact-library reads in the TypeScript SDK and the Web Shell workspace actions layer, including a named-event SSE parser so `event:`-discriminated frames (`start`, `session`, `session_error`, `complete`, `error`) stream progressively with a JSON fallback and a same-generation JSON fallback on pre-stream `503 sse_connection_limit_exceeded`.
- Adds a progressive scan hook governed by a client-only generation-ownership contract (`{ workspaceKey, generation }`): every event and terminal commit is ownership-checked so overlapping same-workspace refreshes and A→B→A workspace round-trips never let a settled-but-superseded scan establish rows, progress, or terminal state; the newest-first list is recomputed in batches, zero-artifact sessions count toward progress, terminal progress reconciles with `complete`'s counters, and any stream ending without `complete` is marked partial with retry.
- Adds a capability-gated `'artifacts'` primary navigation entry and full-page library view with client-side text filtering, bounded row rendering (`Show more`), source-session labels with `Active`/`Archived` badges, terminal wording distinguishing "Enumeration finished" from "Scan finished with per-session failures", and dedicated `409` persistence-unavailable and `503` runtime-unavailable states.
- Reuses session-panel preview paths on the same predicates: workspace-file artifacts preview without loading a session; metadata-only managed artifacts render directly from the envelope descriptor without loading a session or hitting the content route; saved web-preview snapshots (`metadata.artifactType === 'web_preview_snapshot'`) use the content route when the session is live (`workspace-session-live-state`), jump to the session when cold or archived, fall back to the jump on a click-time `404 session_not_found` race, surface `404 artifact_snapshot_unavailable` as a missing-file error without jumping, and hold the post-jump open as a session-keyed pending request until the target session's right-panel restore settles (canceling on mid-load session switch).
- Registers the page's four-locale copy module in the transcript stubs so interaction-only copy adds zero bytes to the exported transcript bundle, and marks the bilingual design documents as implemented.

## Why it's needed

Until now, Web Shell's local daemon mode only surfaced artifacts inside a loaded session (per-turn chips, the right-panel artifacts tab behind the chat header entry, and session-list counts). Finding a deliverable produced in an earlier conversation required opening sessions one by one, and artifacts of archived sessions were unreachable until an explicit unarchive and load. Managed mode already shipped a workspace-wide artifact library (#17728), and the local daemon already had the persisted library routes and progressive SSE stream; this change connects that backend to Web Shell so both modes offer a consistent workspace-level artifact library without allocating agents or mutating session state merely to browse outputs.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Connect Web Shell to a local daemon that advertises `workspace_artifact_library` (and `workspace_artifact_library_stream`) in a workspace containing active, cold, and archived sessions with artifacts.
2. Click the **Artifacts** item in the primary navigation rail/sidebar and verify that the workspace artifact library page opens and progressively lists artifacts newest-first across active, cold, and archived sessions without loading or unarchiving those sessions, showing the source-session label and `Active`/`Archived` badge on each row and any per-session scan failures (such as `413 transcript_too_large`).
3. Click a workspace-file artifact or a metadata-only managed artifact from a cold/archived session and verify that it previews in the right detail pane without loading the session; click a cold or archived web-preview snapshot (or a source-session chip) and verify that Web Shell unarchives/opens the target session and opens the artifact tab after the right-panel restore settles; verify that when `workspace_artifact_library` is absent from `/capabilities`, the primary nav entry is hidden with no live-only fallback.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real Chromium screenshots of the built Web Shell bundle (`packages/web-shell/dist`) rendering the workspace artifact library page with active and archived session artifacts, workspace-file markdown preview, and a per-session `413 transcript_too_large` scan failure (dark and light themes, focus blurred before capture for state consistency):

![Workspace artifact library page in dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-artifact-library/workspace-artifact-library-dark.png)

![Workspace artifact library page in light theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-artifact-library/workspace-artifact-library-light.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: full workspace build (`sdk-typescript`, `web-shell`, `web-templates`, `cli`), typecheck, ESLint, Prettier, focused unit suites (`58/58` in `sdk-typescript`, `208/208` in `web-shell` including `build-artifact.test.ts` and `i18n.test.ts`), real-daemon SDK stream/JSON verification against local daemon `:4170`, and headless Chromium DOM assertions + dark/light screenshots all passed. macOS and Windows were not tested locally; the change is browser/TypeScript code covered by cross-platform CI lanes.

### Environment (optional)

Linux x64, Node.js v26.12.1 (with `--no-experimental-webstorage` for local jsdom vitest runs), Chromium Headless Shell 1228.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: full workspace scans are O(sessions) with cold transcript replay on uncached sessions; progressive SSE, batched newest-first projection, and bounded row rendering (`Show more`) keep the UI responsive, and the `ScanOwner` generation guard prevents superseded scans from overwriting newer results.
- Not validated / out of scope: batch deletion UI, pinning/view preferences, cursor pagination, live subscriptions, and cross-workspace aggregation remain out of scope per the accepted design (#18036). Local WebKit Playwright was not run (host lacks WebKit system libraries).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; daemons without `workspace_artifact_library` hide the navigation entry and keep existing session-scoped artifact surfaces unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Implements the accepted design from #18036.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

按已采纳的设计（#18036）为 Web Shell 本地 daemon 模式实现工作区级产物库页面，原样复用既有持久化产物库后端：

- 在 TypeScript SDK 与 Web Shell 工作区 actions 层封装工作区产物库读取，新增支持 `event:` 行判别的 `parseNamedSseStream` 以渐进消费 `start` / `session` / `session_error` / `complete` / `error` 事件，支持 JSON 回退以及在流创建前收到 `503 sse_connection_limit_exceeded` 时同 generation 内自动回退 JSON。
- 新增受纯客户端 generation 所有权契约（`{ workspaceKey, generation }`）保护的渐进扫描 hook：每个事件与终态提交都做所有权校验，使同工作区重叠刷新与 A→B→A 工作区往返永远不会让已结算但被取代的旧扫描确立行、进度或终态；按批重算最新优先列表，零产物会话计入进度，终态进度与 `complete` 计数对账，流未收到 `complete` 即结束时标记为部分结果并提供重试。

- 四语种文案模块注册进 transcript stub，使仅交互态文案对导出转录 bundle 增量为零，并将双语设计文档状态更新为已实现。

## 为什么需要

此前 Web Shell 本地 daemon 模式只在已加载会话内展示产物（按轮芯片、聊天头部入口打开的右栏产物列表 tab、会话列表数量）。想找更早会话产出的交付物必须逐条打开会话，归档会话的产物在显式解归档并加载前不可达。Managed 模式已上线工作区产物库（#17728），本地 daemon 也早已具备持久化产物库路由与渐进 SSE 流；本改动将该后端接入 Web Shell，使两种模式呈现一致的工作区级产物库体验，且不为浏览输出而额外创建 agent 或改变会话运行状态。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 将 Web Shell 连接到声明了 `workspace_artifact_library`（及 `workspace_artifact_library_stream`）的本地 daemon，且工作区包含带产物的活跃、冷、归档会话。
2. 点击主导航栏中的 **产物（Artifacts）** 入口，确认工作区产物库页面打开，在不加载或解归档会话的前提下按最新优先渐进列出活跃、冷、归档会话的产物，每行展示来源会话标签与 `活跃`/`已归档` 徽标，并展示逐会话扫描失败（如 `413 transcript_too_large`）。
3. 点击冷/归档会话的 workspace 文件产物或纯元数据 managed 产物，确认无需加载会话即可在右侧详情区预览；点击冷/归档网页预览快照（或来源会话标签），确认 Web Shell 解归档/打开目标会话并在右栏恢复收口后打开产物 tab；确认当 `/capabilities` 不含 `workspace_artifact_library` 时主导航项隐藏，无静默 live-only 回退。

### 证据（前后对照）

使用真实 Chromium 渲染构建后的 Web Shell 生产包（`packages/web-shell/dist`）截出的工作区产物库页面暗/亮双主题截图（含活跃与已归档会话产物、workspace 文件 Markdown 预览、以及逐会话 `413 transcript_too_large` 扫描失败；截图前统一 blur 以保持焦点状态一致）：

![暗色主题下的工作区产物库页面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-artifact-library/workspace-artifact-library-dark.png)

![亮色主题下的工作区产物库页面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-artifact-library/workspace-artifact-library-light.png)

| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |

Linux x64，Node.js v26.12.1（本地 jsdom vitest 使用 `--no-experimental-webstorage`），Chromium Headless Shell 1228。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：全工作区扫描是 O(会话数) 且未缓存冷会话需重放转录；渐进 SSE、按批最新优先投影与有界行渲染（`显示更多`）保持界面响应，`ScanOwner` generation 守卫防止被取代的旧扫描覆盖新结果。
- 未验证/范围外：批量删除 UI、置顶/视图偏好、游标分页、实时订阅、跨工作区聚合按已采纳设计（#18036）不在范围内。本地未跑 WebKit Playwright（宿主机缺 WebKit 系统库）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；未声明 `workspace_artifact_library` 的 daemon 隐藏导航入口，既有会话级产物界面保持不变。

prs.title: test(integration): deflake the SIGKILL restart-recovery case (#18055)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stabilizes the SIGKILL case of the daemon restart-recovery end-to-end test so it waits for the conditions it actually asserts about, instead of proceeding on proxies that do not guarantee them. Before killing the daemon it now waits until the prompt it sent is durably present in the session transcript, and after the restart it waits until the recovery scan lists that specific session rather than accepting any well-formed scan response. The assertions, inputs, and timeout ceilings are untouched, and the graceful-shutdown case is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The test was flagged as flaky after failing and then passing on a rerun of the same commit. Investigation showed the reported signature ("recovery scan lacked the SIGKILLed session") has a deeper cause than a short polling race. The chat recorder creates the transcript synchronously as an empty file and appends records asynchronously on a serialized queue, while the prompt ledger is appended synchronously at admission. Recovery enumeration is transcript-gated by design and fails closed when there is no readable transcript record. The test killed the daemon as soon as the fake model server saw a request, which does not imply the queued transcript write had landed — so when the kill landed in that window the transcript stayed empty forever and the session was permanently unrecoverable. Diagnostics from two failing runs captured exactly that state: a 0-byte transcript next to a durable ledger holding the `in_flight` record, with the scan returning an empty item list for the full 60-second budget. A secondary race compounded it: the scan wait returned on any array-shaped item list, including an empty one, so the assertion ran against whatever the first scan happened to contain.

This is test nondeterminism, not a product defect: a session with no persisted transcript record is intentionally not recoverable, and the test was asserting recoverability without establishing that precondition. The graceful-shutdown sibling never flaked because a graceful close drains the write queue before exit, which is why only the SIGKILL case needed the change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the restart-recovery integration file repeatedly with retries disabled so a flake cannot hide, on a loaded machine rather than an idle one: `QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests --retry=0 cli/qwen-serve-restart-recovery.test.ts`. Expect all three tests to pass on every run. To confirm the fix is load-bearing rather than cosmetic, temporarily remove the new pre-kill wait and rerun under load: the SIGKILL case should intermittently fail again, either with `expected undefined to match object { interruption: "in_flight" }`, or `timed out waiting for recovery scan`, or a continuation result that is not `accepted`. Inspecting the session directory at that moment shows a 0-byte transcript beside a populated ledger, which is the state the new wait excludes. Reviewers should also confirm that the test still verifies the same thing: the prompt is genuinely in flight at kill time (the fake model response is still held), the interruption is still asserted to be `in_flight`, and the continuation is still asserted to be accepted and to produce a new turn in the transcript.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change; the evidence is test behavior. Before: 4 failures in 20 runs of the file (3 recovery-scan failures, 1 continuation failure), with the failing runs showing `<sessionId>.jsonl bytes=0` alongside `<sessionId>.ledger.jsonl bytes=97` containing the `in_flight` record. After: 16 consecutive runs, 16 passed and 0 failed, at a host load average of about 18. A targeted probe that forced the first post-restart scan to return an empty item list failed before the change and passed after it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Real bundled CLI (`npm run build && npm run bundle`) driven by the integration harness against a fake OpenAI server, no sandbox (`QWEN_SANDBOX=false`), Node v22.23.2. The suite spawns and SIGKILLs real daemon processes.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the test now waits for transcript durability before crashing, so it no longer exercises the narrow window where a crash precedes any persisted transcript record. That window is intentionally unrecoverable per the recovery design, so covering it was never this test's purpose; asserting it made the test nondeterministic. The new wait adds a bounded 30-second budget that is normally satisfied immediately.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows were not run locally (the suite skips on Windows). No product code changed, so the durability window itself is untouched and unexamined here beyond confirming it is documented fail-closed behavior. The graceful-shutdown case shares the older scan-wait shape but does not exhibit the failure, because graceful close flushes the recorder; it was deliberately left alone to keep this diff scoped to the reported test.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Test-only change; no product behavior, configuration, public API, or CI machinery is affected.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18055

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

稳定 daemon 重启恢复端到端测试中的 SIGKILL 用例，让它等待自己真正断言的条件，而不是依赖无法保证这些条件的代理信号。在杀掉 daemon 之前，现在会等待它发送的 prompt 确实持久化到会话 transcript 中；重启之后，会等待恢复扫描列出该特定会话，而不是接受任何格式正确的扫描响应。断言、输入和超时上限均未改动，优雅退出用例保持不变。

## 为什么需要

该测试在同一 commit 上先失败后重跑通过，因此被判定为 flaky。排查表明，报告的签名（"恢复扫描中没有被 SIGKILL 的会话"）背后的原因比短暂的轮询竞争更深。chat recorder 会同步创建一个空的 transcript 文件，并在串行队列上异步追加记录，而 prompt ledger 在准入时同步追加。恢复枚举按设计以 transcript 为前提，在没有可读 transcript 记录时按 fail closed 处理。测试在 fake model server 一看到请求时就杀掉 daemon，这并不意味着队列中的 transcript 写入已经落盘 —— 因此当 kill 落在该窗口内时，transcript 永远保持为空，会话也就永久不可恢复。两次失败运行的诊断恰好捕获到该状态：0 字节的 transcript 旁边是持有 `in_flight` 记录的持久化 ledger，而扫描在整个 60 秒预算内都返回空的条目列表。还有一个次要竞争加剧了问题：扫描等待只要遇到数组形状的条目列表就返回，包括空列表，于是断言针对第一次扫描恰好返回的内容执行。

这是测试的非确定性，而不是产品缺陷：没有持久化 transcript 记录的会话是有意不可恢复的，而测试在没有确立该前提的情况下就断言了可恢复性。优雅退出的姊妹用例从未 flaky，因为优雅关闭会在退出前排空写队列，这也正是只有 SIGKILL 用例需要改动的原因。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在负载较高而非空闲的机器上，关闭重试并反复运行重启恢复集成文件，使 flaky 无法隐藏：`QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests --retry=0 cli/qwen-serve-restart-recovery.test.ts`。预期每次运行三个测试全部通过。若要确认该修复是关键逻辑而非表面装饰，可临时移除新增的杀进程前等待并在负载下重跑：SIGKILL 用例应会间歇性再次失败，表现为 `expected undefined to match object { interruption: "in_flight" }`、`timed out waiting for recovery scan`，或续跑结果不为 `accepted`。此时检查会话目录会看到 0 字节的 transcript 与已写入的 ledger 并存，而这正是新增等待所排除的状态。评审者还应确认测试验证的内容没有变化：kill 时 prompt 确实仍在进行中（fake model 响应仍被挂起）、仍断言 interruption 为 `in_flight`、仍断言续跑被接受并在 transcript 中产生新一轮次。

### 证据（修复前与修复后）

非 UI 变更，证据为测试行为。修复前：该文件 20 次运行中 4 次失败（3 次恢复扫描失败，1 次续跑失败），失败运行显示 `<sessionId>.jsonl bytes=0`，旁边 `<sessionId>.ledger.jsonl bytes=97` 且包含 `in_flight` 记录。修复后：连续 16 次运行，16 次通过、0 次失败，主机 load average 约为 18。一个强制重启后首次扫描返回空条目列表的定向探针，在改动前失败、改动后通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

真实打包 CLI（`npm run build && npm run bundle`），由集成测试框架驱动并对接 fake OpenAI server，不使用沙箱（`QWEN_SANDBOX=false`），Node v22.23.2。该套件会启动并 SIGKILL 真实的 daemon 进程。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：测试现在会在崩溃前等待 transcript 持久化，因此不再覆盖"崩溃早于任何 transcript 记录落盘"的狭窄窗口。按恢复设计该窗口是有意不可恢复的，覆盖它从来不是本测试的目的；断言它反而让测试变得不确定。新增等待带有 30 秒的有界预算，正常情况下会立即满足。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：未在本地运行 macOS 与 Windows（该套件在 Windows 上跳过）。未改动任何产品代码，因此持久化窗口本身未被触碰，此处除确认其为文档化的 fail-closed 行为外未做深入考察。优雅退出用例沿用较早的扫描等待写法，但不会呈现该失败，因为优雅关闭会 flush recorder；为把 diff 限定在被报告的测试上，特意保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。仅测试变更；不影响任何产品行为、配置、公共 API 或 CI 机制。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #18055

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): runtime-owned background observation with suspend-safe staging and drain (Phase 3b)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR implements Phase 3b, "Managed Runtime-owned background observation", whose design landed in #17912, end to end: the worker-owned capture, the Broker staging ledger, suspend-safe background suspension, and the drain-only settlement wake, together with the real-process and MySQL acceptance matrix and the §7 measurement that settles the tuning constants. Today a background Shell or Monitor watch keeps its running output digest inside the Harness process, so a Harness restart loses the capture and reports `producer_lost`, and a Session with live background work cannot suspend. This change moves the background capture into the worker: the worker builds the same managed tool-result segments, pages and manifest revisions, runs the Monitor policy (line splitting, debounce windows, idle timeout and observation quota), and turns everything that must become durable into ordered, numbered delivery entries that carry the complete resources they introduce. While a Harness is attached the worker pushes entries to a resident applier that publishes the resources and commits the record idempotently; a failed push switches the run to a held mode that retains and retries the entries instead of failing the capture, and a newer Harness replaces the publisher by writer generation rather than being refused.

The Broker now claims one puller per binding and long-polls the worker's deliveries into a new staging ledger, settles background execution rows from the pulled terminal, and arms a staged wake; the suspension path certifies a Session's live background work against the per-run journal evidence and the worker's observation-ownership signal, stamps the suspension seal with a background hold, releases the runtime lease probe-only, and detaches the publisher with its final acknowledgement. A wake — from the staged terminal, the staged-bytes watermark, or the backstop — loads the Session silently and drains the staged entries into the journal without issuing a model turn, then settles the execution and returns the Session to its prior state. Deleting or retiring a Session cleans its staging. The whole lane is gated off by default: the observation flag advertises the capability in writer grants, background Shell admission composes with the tool-publication flag (the capture lane shares its object-store configuration), and the background-held seal composes with the wake-dispatch flag.

The PR also carries two hardening passes. A review pass fixed thirteen enabled-path defects (null-preserving entry serialization, the staging resource allowlist, page-bound exhaustion under idle partial flushes, broken-flush latching, the Monitor tail deadlock, re-attach during an in-flight push, held-run retry with backoff, acknowledgement trimming, request-sized push batches, observation resource isolation, worker run forgetting and resource-store byte release, puller lease usability, and re-deriving observation bindings on Session reload). A real-daemon witness pass then found and fixed five more: the journal commit gate now accepts a running capture's published tool-result resources exactly as the reader and verifier already do (the child-run record could never commit while the capture ran); the staging segment kind matches the design and the shape the worker actually emits; staged entries keep required null fields through re-serialization so the drain replay accepts the terminal; a capture that exhausts its page bound degrades gracefully instead of crashing the worker; and the observation flag is described in the configuration reference.

## Why it's needed

Background work should outlive the Harness that started it, and a Session whose only live work is background should be able to suspend without losing that work or paying for a model turn to settle it. Keeping the capture's running digest in the worker means a Harness restart continues the same capture instead of reporting `producer_lost`; the Broker staging ledger holds the only copy of bytes the journal has not yet referenced, with entry-carried resource refs that survive retention and deletion ordering exactly like journal refs; and the drain-only wake settles exited background work silently. The delivery-entry contract makes retransmission idempotent at every level, keeps worker memory bounded with pipe backpressure, and guarantees a forced stop always produces its exit proof through a reserved terminal slot. All of this is off by default, so existing foreground and background behavior is unchanged until an operator enables it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Default-off legacy behavior: with the observation flag off, the foreground and background Shell lanes, the Monitor runtime, and the resident publisher behave exactly as before; the characterization and legacy suites pin this (core capture and equivalence, cli delivery, foreground/background publisher, monitor runtime, HTTP session store).
- Capture equivalence: identical input through the worker option set and the Harness option set yields equal per-stream digest, byte length, state and execution status, and byte-identical reconstructable output, while the worker segments strictly more finely; covers multi-MiB streams, a UTF-8 character split across chunks, an empty stream and a single partial segment.
- Staging, wake and fault matrix: the Java half is covered on H2 and on real MySQL 8.4 — staging batches and watermarks, the single-puller claim and durable adoption, execution-row settlement from the pull, the seal/wake-hint fence, re-attach-then-drain, retention guards, delete/retirement staging cleanup, worker loss and Broker restart fencing. Each case has a regression that fails on the pre-fix code.
- Full cycle on a real daemon (Linux): with the observation, tool-publication and wake-dispatch flags on, a delegated cgroup v2 root, object-store publication and a stub model, a WebShell session admits a background Shell into the delegated cgroup; the turn settles; the Session suspends with a background-held seal while the background keeps running; staging rows accumulate across the suspension; the background survives its full commanded lifetime and exits naturally; the terminal stages, the wake attaches, and a silent drain load applies every staged entry, settles both execution rows and returns the head to active — with the model request count unchanged (no model turn during drain). This was witnessed end to end, including under the original one-line-per-second workload that used to crash the worker at the page bound; that workload now degrades gracefully and still settles.
- Measurement (§7): on the same daemon, idle long-pull cost is ~2% of one core per binding at a ~3 s cycle with a single puller claim; exit-to-execution-row settlement is ~1–4 s and quiet exit-to-journal-settle ~3–6 s; loud output plateaus staging at the 16 MiB hard cap with the producer paused by backpressure and watermark wakes every ~15 s; silent-load drain cost is ~250–314 ms for one observation and ~11 s for ~300, degrading with journal growth; and a five-exit burst is paced 2.3–4.3 s apart by the wake scan with no thundering herd. These numbers keep the pull wait (2 s), staged-bytes watermark (4 MiB) and hard cap (16 MiB).

Local results: the core/cli suites above are green (capture equivalence 2/2, delivery 15/15, foreground publisher 54/54, background publisher 26/26, monitor runtime 7/7, core capture 17/17 including the two new size-limit regressions, HTTP store 246/246); the Java focused groups are green on H2 (stage store, puller, published-resource commit gate, session store integration) and the staging/wake/recovery/retention matrix ran green on a disposable MySQL 8.4 instance; the CI-equivalent dual Checkstyle execution is clean; the configuration-reference check is clean. The real-daemon cycle and the §7 numbers were measured on a Linux host (jar and bundle built from this branch); the witness scripts and per-run evidence are recorded in the bilingual implementation plan.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible/TUI change; the observation lane is gated off by default.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via vitest (core/cli) and Maven (managed-agent-server, isolated local repository, JDK 21, sibling SDK installed from the checkout). Real-daemon verification on a Linux host: managed local serve with the observation, tool-publication and wake-dispatch flags, a delegated cgroup v2 root under the user slice, Aliyun OSS publication via short-lived STS credentials, and a loopback stub model that issues one background Shell call and counts requests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the entire lane is gated off by default and composes three flags (observation, tool-publication for background admission, wake-dispatch for the background-held seal); with them off, behavior is unchanged. Staging holds the only copy of not-yet-journaled bytes, so its refs ride with their entries and follow the journal's retention and deletion ordering; the hard cap and the reserved terminal slot bound a loud or never-waking Session, and a capture that exhausts its bound degrades to unavailable with the last durable revision standing rather than losing the exit proof.
- Not validated / out of scope: MySQL-lane CI confirmation of the latest Java fixes and fleet-scale/replica puller measurement remain CI/hosted-lane work (the local matrix ran on a disposable MySQL 8.4 and a single-Broker daemon). Raising the per-stream output cap further needs coordinated protocol-limit changes and stays a maintainer design decision (§11 Q3 of the design, with the measurement evidence recorded).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none while gated off. The schema adds the staging ledger table and a resource owner kind; the publisher-install transport gains an optional writer generation and returns the worker's observation fields (all implementors, callers and test mocks updated); the configuration reference gains the observation flag description.

Design document: [`docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.md`](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.md) and [`docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.zh-CN.md). Implementation plan (witness evidence, measurement and remaining work): [`docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-runtime-owned-observation-implementation.md`](docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-runtime-owned-observation-implementation.md) and [`.zh-CN.md`](docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-runtime-owned-observation-implementation.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

References #17912 (design). Part of #17453.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 端到端实现 Phase 3b「Managed Runtime 自持后台观测」（设计已在 #17912 落地）：worker 自持采集、Broker staging 台账、可安全挂起的后台挂起、drain-only 结算唤醒，以及真实进程与 MySQL 验收矩阵和定案调优常量的 §7 度量。今天后台 Shell 或 Monitor watch 把输出 running digest 保存在 Harness 进程内，因此 Harness 重启会丢失采集并报 `producer_lost`，且带活跃后台工作的 Session 无法挂起。本改动把后台采集移入 worker：worker 构建相同的 managed tool-result 段、页与 manifest revision，运行 Monitor 策略（行切分、debounce 窗口、idle 超时与观测配额），并把所有需持久化的内容变成有序、编号、自带完整资源的 delivery 条目。Harness attach 时 worker 把条目推给常驻 applier，由其幂等地发布资源并提交记录；推送失败把 run 切到 held 模式保留并重试条目而非使采集失败，更新的 Harness 按 writer generation 替换 publisher 而非被拒绝。

Broker 现在每个 binding 认领一个 puller，long-poll worker 的投递写入新的 staging 台账，由拉取到的 terminal 结算后台 execution 行，并置位 staged wake；挂起路径依据逐 run 的 journal 证据与 worker 的 observation 归属信号认证 Session 的活跃后台工作，在挂起 seal 上盖后台持有戳，以 probe-only 方式释放 runtime lease，并携带最终确认摘除 publisher。wake（来自 staged terminal、staged-bytes 水位线或兜底）静默加载 Session，把 staged 条目排空进 journal 而不发模型 turn，然后结算 execution 并使 Session 回到先前状态。删除或退役 Session 会清理其 staging。整条 lane 默认关闭：observation flag 在 writer grant 中公告能力，后台 Shell 准入与 tool-publication flag 组合（capture lane 复用其对象存储配置），后台持有 seal 与 wake-dispatch flag 组合。

本 PR 还包含两轮加固。评审轮修复了十三个启用路径缺陷（保留 null 的条目序列化、staging 资源白名单、空闲 partial flush 耗尽页上限、失败 flush 门闩、Monitor 尾窗口死锁、在途 push 期间重附着、held run 退避重试、确认裁剪、按请求大小分批、观测资源隔离、worker run 遗忘与资源存储字节释放、puller lease 可用性、Session reload 时重新推导 observation binding）。真实 daemon 见证轮又发现并修复五个：journal commit 门现在与 reader/verifier 一致地接受运行中 capture 的已发布 tool-result 资源（此前 child-run 记录在 capture 运行期间永远提交不上）；staging segment kind 对齐设计与 worker 实际发射的形状；staged 条目在重序列化中保留必需 null 字段使 drain replay 接受 terminal；耗尽页上限的 capture 优雅降级而非崩溃 worker；observation flag 补入配置参考描述。

## 为什么需要

后台工作应当比启动它的 Harness 活得更久，而唯一活跃工作是后台的 Session 应当能挂起，既不丢失这些工作也不为结算它付一个模型 turn。把采集的 running digest 放在 worker 意味着 Harness 重启延续同一采集而非报 `producer_lost`；Broker staging 台账持有 journal 尚未引用字节的唯一副本，其条目携带的资源 ref 与 journal ref 完全一致地遵循保留与删除顺序；drain-only wake 静默结算已退出的后台工作。delivery 条目契约使每一层重传幂等、以管道背压保持 worker 内存有界，并保证强制停止总经保留 terminal 槽产出退出证明。这一切默认关闭，因此在运营者启用前现有前台/后台行为不变。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 默认关闭的遗留行为：observation flag 关闭时，前台与后台 Shell lane、Monitor runtime、常驻 publisher 行为与此前完全一致；特征化与遗留套件钉住这一点（core capture 与 equivalence、cli delivery、前台/后台 publisher、monitor runtime、HTTP session store）。
- 采集等价：相同输入经 worker 选项集与 Harness 选项集产出相等的逐流 digest、字节长度、状态与执行状态，以及字节一致的可重建输出，worker 分段严格更细；覆盖多 MiB 流、跨 chunk 的 UTF-8 字符、空流与单个部分段。
- staging、wake 与故障矩阵：Java 半在 H2 与真实 MySQL 8.4 上覆盖——staging 批次与水位线、单 puller claim 与持久领养、由 pull 结算 execution 行、seal/wake-hint 围栏、重附着后排空、保留守卫、删除/退役 staging 清理、worker 丢失与 Broker 重启围栏。每个用例都有在修复前代码上失败的回归。
- 真实 daemon 全循环（Linux）：开启 observation、tool-publication、wake-dispatch flag，配委派 cgroup v2 根、对象存储发布与 stub 模型后，WebShell session 准入后台 Shell 进委派 cgroup；turn 结算；Session 带后台持有 seal 挂起而后台继续运行；staging 行跨挂起累积；后台存活满命令时长并自然退出；terminal 暂存、wake attach、静默 drain load 应用全部 staged 条目、结算两条 execution 行并使 head 回 active——模型请求数不变（drain 期间无模型 turn）。该循环已端到端见证，含原本会在页上限处崩溃 worker 的每秒一行工作量；该工作量现在优雅降级并仍结算。
- 度量（§7）：同一 daemon 上，空闲 long-pull 成本约 2% 单核/binding（~3s 周期、单 puller claim）；退出→execution 行结算 ~1–4s，安静退出→journal 结算 ~3–6s；喧闹输出使 staging 在 16 MiB 硬上限平台化（生产者被背压暂停），水位线 wake 每 ~15s 一次；静默 load drain 成本 1 观测 ~250–314ms、~300 观测 ~11s（随 journal 增长退化）；5 退出突发被 wake scan 以 2.3–4.3s 间隔 paced，无惊群。这些数字保持 pull 等待（2s）、staged-bytes 水位线（4 MiB）与硬上限（16 MiB）。

本地结果：上述 core/cli 套件绿（capture equivalence 2/2、delivery 15/15、前台 publisher 54/54、后台 publisher 26/26、monitor runtime 7/7、core capture 17/17 含两个新 size-limit 回归、HTTP store 246/246）；Java 聚焦组在 H2 绿（stage store、puller、published-resource commit 门、session store 集成），staging/wake/recovery/retention 矩阵在一次性 MySQL 8.4 实例绿；CI 同款双 Checkstyle execution 干净；配置参考检查干净。真实 daemon 循环与 §7 数字在 Linux 主机度量（jar 与 bundle 由本分支构建）；见证脚本与逐 run 证据记录在双语实施计划中。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 无用户可见/TUI 变化；observation lane 默认关闭。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

单元测试经 vitest（core/cli）与 Maven（managed-agent-server，隔离本地仓库，JDK 21，sibling SDK 从 checkout 安装）。真实 daemon 验证在 Linux 主机：managed local serve 开 observation、tool-publication、wake-dispatch flag，user slice 下的委派 cgroup v2 根，经短期 STS 凭证的阿里云 OSS 发布，以及发起一次后台 Shell 调用并计数请求的回环 stub 模型。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：整条 lane 默认关闭且组合三个 flag（observation、后台准入的 tool-publication、后台持有 seal 的 wake-dispatch）；关闭时行为不变。staging 持有尚未入 journal 字节的唯一副本，其 ref 随条目并遵循 journal 的保留与删除顺序；硬上限与保留 terminal 槽使喧闹或永不醒的 Session 有界，耗尽上限的 capture 降级为 unavailable 并保留最后持久 revision，而非丢失退出证明。
- 未验证/范围外：最新 Java 修复的 MySQL 车道 CI 确认与舰队规模/复本 puller 度量留 CI/hosted 车道（本地矩阵跑在一次性 MySQL 8.4 与单 Broker daemon）。进一步抬高每流输出上限需协同协议上限改动，属 maintainer 设计决策（设计 §11 Q3，度量证据已记录）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：关闭时无。schema 新增 staging 台账表与一个资源 owner kind；publisher-install transport 增加可选 writer generation 并返回 worker observation 字段（所有实现方、调用方与测试 mock 已更新）；配置参考新增 observation flag 描述。

设计文档：[`docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.md`](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.md) 与 [`docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-runtime-owned-observation.zh-CN.md)。实施计划（见证证据、度量与剩余工作）：[`docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-runtime-owned-observation-implementation.md`](docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-runtime-owned-observation-implementation.md) 与 [`.zh-CN.md`](docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-runtime-owned-observation-implementation.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

References #17912（设计）。Part of #17453。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clears every high-and-critical finding currently failing the nightly Security Checks gate (`pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high`): bumps the directly declared packages (simple-git 3→4.1, shell-quote, sharp, markdown-it in both majors in use), lifts the msteams channel's `@microsoft/agents-*` to the upstream release that already carries the fixed zod and msal-node, and adds three workspace overrides for transitive-only findings (proxy-addr, follow-redirects, and the shell-quote copies pinned by ink's react-devtools-core chain).

## Why it's needed

The Security Checks workflow has been red on main for over a week on a batch of advisories published against the locked tree (simple-git's November CVE set, proxy-addr IP spoofing, shell-quote command injection, follow-redirects credential handling, sharp's librsvg, markdown-it quadratic complexity, and the zod/msal-node copies entering through `@microsoft/agents-*@1.9.1`). The one behavioral adaptation: simple-git v4 throws when a task environment names a guarded `GIT_*` variable without an explicit opt-in, and the extension git client deliberately sets `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`/`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`/`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT` (plus the inline credential trio when authenticating), so those are now named in `allowEnvironment`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` should exit 0 (remaining findings: 1 low, 6 moderate — below the gate). The behavior-sensitive surface is the extension git client: its unit tests exercise the restricted-environment client against simple-git's guard, including the credentialed paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — dependency and guard-configuration change, no UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification: `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` exits 0; `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass; targeted vitest runs all pass — packages/core git suites (`extension-git-client`, `github`, `load-simple-git`, `gitUtils`, `enter-worktree`, `agent`: 649 tests), shell parse/quote suites (784 tests), msteams channel suite (65 tests), and the notices generator test. Both `NOTICES.txt` files were regenerated with the repo's script.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: simple-git 3→4 is a major; the breaking changes (default export removed, abbreviated long options rejected, ambient GIT_* env filtered) were each checked against this repo's usage — all git access goes through the guarded loader, which already uses the named export. The msteams agents minor bump is upstream's own fix carrier. The pnpm minimumReleaseAge gate accepted every pinned version at install time.
- Not validated / out of scope: 1 low and 6 moderate findings remain below the gate; the broader Snyk-driven remediation program is tracked separately in #17099.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none expected.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17099 (the standing security-upgrade tracker). Refs #16434.

prs.title: fix(test): isolate the standalone runtime regression from inherited session env (#17966)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the standalone runtime regression hermetic against the ambient environment: before any probe runs, the test worker now drops the environment keys the production launcher honors (`CLI_VERSION`, `QWEN_CODE_RELAUNCH_ARGS`) plus the preload injectors (`NODE_OPTIONS`, `BUN_OPTIONS`) — the same key set the suite's ambient scenario already strips for its own control probes. A source-pinning witness test next to the existing standalone-suite budget test keeps the guard in place. Test-only change; no production code is touched.

## Why it's needed

The v0.28.3 release failed at its `quality` gate (#17966). Reproducing every quality sub-check locally against the release commit showed the standalone runtime regression — part of the release's script-tests job — fails deterministically whenever the surrounding environment carries a qwen session's stamps: the launcher answers `--version` from `CLI_VERSION` before it ever reads the fixture metadata, so the "metadata-only positive control" asserts the outer session's version (`0.28.0`) against the fixture's `1.2.3` and the whole release gate fails closed. The release validates on the dedicated self-hosted pool that also hosts qwen automation, and jobs on that fleet can inherit a session's environment (this autofix job's own environment carries the full stamp set); the release runner preparation isolates Git/npm/Docker/gh state but not these variables. The suite already acknowledged this pollution class for its ambient controls but left the rest of the worker exposed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `CLI_VERSION=0.28.0 QWEN_CODE_RELAUNCH_ARGS='["--version"]' npm run test:standalone:runtimes:ci` after `npm run build`. Before this change the node worker dies at phase `node/direct/missing` with `AssertionError: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'`; after it, both the node and bun workers complete and the command exits 0. The same run under a clean environment passes both before and after (baseline). The new witness in the release-workflow script suite fails when the guard is removed and passes with it restored (mutation-probed both directions). The full release quality matrix was also reproduced green: lint, typecheck, all three workspace-test shards in a clean CI-like environment, the serve-fast-path bundle check, the full build, pack-build, and verify-package.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Before, with inherited session stamps: `{"host":"node","failurePhase":"node/direct/missing",...}` followed by `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'`. After, same environment: `{"host":"node","complete":true,...}`, `{"host":"bun","complete":true,...}`, exit 0.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Self-hosted Linux runner (Node 22), pinned Node/Bun runtime archives fetched by the suite itself; clean CI-like environment for the baseline runs (`env -i` with fresh HOME), full session environment for the pollution runs. The suite is POSIX-only by design (Windows skips it).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: stripping `NODE_OPTIONS`/`BUN_OPTIONS` at worker start also sanitizes the early registry-entry probes; that is the intended hermeticity and matches what the suite's outer spawner already does for direct runs. Both runtime hosts pass the complete matrix after the change, including under the full session environment.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact failing sub-check of release run 44841519782 cannot be confirmed without log access; this fix addresses the only reproducible defect found across the whole quality matrix. macOS/Windows not exercised (the fixture is POSIX-only). Twenty script-suite lint-lane failures seen during reproduction were traced to this sandbox lacking the `file` utility (probe: `spawnSync file ENOENT`), and two workspace failures to the session's `SANDBOX` stamp — both ruled out with focused clean-environment reruns, not product defects.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test infrastructure only.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17966

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让独立运行时回归测试对外部环境保持封闭（hermetic）：在任何探针运行之前，测试 worker 现在会丢弃生产启动器所读取的环境键（`CLI_VERSION`、`QWEN_CODE_RELAUNCH_ARGS`）以及预加载注入器（`NODE_OPTIONS`、`BUN_OPTIONS`）——与套件 ambient 场景为其自身对照探针已剥离的键集完全一致。在既有的独立套件预算测试旁新增了一个源码钉住（source-pinning）见证测试，确保该守卫不被移除。纯测试改动；未触碰生产代码。

## 为什么需要

v0.28.3 发布在其 `quality` 门禁处失败（#17966）。在发布提交上本地复现每一个质量子检查后发现：只要周围环境携带 qwen 会话的印记，独立运行时回归测试（发布脚本测试任务的一部分）就会确定性失败——启动器在读取 fixture 元数据之前就用 `CLI_VERSION` 回答 `--version`，于是“仅元数据阳性对照”拿外层会话的版本（`0.28.0`）去断言 fixture 的 `1.2.3`，整个发布门禁随之失败关闭。发布在专用自托管池上验证，该池同时承载 qwen 自动化，该机群的任务可以继承会话环境（本 autofix 任务自身的环境就携带完整印记集）；发布 runner 的准备工作隔离了 Git/npm/Docker/gh 状态，但没有隔离这些变量。套件早已为 ambient 对照承认了这类污染，却让其馀 worker 暴露在外。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `npm run build` 之后运行 `CLI_VERSION=0.28.0 QWEN_CODE_RELAUNCH_ARGS='["--version"]' npm run test:standalone:runtimes:ci`。改动前，node worker 在 `node/direct/missing` 阶段以 `AssertionError: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'` 失败；改动后，node 与 bun worker 均完成且命令 exit 0。干净环境下的同一运行在改动前后均通过（基线）。发布工作流脚本套件中的新见证测试在移除守卫时失败、恢复后通过（两个方向均做了变异探针）。完整的发布质量矩阵也已复现为绿：lint、typecheck、干净类 CI 环境下的全部三个工作区测试分片、serve-fast-path bundle 检查、完整构建、pack-build 与 verify-package。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A（非 UI）。改动前，继承会话印记时：`{"host":"node","failurePhase":"node/direct/missing",...}`，随后 `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: metadata-only positive control '0.28.0' !== '1.2.3'`。改动后，同一环境：`{"host":"node","complete":true,...}`、`{"host":"bun","complete":true,...}`，exit 0。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

自托管 Linux runner（Node 22），套件自行拉取固定版本的 Node/Bun 运行时归档；基线运行使用干净类 CI 环境（`env -i` 加全新 HOME），污染运行使用完整会话环境。该套件按设计仅支持 POSIX（Windows 跳过）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：在 worker 启动时剥离 `NODE_OPTIONS`/`BUN_OPTIONS` 也会净化早期的 registry-entry 探针；这正是预期的封闭性，且与套件外层 spawner 对直接运行已有的处理一致。改动后两个运行时宿主均通过完整矩阵，包括完整会话环境下。
- 未验证/范围外：没有日志访问权限，无法确认发布 run 44841519782 具体失败的子检查；本修复处理的是整个质量矩阵中唯一可复现的缺陷。未覆盖 macOS/Windows（fixture 仅 POSIX）。复现期间看到的二十个脚本套件 lint 通道失败被证实源于本沙箱缺少 `file` 工具（探针：`spawnSync file ENOENT`），两个工作区失败源于会话的 `SANDBOX` 印记——均通过聚焦的干净环境重跑排除，非产品缺陷。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；仅测试基础设施。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #17966

prs.title: feat(cli): attribute Managed Agent sessions to the managed telemetry channel
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a `managed` value to the telemetry client-channel dimension so Managed Agent sessions can be told apart from ordinary daemon traffic. The Hosted Harness daemon stamps an informational environment marker into its own environment at boot, before the session-child base environment is frozen, and restores the previous value on close and on startup failure so embedded callers keep no leftover marker. The ACP channel fallback resolves the new marker ahead of the existing desktop and daemon markers, and the config loader now applies the same fallback to the synthesized per-turn arguments the Hosted loop builds, which never pass through argument parsing. Both Managed execution paths — in-process hosted turns and spawned legacy-engine children — therefore report `channel=managed`. The value is also added to the CLI channel choices, the container-sandbox passthrough, the project-env denylist, and the daemon-start environment drop; any non-hosted-profile serve boot additionally clears an inherited marker before freezing the base env (and restores it on close), so an independent daemon launched inside a Managed session keeps reporting daemon. The runtime client attribution design is extended with the managed row and its two execution paths (now maintained as a complete English/Chinese pair).

## Why it's needed

Usage telemetry already separates CLI, VSCode, SDK, ACP, CI, desktop, and daemon entry points, but the Managed Agent was invisible as a product surface: its hosted turns reported no channel at all because their per-turn configs bypass argument parsing, and its legacy-engine children reported the generic daemon marker shared with Web Shell and SDK daemon clients. Product and capacity analysis for the Managed Agent needs its own bucket without double-counting ordinary daemon usage, and the attribution must not be spoofable by a workspace or leak across daemon boundaries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the channel fallback, config, shared-env-keys, sandbox, daemon-start, and serve deployment-profile unit suites (exact commands and output in the verification comment). Expect: the managed marker resolves ahead of the desktop and serve markers; an explicit channel flag still wins; non-ACP arguments stay unset even under a marker; the hosted-harness profile stamps the marker into its own environment and into the frozen session-child base environment captured by the spawn factory, restores it on close and on a startup failure that lands after the stamp, and restores a pre-existing operator value; the default profile never stamps. For a live check, boot the managed-local stack with usage statistics enabled, send a prompt through the Web Shell, and inspect the RUM upload from the harness process: `properties.channel` should be `managed` (this full-stack capture was not run locally; it needs the Java control plane and is flagged as unverified in the report).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible interface change. Terminal captures of the verification runs are embedded below; they show the suite results on the rebased head, not a UI before/after.

![Verification runs at head 30b190c598: 1147 tests passed (incl. LIFO/non-LIFO co-residency and stamp-window cases, the serve process.env AST guard, RUM payload channel cases and a 3-cell real-process gate), ESLint/Prettier clean, cli+core tsc --noEmit exit 0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/managed-telemetry-channel/managed-telemetry-channel/managed-telemetry-verification.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |

prs.title: fix(ci): isolate self-hosted Maven cache reuse
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Self-hosted Java jobs now rebuild a writable job-local Maven repository before running Maven. Warm hosts can still seed that repository with hard links, but cross-device or otherwise unsuccessful copies fall back to a clean local repository rather than leaving a partial tree. Legacy nested copies, repository aliases, inherited read-only directories and leftover quarantine directories are handled before any Maven invocation.

Resolver tracking records, remote and local metadata, checksums, transfer residue, and in-house artifacts under development are removed before unlocked Maven runs. Failure to establish a safe job-local repository stops the affected seed instead of allowing stale shared links to redirect writes into the host cache. Mount records are inspected with structured parsing, while the destructive cleanup operations do not follow nested filesystem aliases or cross filesystem boundaries.

Cache publication retains the existing host lock and deferred Maven status. It skips cross-filesystem publication and preserves the original suite status, keeping cache performance improvements separate from test and release gates. The recorded workflow size baselines account for the five affected seed sites and their failure handling.

## Why it's needed

The previous copy could fail when the host cache and the job-local repository were on different filesystems. Ignoring that failure left an incomplete repository that Maven would still consume, while a same-filesystem copy could preserve nested aliases or mutable resolver files as shared host inodes. Subsequent unlocked Maven runs could read stale state or modify inherited cache files before the locked write-back phase.

This change lets affected jobs fall back to the network when warm reuse is unavailable, while ensuring that the shortcut cannot redirect or leak writes outside the job-local repository.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run `node --test --test-concurrency=1 .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`; all 112 routing and safety checks should pass, including the bounded artifact-cleaning guard.
- Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js --reporter=dot` on Linux. It should execute all 225 tests and exercise device mismatches, partial copies, root and nested aliases, quarantine recovery, read-only directories, mount-record failures, residual resolver state, and preservation of successful and failing Maven statuses.
- For reviewer-visible real-Maven coverage, seed a private temporary host repository containing `_remote.repositories` and an ordinary fixture JAR, run the self-hosted reference seed with private `HOME` and `RUNNER_TEMP`, then install a fixture JAR into the job-local repository using Maven 3.9.11. The host tracker should keep its original content and have one link, not be rewritten through the copied inode. Omitting `_remote.repositories` from the seed's deletion predicate should reproduce host-side mutation with two links; do not point this A/B fixture at a real user repository.
- Verify that a host cache and job repository on different filesystems cause a clean network-backed fallback rather than an attempted cross-filesystem hardlink copy. A same-filesystem host cache should still provide ordinary warm JAR links. Successful and failed Maven runs must retain their own exit statuses, and the cross-device write-back must not publish a cache delta.
- Review that a quarantine move or metadata cleanup failure before Maven is fatal when a usable safe repository cannot be established, while failure to delete only the newest quarantined tree is observable without replacing the Maven suite status.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI-infrastructure change with no terminal or Web Shell UI. Private Linux A/B: the intact reference seed ran real Maven 3.9.11 with `hostTrackingChanged=false` and host tracker `nlink=1`; deliberately omitting tracking-record pruning produced `hostTrackingChanged=true` and `nlink=2`. On real `/dev/shm` and `/tmp` devices, the unguarded seed failed with status 1 and the guarded cold start succeeded with status 0.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: 225 workflow-cache tests passed, plus 758 passed and one skipped in ten related workflow suites. The reference-package Node suite passed 28 tests with one root-only skip. macOS: the focused workflow file passed 144 tests with 81 Linux-only skips; one release-workflow timing test outside this cache change still exceeds its five-second budget on this host, including after the main merge, so a full macOS test suite is not claimed as green. Windows was not run locally.

### Environment (optional)

### Environment (optional)

Linux shell and filesystem behavior used private temporary repositories, separate `/dev/shm` and `/tmp` filesystems, and private user/mount namespaces. Real Maven verification used Maven 3.9.11 with an isolated installation request rather than the user's existing Maven repository. On the updated main base, the full build, TypeScript checks, complete `npm run lint`, Prettier, and the Bash-5 workflow-size check all passed. Full Hosted MySQL, daemon-cluster and JDK 11/21 behavior remains for the pull request's actual CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a damaged or cross-device warm cache can cost more network resolution or stop a seed when it cannot be made safe. This is deliberate: continuing with unresolved aliases or resolver links is less safe than falling back or stopping before Maven.
- Not validated / out of scope: this does not attempt to secure against privileged mount injection after a mount-table snapshot, and it does not change runtime providers, MySQL behavior, daemon orchestration or the merged approval behavior in #17863. Mount inspection is an observed-state guard, not an atomic file-system security boundary.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No settings or project files require migration. The increased workflow-size records reflect the five seed sites and do not relax the 470000-byte absolute limit.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17863; that approval-behavior PR is already merged and is not modified by this independent CI repair. No issue is closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

自托管 Java 任务现在会在执行 Maven 之前重建一个可写的任务本地 Maven 仓库。温热宿主仍可用硬链接播种该仓库，但跨设备或其他原因导致的复制失败会回退到干净的本地仓库，而不是继续使用复制了一半的目录树。所有 Maven 调用之前都会处理旧的嵌套复制、仓库别名、继承的只读目录和历史隔离目录。

在可能未持锁的 Maven 运行之前，会删除 Resolver 跟踪记录、远端及本地元数据、校验和、传输残留物和正在开发的内部构件。当无法建立安全的任务本地仓库时，种子阶段会停止，而不是让异常链接把写入重定向到宿主缓存。挂载记录通过结构化解析进行检查，破坏性清理操作也不会跟随嵌套的文件系统别名或跨越文件系统边界。

缓存回写仍保留既有的宿主锁和延后的 Maven 状态。跨文件系统时会跳过发布，并保留原始测试状态，从而将缓存性能改进与测试及发布门禁分开。工作流大小基线的记录反映五个受影响的种子位置及其失败处理。

## Why it's needed

之前的复制方式在宿主缓存与任务本地仓库位于不同文件系统时会失败。忽略该错误会让 Maven 继续使用不完整的仓库；同一文件系统的复制又可能保留嵌套别名，或将可变的 Resolver 文件保留为共享宿主 inode。随后未持锁的 Maven 运行可能在进入持锁回写阶段之前读取陈旧状态，甚至修改继承的缓存文件。

这项修改使受影响的任务在无法热复用时回退到网络解析，同时保证这条性能捷径不会将写入重定向或泄漏到任务本地仓库之外。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- 运行 `node --test --test-concurrency=1 .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`；全部 112 项路由和安全检查应通过，其中包括带边界的构件清理守卫。
- 在 Linux 上运行 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js --reporter=dot`。应执行全部 225 项测试，覆盖设备不匹配、部分复制、根目录和嵌套别名、隔离区恢复、只读目录、挂载记录故障、残留的 Resolver 状态，以及成功和失败 Maven 状态的保留。
- 对于评审可亲自复跑的真实 Maven 覆盖，先在私有临时宿主仓库中放入 `_remote.repositories` 和普通示例 JAR，以私有 `HOME` 和 `RUNNER_TEMP` 执行自托管参考构建的种子阶段，再使用 Maven 3.9.11 将示例 JAR 安装到任务本地仓库。宿主跟踪文件应保持原内容且链接数为 1，不应通过复制得到的 inode 被改写。故意从种子的删除谓词中省略 `_remote.repositories`，应可复现链接数为 2 时的宿主侧写入；不要让这套 A/B 夹具访问真实用户仓库。
- 验证宿主缓存与任务仓库位于不同文件系统时，会走干净的网络回退，而不是尝试跨文件系统硬链接复制。位于同一文件系统的宿主缓存仍应提供正常的温热 JAR 链接。成功或失败的 Maven 运行必须保留各自退出码，跨设备回写不得发布缓存增量。
- 检查当无法建立可用且安全的仓库时，Maven 之前的隔离移动或元数据清理失败会终止该步骤；仅删除最新隔离树失败时应保持可观察，同时不替换 Maven 测试状态。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A —— 这是 CI 基础设施修改，没有终端或 Web Shell 用户界面。私有 Linux A/B 中，完整参考种子运行真实 Maven 3.9.11 后，`hostTrackingChanged=false`、宿主跟踪文件 `nlink=1`；故意漏删跟踪记录时则得到 `hostTrackingChanged=true` 和 `nlink=2`。在实际的 `/dev/shm` 和 `/tmp` 不同设备上，无保护种子以状态 1 失败，受保护的冷启动以状态 0 成功。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux：225 项工作流缓存测试通过，十个相关工作流套件另有 758 项通过、1 项跳过。参考发行包 Node 套件通过 28 项、因需 root 跳过 1 项。macOS：定向工作流测试通过 144 项，并有 81 项 Linux 专属跳过；本缓存修改之外的发布流程计时用例在本机仍超过五秒上限（合入更新后的 main 后又复现一次），因此不声称完整 macOS 测试全绿。Windows 未在本地运行。

### Environment (optional)

Linux shell 与文件系统验证使用了私有临时仓库、分离的 `/dev/shm` 和 `/tmp` 文件系统以及私有用户/挂载命名空间。真实 Maven 验证使用 Maven 3.9.11，在隔离环境中安装构件，而不是访问用户既有的 Maven 仓库。在更新后的 main 基线上，完整构建、TypeScript 检查、完整 `npm run lint`、Prettier 和工作流大小检查均通过。完整的 Hosted MySQL、daemon 集群与 JDK 11/21 行为留给本 PR 的真实 CI 验证。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：损坏或跨设备的温热缓存可能需要更多网络解析，或在无法安全整理时停止种子阶段。这是刻意选择：与带未解析别名或 Resolver 链接继续执行相比，回退到网络或在 Maven 之前停止更安全。
- 未验证/不在范围：本修改不试图防御挂载表快照之后的特权挂载注入，也不修改 runtime provider、MySQL 行为、daemon 编排或已在 #17863 中合入的审批行为。挂载检查是针对已观测状态的守卫，不是原子性的文件系统安全边界。
- 破坏性变化/迁移说明：无。无需迁移设置或项目文件。工作流大小记录增加反映五个种子位置，并未放宽 470000 字节的绝对上限。

## Linked Issues

仅作 #17863 的后续关联；那条审批行为 PR 已经合入，本独立 CI 修复不修改它。本 PR 不关闭任何 issue。

</details>

prs.title: test(integration): deflake the teammate parity helper gate (#18027)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This stabilizes the teammate-report scenario in the interactive agent-loop parity suite without changing anything it verifies. The scenario scripts a helper subagent whose reply is deliberately held back until the leader's answer has been recorded on disk, so that the two agents' transcripts have a deterministic causal order. That hold now gets the same generous wall-clock budget the suite already uses for its other cross-turn waits, instead of inheriting the polling helper's much shorter default. A fast companion test pins the new budget by driving the scenario's real reply closure under fake timers, so a future regression back to the short default fails immediately rather than resurfacing as an occasional red CI run.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol observed this scenario failing and then passing on a rerun of the same commit, in code the reporting PR did not touch. The failure signature was that the round counts matched across arms while the request arrays differed by exactly one.

The mechanism is a test-side timing race, not a product defect. The gate that orders the helper behind the leader's recorded answer is the only code in this scenario's scripted reply that can throw, and it was running on a 30-second default while every comparable wait in the file explicitly allows 90 seconds. When a contended runner stalls the leader past that default, the gate throws, the fake model server answers HTTP 500, and the CLI quite correctly retries the helper request inside the same round. Because a retry runs inside its round, the round counters stay at their expected values while the strict request count sees one extra request — precisely the reported signature.

The causal chain was proven rather than assumed: forcing the gate to expire once produced `requests=7` with `perAgent={"leader":5,"helper":2}` and unchanged round counts, failing the length assertion with "expected … to have a length of 6 but got 7". Retrying a 500 is correct CLI behaviour, so the fix belongs in the test's wait budget, not in the product.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the named scenario repeatedly and confirm it is green every time: from `integration-tests`, `QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts -t '(teammate report|helper gate)'`. Five consecutive runs passed here, plus a sixth against a freshly built bundle.

Confirm the new companion test is load-bearing rather than decorative: delete the `90_000` argument from the helper gate's `until(...)` call and rerun with `-t 'helper gate'`. It must fail with `expected true to be false`, because the gate then settles before the 31 simulated seconds elapse. Restore the argument and it passes again. This mutation probe was run in both directions.

Confirm the fake-timer test does not leak state into the scenarios that follow it: run `-t '(helper gate|plain text|Stop hook|background shell|teammate report|normalizer)'`. All six passed, including the background-shell and Stop-hook scenarios that depend on real timers.

Confirm no assertion was weakened: the diff adds a timeout argument and one new test, and touches no existing expectation. The suite's test count goes from 26 to 27.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI behaviour changes. This is test-harness stabilization only.

Before (forced-failure surrogate reproducing the CI signature):

```
[probe] arm=current i=2 agent=helper THREW held=230ms Error: the leader records its waiting answer
[probe] arm=current i=4 agent=helper ARRIVE          ← the CLI's retry
[probe] arm=current requests=7 perAgent={"leader":5,"helper":2} sharedRounds=0
[probe] arm=shared  requests=6 perAgent={"leader":5,"helper":1} sharedRounds=5
AssertionError: expected [ … ] to have a length of 6 but got 7
```

After (five consecutive runs, plus the interference run and the fresh-build run):

```
Tests  2 passed | 25 skipped (27)
Tests  6 passed | 21 skipped (27)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node v22.23.2, built CLI bundle (`dist/cli.js`), `QWEN_SANDBOX=false`, Ink renderer. The OpenTUI and Bun legs were not exercised locally; the changed gate belongs to a scenario the OpenTUI leg already filters out, and the new companion test drives the reply closure directly and is renderer-independent.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: raising the gate's ceiling means a genuinely wedged leader now takes longer to surface as a failure. The diagnostic improves rather than degrades — it becomes the gate's own explicit "the leader records its waiting answer" error instead of a confusing request-count mismatch — and the scenario's existing 240-second per-test timeout still bounds the whole case.
- Not validated / out of scope: the original CI log was not reachable from this run, so the precise stall that tripped the 30-second default on the reporting runner was not observed directly; the mechanism was established by a forced-failure surrogate that reproduces the exact signature. Six baseline runs on an idle machine were green, so the natural stall did not reproduce locally. The OpenTUI/Bun legs and macOS/Windows were not run. No product code is changed, and no other scenario's wait budget is touched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Test-only change; no settings source changed, so no generated schema regeneration is required.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18027

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 稳化了交互式 agent-loop 对等套件中的 teammate 报告场景，且不改变它所验证的任何内容。该场景脚本化了一个 helper 子代理，其回复被有意延后，直到 leader 的回答落盘为止，以便两个代理的转录具有确定的因果顺序。现在这道等待获得了本套件其他跨轮次等待已在使用的宽松墙钟预算，而不再继承轮询辅助函数那个短得多的默认值。同时新增了一个快速配套测试，通过在 fake timers 下驱动场景真实的 reply 闭包来钉住这个新预算，因此将来若回退到短默认值会立即失败，而不会再次表现为偶发的 CI 红灯。

## 为什么需要

CI Failure Patrol 观察到该场景在同一 commit 上先失败、重跑后通过，且相关代码并非报告 PR 所改动。失败签名是：各分支轮次计数一致，而请求数组恰好相差一条。

其成因是测试侧的时序竞争，而非产品缺陷。把 helper 排在 leader 已记录回答之后的这道闸门，是该场景脚本化 reply 中唯一可能抛异常的代码，而它运行在 30 秒默认值上，文件中所有同类等待都显式允许 90 秒。当高负载 runner 让 leader 停顿超过该默认值时，闸门抛异常，fake 模型服务器返回 HTTP 500，CLI 则完全正确地在同一轮次内重试 helper 请求。由于重试发生在其轮次内部，轮次计数仍保持期望值，而严格的请求计数却看到多出一条请求 —— 正是所报告的签名。

这条因果链是被证明而非假设的：强制让闸门超时一次，产生了 `requests=7`、`perAgent={"leader":5,"helper":2}` 且轮次计数不变的结果，长度断言以「expected … to have a length of 6 but got 7」失败。对 500 重试是 CLI 的正确行为，因此修复应落在测试的等待预算上，而不是产品里。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

重复运行命名场景并确认每次都通过：在 `integration-tests` 下执行 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts -t '(teammate report|helper gate)'`。本地连续 5 次通过，另外针对全新构建产物又跑了第 6 次。

确认新增的配套测试是真正起作用的、而非装饰：从 helper 闸门的 `until(...)` 调用中删除 `90_000` 参数，再以 `-t 'helper gate'` 重跑。它必须失败并报 `expected true to be false`，因为此时闸门会在 31 秒模拟时间走完之前就已结束。恢复该参数后再次通过。此变异探针已双向执行。

确认 fake-timer 测试不会把状态泄漏给其后的场景：运行 `-t '(helper gate|plain text|Stop hook|background shell|teammate report|normalizer)'`。六个全部通过，其中包括依赖真实定时器的 background-shell 与 Stop-hook 场景。

确认没有弱化任何断言：diff 只增加了一个超时参数和一个新测试，未触碰任何既有期望。套件测试数从 26 增至 27。

### 证据（修复前与修复后）

N/A —— 没有用户可见或 TUI 行为变化。这仅是测试框架的稳化。

修复前（强制失败替身复现 CI 签名）：

```
[probe] arm=current i=2 agent=helper THREW held=230ms Error: the leader records its waiting answer
[probe] arm=current i=4 agent=helper ARRIVE          ← CLI 的重试
[probe] arm=current requests=7 perAgent={"leader":5,"helper":2} sharedRounds=0
[probe] arm=shared  requests=6 perAgent={"leader":5,"helper":1} sharedRounds=5
AssertionError: expected [ … ] to have a length of 6 but got 7
```

修复后（连续 5 次运行，加上干扰检查与全新构建运行）：

```
Tests  2 passed | 25 skipped (27)
Tests  6 passed | 21 skipped (27)
```

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux、Node v22.23.2、已构建的 CLI 产物（`dist/cli.js`）、`QWEN_SANDBOX=false`、Ink 渲染器。OpenTUI 与 Bun 分支未在本地执行；被改动的闸门所属场景在 OpenTUI 分支中本就被过滤掉，而新增的配套测试直接驱动 reply 闭包，与渲染器无关。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：抬高闸门上限意味着真正卡死的 leader 需要更久才会暴露为失败。诊断信息是变好而非变差 —— 它会变成闸门自身明确的「the leader records its waiting answer」错误，而不是令人困惑的请求数不匹配 —— 并且该场景既有的 240 秒单测试超时仍然约束整个用例。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：本次运行无法读取原始 CI 日志，因此报告 runner 上究竟是何种停顿触发了 30 秒默认值，并未被直接观察到；该机制是通过一个能复现完全相同签名的强制失败替身确立的。空闲机器上的 6 次基线运行均为绿色，故自然停顿未在本地复现。OpenTUI/Bun 分支以及 macOS/Windows 未运行。没有改动任何产品代码，也没有触碰其他场景的等待预算。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): align session hover status with the row's status cues
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The session hover details popover now faithfully names every status cue the session row shows, instead of only the states derivable from the session summary. Two alignments: (1) while a realtime voice session is spinning up, the row swaps its status dot for a spinner and the popover now shows the same "Preparing voice chat…" label instead of idle/running; (2) the completed-unread arm moves to the row's dot precedence — the unread dot outranks the running and active-work dots, the background dot outranks unread — so a row showing the unread dot is no longer described as running/active/unknown in its own popover, and hidden background work is named by the same suffix the running arm uses. The voice-starting override and the unread arm both stay below the actionable approval/question cues, mirroring the row's attention badge and the popover's pinned blocked-state precedence. Override labels themselves also carry the background suffix, so a starting voice session with background tasks names both states instead of dropping the hidden one (verify-pr F1).

## Why it's needed

The session list expresses status mostly as icon-only colored dots and spinners, several of them aria-hidden; the hover details popover is the only textual outlet for those cues. Before this PR the popover could contradict the row it describes: a starting spinner with no textual counterpart, and an unread dot described as "Running". Covering every circle state keeps the popover a faithful, complete explanation of the row for users who cannot read the icons. After #18072 gave the active-work dot the running color, two distinct states share one color; the popover text is where they are told apart.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the two suites: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/sidebar/SessionDetailsTooltip.test.tsx client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.workspace-removal.test.tsx` — 218 tests pass. The tooltip suite adds a seven-row unread-precedence matrix (unread over running / active work / unknown; background over unread; unread + in-flight turn names the hidden background via the suffix; blocked over unread; plain unread) plus two override-suffix cells (label with / without background tasks). The sidebar suite adds four hover regressions for the voice starting cue (label appears, idle fallback after presence clears, approval/question precedence, and hidden background named while the row's background dot is absent).
2. Mutation witnesses, all killed on the merged main-based tree: voice cue — override removed (pre-fix) fails the starting test, gate removed fails the precedence tests; unread — old chain order fails four matrix rows, unguarded background arm fails the suffix row, missing suffix fails the suffix row, deleted unread arm fails five rows; F1 — reverting the override render line to `statusLabel ?? status` kills both positive suffix cells.
3. In a running Web Shell: hover a starting voice row → "Preparing voice chat…" next to the spinner; hover a completed-unread row that also has a prompt in flight → "Finished" (plus the background suffix when background tasks run), matching the unread dot; a session waiting for approval or a user question keeps that label.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Fixed code rendered in a real browser against a mock daemon advertising `live/status` state `starting` with a background task running: the row shows the starting spinner and hides the background dot, while the hover popover names both states ("Preparing voice chat… · Background tasks running").

![Hover details naming the voice starting cue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-hover-status/session-hover-status/hover-starting-after.png)

Completed-unread state rendered at the final head: the live-state poll transitions the session from running to idle, the row shows the unread dot, and the hover popover names it "Finished" instead of "Running". The transient unread-plus-running combination is pinned by the unit matrix.

![Hover details naming the completed-unread state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-hover-status/session-hover-status/hover-unread-precedence.png)

Current production daemon (pre-fix build), hovering the running session of this worktree: the popover's status line already carries the list's running state — the seam this PR extends to the starting and unread cues. The screenshots are not a before/after pair of the same state; they show the new cues and the existing status line on the live app. All fixed-code renders were captured at head `c062036e27` (fix branch merged with `origin/main` `68388f5d41` including #18072, plus the F1 suffix fix).

![Live daemon hover details showing the Running status line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-hover-status/session-hover-status/hover-running-status-live.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Vitest jsdom suites with real hover timers; Playwright chromium against a fresh vite dev server with the mock daemon for the screenshot; headless chromium probe of the local production daemon for the live-app screenshot.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the single status line must pick one state when several cues coexist; the chosen precedence now mirrors the row's dots exactly (blocked badge > starting spinner > background dot > unread dot > running dot > active-work dot), with the background suffix naming hidden background work.
- Not validated / out of scope: a real voice call startup against a live daemon (mock-driven render plus unit tests); macOS/Windows; the overview panel's status column is unchanged (it passes completedUnread=false and has no unread dot).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None.

## 本 PR 做了什么

会话 hover 详情弹窗现在忠实说出会话行展示的每一个状态提示，而不只是能从 session summary 派生的状态。两处对齐：(1) 实时语音会话启动期间，行把状态圆点换成 Spinner，弹窗现在显示同样的「Preparing voice chat…」标签，而非 idle/running；(2) completed-unread 分支移到行圆点的优先级——unread 圆点优先于 running 与 active-work 圆点，background 圆点优先于 unread——因此展示 unread 圆点的行不再在自己的弹窗里被描述为 running/active/unknown，被隐藏的后台任务由与 running 分支相同的后缀说出。语音启动 override 与 unread 分支都保持在待审批/需要用户输入这两个 actionable 状态之下，与行的 attention 徽章及弹窗已钉住的 blocked 优先级一致。override 标签自身也带后台后缀，因此带后台任务的启动中语音会话会同时说出两种状态，而不是丢掉被隐藏的那个（verify-pr F1）。

2. 变异见证，在合并 main 后的树上全部被杀：语音——移除 override（修复前）杀启动用例、移除门杀优先级用例；unread——旧链序杀四行、背景支去守卫杀后缀行、去后缀杀后缀行、整删 unread 支杀五行；F1——渲染行还原为 `statusLabel ?? status` 杀两正格后缀用例。

### 证据（前后对照）

修复后的代码在真实浏览器中对 mock daemon（live/status 为 starting 且带后台任务）渲染：行显示启动 Spinner 并隐藏后台圆点，hover 弹窗同时说出两种状态（「Preparing voice chat… · Background tasks running」）。

![hover 详情说出语音启动提示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-hover-status/session-hover-status/hover-starting-after.png)

在最终 head 渲染的 completed-unread 状态：live-state 轮询把会话从 running 转为 idle，行显示 unread 圆点，hover 弹窗说出「Finished」而非「Running」。unread+running 的瞬态组合由单元矩阵钉住。

当前生产 daemon（修复前构建），hover 本 worktree 的运行中会话：弹窗状态行已携带列表的运行状态——即本 PR 扩展到启动与 unread 提示的既有 seam。各图不是同一状态的前后对照：它们展示新提示与线上应用既有的状态行。所有修复代码渲染均摄于 head `c062036e27`（修复分支合并 `origin/main` `68388f5d41` 含 #18072，再加 F1 后缀修复）。
