prs.title: feat(core): add DeepInfra provider preset, service_tier support, and interactive model selection panel
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR introduces end-to-end support for DeepInfra as a built-in third-party provider preset, implements full `service_tier` routing support (enabling DeepInfra's 20% discounted Flex tier as well as OpenAI service tiers), and replaces manual model identifier typing in provider setup with a rich, interactive `ModelSelectionPanel` component.

Specifically, the implementation includes:
1. **DeepInfra Provider Preset (`packages/core/src/providers/presets/deepinfra.ts`)**: Registers DeepInfra (`AuthType.USE_OPENAI`, base URL `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai`, environment variable `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY`) with `modelsEditable: true`, dual-gate ownership checks, and attribution headers (`HTTP-Referer`, `X-Title`).
2. **End-to-End `service_tier` Support**: Adds `service_tier` ('flex' | 'priority' | string) across configuration layers (`ContentGeneratorConfig`, `ModelGenerationConfig`, `ProviderConfig`), CLI options (`--service-tier`), and resolves it through `modelConfigResolver`. Injects `service_tier` into outgoing HTTP payloads across both `openaiContentGenerator` (Chat Completions) and `openaiResponsesContentGenerator` (Responses pipeline).
3. **Daemon Model Metadata Proxy Route (`/workspace/auth/deepinfra-models`)**: Queries `https://api.deepinfra.com/models/list` with an in-memory cache (TTL: 1 hour) to retrieve ~170 live models. Parses model type, context window (`max_tokens`), quantization formats (`fp32`, `fp8`, `int4`, etc.), pricing (`cents_per_input_token` and `cents_per_output_token` normalized to `$/Mt`), and tier tags (`flex`, `priority`). 
4. **Interactive `ModelSelectionPanel` (`packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/ModelSelectionPanel.tsx`)**: An interactive catalog table featuring real-time name and task search, filter dropdowns for task type, dynamic quantizations, and context lengths up to 1024k, four subline toggle buttons with inline SVG icons (`✨ Featured`, `🏷️ Discount`, `⚡ Priority`, `⏱️ Flex`), and separate sortable columns for `In ($/Mt)` and `Out ($/Mt)` pricing. Checkboxes allow multi-selecting models with real-time synchronization to the comma-separated model IDs input, which remains editable for custom models.
5. **CLI & Desktop Auth Integration**: Adds DeepInfra to interactive `qwen auth` workflows and preserves `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` in daemon environment snapshots for workspace tasks.

## Why it's needed

DeepInfra provides serverless inference API (including Qwen, Deepseek, Nemotron, ...). Furthermore, its Flex service tier provides a 20% cost reduction (0.8× pricing) for throughput-oriented tasks. Previously, users had to set up DeepInfra as a generic custom provider and had no way to pass `service_tier: "flex"` to request bodies. In addition, configuring editable-model providers previously required users to manually research, remember, and type model IDs into a bare text input without knowing context windows, quantization variants, or input/output pricing.

### Why this change exceeds 2,000 lines and needs to land together

This PR exceeds 2,000 lines because it represents the complete, cohesive integration of a Tier 1 provider preset:
- Backend preset registration and security dual-gate ownership (`packages/core/src/providers/`).
- End-to-end `service_tier` typing, resolution, and wire serialization in both Chat Completions and Responses generator engines (`packages/core/src/core/`, `packages/core/src/models/`).
- Daemon proxy route with server-side caching, metadata mapping, and model filtering (`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/`).
- CLI commands, config schema, options, and daemon env snapshots (`packages/cli/src/`).
- Frontend interactive `ModelSelectionPanel` component, styles, and Web Shell auth integration (`packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/`).
- Full unit test coverage across all packages (preset tests, resolver tests, wire payload tests, daemon route tests, and React component tests) and documentation updates.

Splitting this PR into isolated fragments would leave the repository in incomplete intermediate states (e.g., a backend preset without frontend model selection, or a UI attempting to consume an unreleased daemon proxy route). Landing the entire feature together guarantees architectural consistency and a fully functional user experience.

### Tier 1 — Built-in Preset Criteria Disclosure

As required by `CONTRIBUTING.md` for Tier 1 provider presets:
- **Affiliation Disclosure**: The PR author is a regular paying customer of DeepInfra and has no commercial affiliation, employment, partnership, or financial interest in DeepInfra.
- **Operational Maturity**: DeepInfra operates publicly with high availability and transparent uptime tracking. Their public status page and incident history are accessible at https://status.deepinfra.com/.
- **Organic User Demand**: Requested by the author ("only me so far") to enable low-cost, high-throughput open model inference with Flex tier support in Qwen Code.
- **Data and Security Transparency**: DeepInfra publishes a documented Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policy confirming that prompt and completion data are not retained or used for training.
- **Maintenance Commitment**: No ongoing maintenance commitment is given by the PR author; maintenance is community-driven.

2. **Verify Daemon Proxy Endpoint**:

In Step 4 ("Model IDs") of provider setup, users were presented with only a plain text input with no guidance on available models, requiring them to leave the application, look up model identifiers manually, and guess their context windows, quantization variants, and token pricing.

prs.title: fix(permissions): keep UNC roots in Always Allow rules
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When you hit "Always Allow" on a folder under a UNC path (a network share like `\\server\share\proj` or a WSL folder like `\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\proj`), the saved rule now keeps the UNC root, so it actually matches files in that folder. UNC dirs get saved as `Read(///server/share/proj/**)`, which resolves back to `//server/share/proj/**`. Ordinary drive-letter and POSIX paths come out the same as before. Two intentional changes also reach them: a trailing separator is trimmed (`/tmp/data/` used to save `Read(//tmp/data//**)`, which matched nothing), and glob characters in a directory name are escaped so the rule only covers that directory.

## Why it's needed

Right now the rule gets saved as `Read(//server/share/proj/**)`, which resolves to `/server/share/proj/**`. Real file paths there look like `//server/share/proj/a.txt`, so the rule never matches and you get asked again every time. It's the UNC leftover from #17810 (drive letters were fixed there, #17812 lists UNC as out of scope). Triage on #18059 confirmed the root cause and the `///` approach.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run src/permissions` in `packages/core`. The new test builds a rule for a UNC dir (network share and WSL shapes), then checks files inside it match, files in a sibling folder don't, and the old `/server/share/...` form doesn't.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new round-trip test fails on main (`expected false to be true`). After: passes. All 1574 tests in `src/permissions` pass, prettier and eslint are clean. Non-UI change, so no screenshots.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests only on Linux, using Windows-style paths. I haven't tried it on a real Windows machine.

### Environment (optional)

N/A, unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: rule output is unchanged for ordinary paths without trailing or doubled separators or glob characters. Those now save a narrower rule (never a wider one), and the existing drive-letter and POSIX tests still pass. #17812 edits the same file, so whichever lands second may need a small rebase.
- Not validated / out of scope: real Windows / real network share.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Old broken UNC rules never matched anything, so people just approve once more. Old rules with unescaped glob characters stay as they are until replaced.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18059

---

## 中文说明

### 这个 PR 做了什么

在 UNC 路径（例如网络共享 `\\server\share\proj` 或 WSL 目录 `\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\proj`）下的文件夹点击 "Always Allow" 时，保存的规则现在会保留 UNC 根，所以能真正匹配该文件夹里的文件。UNC 目录会保存为 `Read(///server/share/proj/**)`，解析后回到 `//server/share/proj/**`。普通的盘符路径和 POSIX 路径生成的规则和之前一样。另外有两处有意的改动也会影响它们：末尾分隔符会被去掉（`/tmp/data/` 以前保存为匹配不到任何东西的 `Read(//tmp/data//**)`），目录名里的通配符会被转义，规则只覆盖该目录。

### 为什么需要

现在规则被保存成 `Read(//server/share/proj/**)`，解析成 `/server/share/proj/**`，而真实文件路径是 `//server/share/proj/a.txt`，所以永远匹配不上，每次都会重新询问。这是 #17810 遗留的 UNC 情况（#17810 修了盘符，#17812 把 UNC 列为不在范围内）。#18059 的 triage 已确认根因和 `///` 的方案。

### 如何验证

在 `packages/core` 运行 `npx vitest run src/permissions`。新测试为 UNC 目录（网络共享和 WSL 两种形式）生成规则，检查目录内文件能匹配、同级其他目录不匹配、旧的 `/server/share/...` 形式不匹配。修复前新测试失败，修复后通过；`src/permissions` 全部 1574 个测试通过，prettier 和 eslint 无问题。只在 Linux 上用 Windows 风格路径跑了单元测试，没有在真实 Windows 上测试。

### 风险与范围

对没有末尾或重复分隔符、也没有通配符的普通路径，规则输出不变；带这些字符的路径现在生成更窄（不会更宽）的规则。#17812 改的是同一个文件，后合并的一方可能需要小幅 rebase。没有破坏性变更：旧的错误规则本来就匹配不到任何东西，用户重新允许一次即可。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): compact automatic trigger messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Repetitive cron and self-paced `/loop` continuations now render as compact automatic-trigger cards instead of full-sized ordinary user bubbles. The card preserves the available display text through Show more/Collapse. Only four exact short runtime echoes omit the redundant disclosure; an unknown future label retains its full text. Structured per-run scheduled tasks, host content replacements/redaction, attachments, editing, and the existing outer timestamp retain their prior behavior. Replay normalization between `loop` and `cron` preserves an already-open detail; content, attachment, editing, or genuine variant changes still reset it.

HTML output now selects a document schema from the pinned renderer's declared ceiling. The current local renderer emits V2 with only `meta: { source: "cron" }` on the relevant user block; it never fabricates a scheduler time or copies surrounding metadata. Pre-V2 delegates default to compatible V1, and the lower-level rendering entry also refuses a document above the renderer's supported ceiling before emitting an unreadable file. Delegating V2 requires an explicit `QWEN_EXPORT_RENDERER_SCHEMA_MAX_VERSION=2` declaration with matching identity and SRI-pinned assets. V1 is unchanged; the static reader accepts valid V1 and V2 while rejecting unknown versions, V1-injected metadata, non-canonical sources, extra fields, and metadata on non-user blocks. With `origin/main` at `39f15664e3a449ba86b06bb1a71eb1f2ec07fcd9`, the resolved renderer-budget conflict retains the upstream ChatSurface rationale and remeasures the actual merged tree: **2,155,023 identity-injected JavaScript bytes and 2,428,500 CSS bytes**. The warning is the measured 2,155,023 bytes and the hard ceiling is warning + 430 = **2,155,453 bytes**, rather than choosing either branch's previous number or inheriting the old 713/1713-byte margins. Earlier 2,154,390/2,154,820 figures are retained below only as historical checkpoints.

## Why it's needed

Long wakeup prompts repeat hundreds of characters in ordinary bubbles and make system-generated turns appear manually entered. Compact cards make a conversation easier to scan without hiding the available instructions. The initial implementation worked in interactive Web Shell, but real daemon HTML export discarded the automatic source and turned the entry back into an ordinary bubble. Versioning the output envelope preserves that routing tag without widening the frozen V1 contract, but an older delegated renderer cannot necessarily read V2. The writer must select the schema it actually supports instead of assuming every published renderer can read it. Invalid user metadata in a static document must not be allowed to impersonate canonical automatic input.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Detailed automatic prompts require one disclosure action. HTML output follows the delegate's supported schema instead of always writing V2; this retains the canonical automatic-input tag without weakening V1's frozen field set, and valid older documents remain readable.
- Pool-sensitive verification: The 623-file Web Shell sweep had one history-order failure among 17,659 tests. The case passed alone, and its full provider file subsequently passed 545/545. That is recorded as pool-sensitive evidence rather than a claim that the wide run passed; no assertion was weakened.
- Not validated / out of scope: No local macOS, Windows, WebKit, or Firefox run; no full workspace test matrix; no new model calls or simulated scheduler clock. This does not group wakeups, reconstruct a stable loop-chain identity, infer scheduler fire time, or expose full `modelText` behind a short runtime echo. Scheduling, cancellation, persistence, and daemon lifecycle APIs are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: V2 readers retain V1 compatibility. Unknown versions and metadata fail closed. Markdown, JSON, and JSONL payloads are not widened to carry this export tag.

## 本次改动

重复出现的 cron 和自调节 `/loop` 延续输入现在以紧凑的自动触发卡片展示，而不是全尺寸普通用户气泡。卡片通过“显示更多/收起”保留可展示的原文。只有四种完全匹配的短运行时 echo 不提供冗余展开；未知的未来标签保留全文。结构化 per-run 定时任务、宿主内容替换/脱敏、附件、编辑和外层时间戳均保持原行为。回放中 loop 与 cron 的相互归一化保留已经展开的完整指令；只有真正的变体切换或内容、附件、编辑变化才收起旧详情。

HTML 输出根据所固定 renderer 声明的 schema 上限选择文档版本。当前本地 renderer 输出 V2，相关 user block 只允许 `meta: { source: "cron" }`，不伪造调度时间，也不携带周边元数据。pre-V2 委托默认输出兼容的 V1；较低层的 render 入口同样在输出不可读文件前拒绝超过 renderer 支持上限的 document。委托 V2 必须显式设置 `QWEN_EXPORT_RENDERER_SCHEMA_MAX_VERSION=2`，并固定匹配的身份和 SRI 资源。V1 保持不变；静态 reader 接受有效的 V1/V2，但拒绝未知版本、注入 V1 的 metadata、非规范来源、额外字段和非 user block 上的 metadata。合入 `39f15664e3` 后，解决预算冲突时保留上游 ChatSurface 原因说明，并对实际合并树重新测量：最终注入身份的 JavaScript 为 **2,155,023 字节**，分离的 CSS 为 **2,428,500 字节**。告警基线采用实测值，硬上限为 **2,155,453 字节**，只保留 430 字节工具链余量，不选择任一侧旧数值，也不沿用此前 713/1713 字节余量。较早的 2,154,390/2,154,820 字节仅属于此前检查点。

## 为什么需要

冗长的唤醒 prompt 以普通气泡反复显示数百个字符，还会让系统生成的轮次看起来像用户手工输入。紧凑卡片更便于浏览，同时不隐藏可展示的指令。初版实现在交互式 Web Shell 中有效，但真实 daemon HTML 导出丢失自动来源，使该输入重新变成普通气泡。对输出信封进行版本化可以保留路由标签，同时不放宽冻结的 V1 契约；但旧版委托 renderer 未必能读取 V2，writer 必须按其实际支持能力选择 schema，而不是假设所有已发布 renderer 都支持 V2。静态文档中的非法用户元数据也不能冒充规范的自动输入。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): pause task creation and show an overload strip in the sidebar
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Surfaces the daemon's load-admission pause in the Web Shell task sidebar, at the point of action it governs. While the daemon reports sustained overload, a thin warning strip appears above the "New task" button with the reason as a tooltip, and every creation entry point is disabled until the pause clears. The state comes from two sources combined with OR: a five-second poll of the cheap `GET /daemon/status` summary reading the new `runtime.loadAdmission` section, and a reactive `system_overloaded` refusal hint that expires after the daemon's fifteen-second `Retry-After`, so a poll gap cannot hide a fresh refusal and the UI never stays paused longer than advised without poll confirmation. The poll/expiry/OR logic lives in a small `useDaemonOverloadPause` hook; the App owns the refusal state fed by the existing notice effect and refuses creation with a warning toast at the root create handler, covering entry points outside the sidebar. The SDK's daemon status type gains the additive optional `loadAdmission` field, so older daemons and `--no-load-admission` daemons simply never pause the UI. Design: [English](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.zh-CN.md). Depends on the daemon-side gate in #18052 for live behavior; without it the client degrades to today's behavior plus the reactive strip.

## Why it's needed

#18052 refuses new sessions with `503 system_overloaded` while the host is saturated, but the Web Shell only showed that refusal as a toast after a click: the button kept looking actionable while every click was guaranteed to fail, and the state was invisible before the first failed click. Raw CPU/memory gauges already live in the Daemon Status dialog; what was missing is the actionable state where the gated operation lives. This slice turns the surprise 503 into a visible, explained pause and stops futile clicks.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/web-shell`, run `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts useDaemonOverloadPause overload-strip App.test continuation-badge RecentSessions.test` (the flag is the local workaround for Node 26's native webstorage placeholder shadowing jsdom localStorage; CI's Node is unaffected). Expect the hook matrix (poll overload pauses, normal poll and omitted field do not, unexpired refusal pauses despite a normal poll, expiry notifies and unpauses, poll-confirmed overload stays paused past expiry, five-second reload cadence only while enabled), the sidebar matrix (strip text/title/aria-label in en and zh-CN, disabled inert button while paused, no strip and working button otherwise), and no App regression. Live level: with a daemon carrying #18052, raise host load until the gate engages and confirm the strip, the disabled button with readings tooltip, and recovery clearing both; a `--no-load-admission` daemon never shows the strip.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: overload invisible until a failed create toast. After: a real-browser probe (Playwright + Chromium against a live daemon carrying both this slice and #18052, 72 nice-19 burners on a 32-core host) passes 12/12: normal state has no strip and an enabled button; under sustained load the strip appears, the button disables, and the tooltip shows interpolated real readings ("Host load ratio 2.19, event-loop p99 21 ms (cpu_load)…"); a first prompt typed while paused is refused up front with a warning toast and creates no session; after load decay the strip hides, the button re-enables, and the first prompt allocates a session (0 -> 1). Screenshots below, same viewport and empty-session state throughout.

![Web Shell sidebar in normal state: no strip, New session enabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-normal-no-strip.png)

![Web Shell sidebar under sustained host load: overload strip above New session and the button disabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-overloaded-strip-disabled.png)

![First prompt while paused: warning toast, no session created](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-paused-first-prompt-refused.png)

![After recovery: strip gone, first prompt allocates a session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-recovered-create-works.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local jsdom component suites on Node 26 with `--no-experimental-webstorage`; local full build excludes web-templates because its export-size gate overshoots by 10 bytes on this host even on pristine main (A/B verified identical measurements; main's CI at this base is green), so CI re-measures that gate on its own Node.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: one extra summary request per five seconds per open Web Shell; the summary is the cheap in-memory view the status dialog already polls. A proxy stripping the new status field degrades the client to reactive-only behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: a "view daemon status" affordance on the strip is deferred; macOS/Windows not run locally. The live probe ran on Linux against a locally merged gate+UI tree (the gate itself ships in #18052); the managed-mode exemption has no automated case yet.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; additive SDK field, optional sidebar props, two new i18n keys per locale.

## Linked Issues

Refs #18052

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 daemon 负荷准入的暂停状态 surfaced 到 Web Shell 任务侧栏——它所管辖的动作点上。daemon 报告持续过载期间，"新建任务"按钮上方出现薄警示条，原因以 tooltip 提供，所有新建入口禁用直至暂停清除。状态来自两个以 OR 组合的来源：每五秒轮询廉价 `GET /daemon/status` summary 读新增 `runtime.loadAdmission` 节；以及被动 `system_overloaded` 拒绝提示，按 daemon 的十五秒 `Retry-After` 过期——轮询间隙藏不住新拒绝，且没有轮询确认时 UI 不会暂停得比建议更久。轮询/过期/OR 逻辑在小 hook `useDaemonOverloadPause` 中；App 持有现有 notice effect 喂入的拒绝状态，并在根 create handler 以警告 toast 拒绝新建，覆盖侧栏之外的入口。SDK daemon status 类型新增加性可选 `loadAdmission` 字段，旧 daemon 与 `--no-load-admission` daemon 因此永不暂停 UI。设计：[English](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/daemon-overload-sidebar-indicator.zh-CN.md)。实机行为依赖 #18052 的 daemon 侧闸门；没有它客户端退化为今天的行为加被动警示条。

## 为什么需要

#18052 在主机饱和期间以 `503 system_overloaded` 拒绝新建会话，但 Web Shell 只在点击后以 toast 呈现该拒绝：按钮在每次点击都必然失败时仍看起来可操作，状态在第一次失败点击前不可见。原始 CPU/内存仪表已在 Daemon Status 对话框；缺的是被管辖操作所在处的可操作状态。本切片把意外 503 变成可见、有解释的暂停，并阻止无效点击。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/web-shell` 下跑 `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts useDaemonOverloadPause overload-strip App.test continuation-badge RecentSessions.test`（该 flag 是 Node 26 原生 webstorage 占位遮蔽 jsdom localStorage 的本机绕法；CI 的 Node 不受影响）。预期：hook 矩阵（轮询过载暂停、正常轮询与省略字段不暂停、未过期拒绝在正常轮询下仍暂停、过期通知并解除、轮询确认的过载过过期后仍暂停、仅 enabled 时五秒 reload 节奏）、侧栏矩阵（en 与 zh-CN 的条文案/title/aria-label、暂停时禁用且点击无效、否则无条且按钮可用）、App 无回归。实机级：对带 #18052 的 daemon 抬高主机负荷至闸门激活，确认警示条、带读数 tooltip 的禁用按钮、恢复后两者清除；`--no-load-admission` daemon 永不显示警示条。

### 证据（前后对照）

前：过载不可见，直到失败的新建 toast。后：实机浏览器探针（Playwright + Chromium，对同时带本切片与 #18052 的存活 daemon，32 核主机 72 个 nice-19 burner）12/12 过：正常态无警示条、按钮可用；持续负荷下警示条出现、按钮禁用、tooltip 显示插值后的真实读数（"Host load ratio 2.19, event-loop p99 21 ms (cpu_load)…"）；暂停态输入的首条 prompt 被前置拒绝并弹警告 toast、不创建会话；负荷衰减后警示条消失、按钮恢复、首条 prompt 建立会话（0 -> 1）。截图如下，全程同视口、同空会话状态。

![正常态 Web Shell 侧栏：无警示条，New session 可用](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-normal-no-strip.png)

![持续主机负荷下的 Web Shell 侧栏：New session 上方过载警示条、按钮禁用](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-overloaded-strip-disabled.png)

![暂停态首条 prompt：警告 toast、未创建会话](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-paused-first-prompt-refused.png)

![恢复后：警示条消失、首条 prompt 建立会话](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission-ui/sidebar-recovered-create-works.png)

### 测试平台

Linux ✅ 实测；macOS ⚠️ 未实测；Windows ⚠️ 未实测。

### 环境

Node 26 加 `--no-experimental-webstorage` 的本地 jsdom 组件套件；本地全量 build 排除 web-templates——其 export 体积门在本机即使纯 main 也超 10 字节（A/B 实测两臂同值；main 在本 base 的 CI 绿），由 CI 在其自身 Node 上重测该门。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：每个打开的 Web Shell 每五秒多一次 summary 请求；summary 是 status 对话框已在轮询的廉价内存视图。剥离新 status 字段的代理使客户端退化为仅被动行为。
- 未验证/范围外：条上"查看 daemon 状态"入口延期；macOS/Windows 未本地跑。实机探针在 Linux 上对局部合并 gate+UI 的树跑（闸门本身随 #18052 交付）；managed 豁免尚无自动化格。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无；加性 SDK 字段、可选侧栏 props、每语言两个新 i18n key。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #18052

</details>

## What this PR does

The English and Chinese design documents now record that the automatic-trigger message work was merged through #17970, with its actual merge commit and date. They distinguish the historical motivation from the current implemented state. The English description of the renderer-budget history also now includes attachment-reference validation, matching the Chinese version and the guarded renderer behavior.

## Why it's needed

Without a landing marker, the original problem statement could read as though the ordinary-bubble behavior were still current. English also omitted one of the checks represented in the historical renderer-size explanation while Chinese included it. This update preserves the original design motivation while making the shipped state and the field-boundary budget history clear and consistent in both languages.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Read the implementation-status sections in both languages. Confirm that they name #17970, the `2806006c8e` merge commit, and 2026-11-22, and that they explain that the following ordinary-bubble problem statement is historical.
2. Compare the budget-history paragraphs. Confirm that both languages include metadata boundaries, attachment-reference validation, and schema-version narrowing, while retaining the historical 2,154,390-byte measurement separately from the current 2,155,023-byte warning and 2,155,453-byte ceiling.
3. Follow the English/Chinese cross-links and the PR and merge-commit links. Both local reciprocal document links resolve, and the added references point to the actual merged PR and commit.

Checks actually performed: Prettier reported `All matched files use Prettier code style!` for both documents. A local reference check verified four `.md` links per document and the PR/commit provenance. For a normal installed checkout, the same format check can be reproduced with:

```bash
npx prettier --check docs/design/2026-11-20-web-shell-automatic-trigger-message.md docs/design/2026-11-20-web-shell-automatic-trigger-message.zh-CN.md
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this PR changes documentation only, not user-visible behavior.

The following previously captured screenshot documents the already-merged behavior from #17970; it is not a new screenshot or a claimed UI change from this documentation-only PR:

![Previously verified automatic-trigger card from the merged implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/automatic-trigger-message/automatic-trigger-message/native-detailed-collapsed.png)

|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested — Markdown formatting and reference checks |

### Environment (optional)

Linux with the repository-pinned Prettier package and a local reference check. This is a documentation-only branch; no production build or full product/browser test matrix is claimed for this change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: separating the design's historical motivation from implemented behavior without rewriting the accepted budget or schema contract.
- Not validated / out of scope: no production behavior, scheduler, cancellation, persistence, daemon lifecycle, or model input changes. No full production test matrix. Remaining test-harness robustness and offline legacy-renderer work stays separate from this documentation-only change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; this changes design documentation only.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/pr17970-closeout/docs/design/2026-11-20-web-shell-automatic-trigger-message.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/pr17970-closeout/docs/design/2026-11-20-web-shell-automatic-trigger-message.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

英中文设计文档现在都记录自动触发展示工作已通过 #17970 合入，并给出实际合并提交与日期。它们将历史动机与当前已实现状态区分开来。英文对 renderer 历史体积的说明也补上了附件引用校验，与中文版本及 renderer 中真实存在的校验保持一致。

### 前后证据

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：区分历史动机与已实现行为，不改写已接受的体积预算或 schema 契约。
- 未验证/范围外：不改变生产行为、调度、取消、持久化、daemon 生命周期或模型输入；未运行完整生产测试矩阵。其余测试 harness 健壮性与离线旧 renderer 的工作保持单独后续处理，不混入本纯文档变更。

为 #17970 的独立文档后续。#17267 跟踪不同的待唤醒状态可见性，与本改动无关，保持打开。

prs.title: fix(release): gate Teams publish on trusted-publishing bootstrap (#17936)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Teams channel adapter joined the set of packages the release publishes when it landed, but it joined it unconditionally. This puts its first publish behind the same one-time bootstrap switch the Mem0 extension already uses: the release keeps building, versioning and validating the package exactly as before, and simply leaves it out of the publish selection until a maintainer has performed the public bootstrap publish and bound the package to the release workflow. The switch is a repository variable, so enabling it later needs no code change, and it stays off for forks so a fork cannot publish the scoped package. The Teams design document now records the constraint and the maintainer action in both languages.

## Why it's needed

The v0.28.1 release failed in its publish job. Every validation job passed; the failure was in publishing itself. npm requires a package to already exist before trusted publishing can be configured for it, and the release publishes with provenance through trusted publishing rather than a long-lived token. The Teams adapter is a brand-new public package: no released tag contains the commit that introduced it, so v0.28.1 would have been its first ever publish, and an unbootstrapped package cannot be published that way. One unpublishable package fails the whole publish step, so the entire release was blocked by a package that was not ready to ship yet.

This is the same situation the Mem0 extension was in, and the repository already has an established, documented answer for it: keep the package behind a bootstrap variable until a maintainer completes the one-time public publish. The Teams adapter was added without that gate. Restoring the gate unblocks the release for every package that is ready, without weakening any existing check and without inventing a second version line for Teams.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The publish selection is observable without any credentials, because the release step prints the package names it will publish before it publishes them.

1. With the bootstrap switch unset, run the release's package selection and confirm `@qwen-code/channel-msteams` is absent while every other release package is still present. Before this change it was present, which is exactly the selection that failed.
2. Set the switch to `true` and confirm the Teams adapter comes back, so the gate is a rollout switch and not a removal.
3. Confirm the release still versions and builds the Teams adapter regardless of the switch — the gate affects only the publish selection, not the build, the version bump, or the already-shipped guard.
4. The regression coverage drives the real release step script with stubbed publish commands and asserts the exact filter list for both switch states. Both new assertions were confirmed to fail on the pre-change code: removing the selection gate makes the switched-off case fail, and removing the workflow wiring makes the wiring check fail.

A reviewer who wants to confirm the underlying npm constraint can check that no existing release tag contains the commit that added the Teams package, which is what makes v0.28.1 its first publish.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — release pipeline behavior, no user interface change.

Before, with the bootstrap switch off, the release publish step selected:

```
@qwen-code/channel-base … @qwen-code/channel-msteams … @qwen-code/web-shell
```

After, with the switch off, the same step selects the same list without `@qwen-code/channel-msteams`; with the switch on, the list is unchanged from before.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2 on Linux, full workspace build present. Verification used the repository's own build, typecheck, lint and Vitest suites plus the real release step script driven with stubbed `npm`/`corepack` binaries. No publish was attempted and no registry or GitHub credentials were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Teams adapter is not installable from npm until a maintainer performs the bootstrap publish and enables the repository variable. That is the intended, documented rollout state and matches how the Mem0 extension was introduced; the alternative is that no release can ship at all. Nothing else depends on the Teams package, so withholding it does not break any other published artifact.
- Not validated / out of scope: the actual bootstrap publish and the npm-side trusted-publishing binding are maintainer actions outside this repository and were not performed. The release workflow was not executed end to end, since that requires the release environment and credentials. Separately, while tracing the release commit I noticed that the version bump rewrites the Teams extension manifest but the release commit's staging list does not include channel extension manifests, so that manifest is left out of the release commit. That is a distinct defect from the publish failure and is deliberately not changed here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No published package's contents, name or version scheme changes; only which packages a release attempts to publish while the bootstrap switch is off.

Design document updated in both languages: [docs/design/teams-channel.md](docs/design/teams-channel.md) and [docs/design/teams-channel.zh-CN.md](docs/design/teams-channel.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17936

prs.title: test(web-shell): harden artifacts right-panel entry test coverage
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds three focused DOM tests and corrects a design-doc status line, with no production code change. It hardens the artifacts header entry introduced by #17689 (the entry that opens the session artifacts list as a right-panel tab): the persisted-tab serialize/parse round-trip, the close affordance for a restored zero-artifact artifacts tab, and the floating drawer's focus restore to the header entry.

## Why it's needed

#17689 merged at head `6fcccaefa4` before its round-5 review findings were addressed. Two non-blocking inline findings and the independent verification report left concrete coverage gaps. A serialize arm that dropped a tab's `id`/`title` would keep the existing kind-only assertion green while the tab silently vanished on every reload, against the design's "a persisted artifacts tab restores across reload". The `artifactsTabActive` join that keeps a close affordance for a restored zero-artifact tab had no App-layer witness, so mutating it to `false` or a wrong id prefix shipped green. And deleting `rememberArtifactPanelTrigger()` — the call that lets the floating drawer return focus to the header entry on close — left every committed suite green while focus dropped to `BODY` (the verification's surviving mutant M1, an accessibility regression). This PR pins each of those behaviors with a test that a single-point mutant reddens, and aligns the design-doc status line with the verification actually completed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/web-shell`, run the focused suites: `npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t artifact` (70 passed), the four component suites `ChatContextHeader` / `ArtifactPanel` / `ArtifactsListPanel` / `EnvironmentPanel` (257 passed), and `client/build-artifact.test.ts` (43 passed against a freshly built dist). `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`, ESLint on the changed test file, and Prettier on all three changed files are clean. Each new assertion is load-bearing — the mutation witnesses below were run on this branch's base, whose `App.tsx` is byte-identical to the merged `6fcccaefa4`, and each production edit was restored byte-identical afterward:

| Mutant (single production edit) | Pinning test | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| serialize artifacts arm drops `id`/`title` | custom chat header round-trip | KILLED — `expected undefined to be 'artifacts:session-1'` |
| `artifactsTabActive = false` | restored zero-artifact close affordance | KILLED — `expected null not to be null` |
| delete `rememberArtifactPanelTrigger()` in the list-panel opener | drawer focus restore | KILLED — `expected <body> to be <button>` |

### Evidence (Before & After)

Tests and a documentation status line only (no user-visible production change). The drawer focus restore was additionally re-confirmed in headless Chromium against the live daemon at a narrow viewport (800×900), where the panel floats as a drawer: open from the focused header entry, close with the drawer's own toggle, and read `document.activeElement`. Probe result:

```json
{
  "entryLabel": "Artifacts (4)",
  "pressedBefore": "false",
  "drawerListRows": 4,
  "pressedOpen": "true",
  "drawerGone": true,
  "focusAfterClose": { "tag": "BUTTON", "isArtifactsEntry": true, "label": "Artifacts (4)" }
}
```

Focus returns to the artifacts entry (`isArtifactsEntry: true`), not `BODY`; the list row count matches the badge (4 == 4). The drawer open state:

![Artifacts drawer open at narrow viewport](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr17689-artifacts-entry/pr17689/follow-up/drawer-open.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Vite dev server proxied to the local `qwen serve` daemon (`127.0.0.1:4170`); headless Chromium (playwright-core) for the focus probe; vitest/jsdom for the DOM tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none — tests and a documentation status line only; no production code change.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows lanes; the full web-shell suite (focused subsets were run).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design document updated in both locales (status line only): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-18-artifacts-entry-opens-right-panel.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-18-artifacts-entry-opens-right-panel.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17689, addressing its round-5 review findings (serialize round-trip pin, zero-artifact App-layer witness, drawer focus-restore coverage, and the design-doc status drift).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增三个聚焦 DOM 测试并修正一处设计文档状态行，不改任何生产代码。它加固 #17689 引入的产物头部入口（该入口把会话产物列表作为右侧面板 tab 打开）：持久化 tab 的 serialize/parse 回环、恢复出的零产物产物 tab 的关闭入口、以及浮动抽屉关闭时焦点回到头部入口。

## 为什么需要

#17689 在 head `6fcccaefa4` 合入时，其第 5 轮评审发现尚未处理。两条 non-blocking 行内意见与独立验证报告留下了具体覆盖缺口：serialize 分支若丢掉 tab 的 `id`/`title`，既有的「仅判 kind」断言仍会绿，而 tab 会在每次刷新时静默消失，违背设计中「持久化的产物 tab 跨刷新恢复」；为恢复出的零产物 tab 保留关闭入口的 `artifactsTabActive` 连接没有 App 层见证，把它变异成 `false` 或错误 id 前缀都能绿着上线；删除 `rememberArtifactPanelTrigger()`（让浮动抽屉关闭时把焦点还回头部入口的调用）后所有已提交套件仍绿，而焦点落到 `BODY`（验证中存活的变异 M1，属无障碍回归）。本 PR 用「单点变异即转红」的测试钉住上述每一处行为，并把设计文档状态行与实际已完成的验证对齐。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/web-shell` 下跑聚焦套件：`npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t artifact`（70 过）、四个组件套件 `ChatContextHeader` / `ArtifactPanel` / `ArtifactsListPanel` / `EnvironmentPanel`（257 过）、`client/build-artifact.test.ts`（对新构建 dist 43 过）。`tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`、改动测试文件的 ESLint、三个改动文件的 Prettier 均净。每条新断言都承重——下列变异见证在本分支基线上跑（其 `App.tsx` 与已合并的 `6fcccaefa4` 字节一致），每次生产编辑后都字节级还原：

| 变异（单点生产编辑） | 钉住用例 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| serialize 产物分支丢 `id`/`title` | 自定义头部回环 | 被杀 — `expected undefined to be 'artifacts:session-1'` |
| `artifactsTabActive = false` | 恢复零产物关闭入口 | 被杀 — `expected null not to be null` |
| 删列表面板 opener 里的 `rememberArtifactPanelTrigger()` | 抽屉焦点恢复 | 被杀 — `expected <body> to be <button>` |

### 证据（前后对比）

仅测试与文档状态行（无用户可见生产改动）。抽屉焦点恢复另在窄视口（800×900，面板浮动为抽屉）下用无头 Chromium 对真实 daemon 复确认：从聚焦的头部入口打开、用抽屉自身 toggle 关闭、读 `document.activeElement`。探针结果见上方 JSON：焦点回到产物入口（`isArtifactsEntry: true`）而非 `BODY`，列表行数与徽章一致（4 == 4）。抽屉打开态截图见上图。

### 测试平台

macOS ⚠️ 未测、Windows ⚠️ 未测、Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境

Vite dev server 代理到本机 `qwen serve` daemon（`127.0.0.1:4170`）；焦点探针用无头 Chromium（playwright-core）；DOM 测试用 vitest/jsdom。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：无——仅测试与文档状态行，不改生产代码。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS 与 Windows 车道；web-shell 全量套件（跑了聚焦子集）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

设计文档双语更新（仅状态行）：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-18-artifacts-entry-opens-right-panel.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-18-artifacts-entry-opens-right-panel.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

#17689 的跟进，处理其第 5 轮评审发现（serialize 回环钉、零产物 App 层见证、抽屉焦点恢复覆盖、设计文档状态漂移）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): close over the resources a config_install record names
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `managed-config_install` to the two lists in `http-managed-session-store.ts` that decide what a commit closes over: the `collectNestedResourceRefs` walk branch and `isReferenceContainer`. The walker ships the record's own six edges (`bundleRef`, `rootSnapshotRef`, `previousBundleRef`, `restoresBundleRef`, `stageAckRefs`, and `enableAckRefs`) while excluding `previousRecordRef`, so every new revision does not re-close the entire configuration-history chain.

The same round also preserves sessions that already contain pre-fix records:

- `LEGACY_EXTENSION_CLOSURE_KINDS` now covers the four child kinds a pre-fix `config_install` record can name (`managed-extension-config-bundle`, `managed-extension-root`, `managed-extension-stage-ack`, and `managed-extension-enable-ack`), so the snapshot, native-page, and commit walks degrade an absent child instead of failing closed. A directly declared missing ref remains fatal.
- The snapshot ordering check tolerates one of those transitive children when it was first committed by a later transaction; it still calls `requireSameRef`, so a present-but-conflicting child remains fatal.
- A malformed `managed-config_install` body now produces the labelled `ManagedSessionRecordError` (`config install record must be an object.`) instead of a raw `TypeError`.

Final diff: 2 files, +358/−3; 36 changed production lines and 325 added test lines.

## Why it's needed

Three lists are meant to agree about this kind, and before this PR two did while the one that actually walks did not:

| List | Location | Has the kind? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` — declares its six edges | `managed-session-resource-references.ts:99` | yes |
| `RESTORE_CONTAINER_KINDS` — cold-load descent queue | `hosted-harness-session.ts:482` | yes |
| `collectNestedResourceRefs` + `isReferenceContainer` | `http-managed-session-store.ts` | **no** |

`collectNestedResourceRefs` is a standalone implementation — it neither reads `RESOURCE_REF_PATHS` nor delegates to `managedSessionNestedResourceRefs` — so its chain of kind branches fell through to `return []` for this kind. Both arms of `commitResources` call it, so the record shipped alone and a reopened reader could not reach the bundle, root snapshot, or acknowledgements it names.

Two consumers walk exactly that chain: `hosted-mcp-settings.ts` follows `previousRecordRef`, and `ManagedSessionResourcesService.java` resolves the effective package selection along the same chain. Excluding `previousRecordRef` from the new closure keeps each predecessor owned by its original transaction and avoids linear closure growth.

## Reviewer Test Plan

<!-- pr-evidence -->
| Check | Command / probe | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Focused unit suite | `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts` | ✅ 246 passed |
| Formatting | `corepack pnpm exec prettier --check packages/core/src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.ts packages/core/src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts` | ✅ all matched files clean |
| PR ESLint slice | `LINT_BASE_SHA=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) node scripts/lint.js --eslint` | ✅ 2 selected files clean |
| Legacy-tolerance mutation | Temporarily remove the four config child kinds from `LEGACY_EXTENSION_CLOSURE_KINDS`, then run the new pre-fix snapshot test | ✅ RED: `snapshot resource is missing.` |
| Persisted-arm mutation | Temporarily remove `managed-config_install` from `isReferenceContainer`, then run the new commit-closure test | ✅ RED: census contains only the record |
| Malformed-body mutation | Temporarily replace the `asRecord` guard with the previous bare cast, then run the malformed-record test | ✅ RED: raw `TypeError` |

How to verify:

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts`.
2. Revert the new `ref.kind === 'managed-config_install'` walker condition: the direct six-edge case fails.
3. Delete the `managed-config_install` entry from `isReferenceContainer`: the `commitResources` persisted-arm census loses the bundle/root/ack children and fails.
4. Remove the four config child kinds from `LEGACY_EXTENSION_CLOSURE_KINDS`: the pre-fix snapshot/native regression case fails on the absent child.
5. Replace the `asRecord` guard with the previous bare cast: the malformed-body case fails with a raw `TypeError`.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
| 🐧 Linux | CI |

Non-UI change.

## Risk & Scope

- The new closure intentionally carries more resources for new `config_install` commits. `maxResourcesPerTransaction` still bounds each transaction, and excluding `previousRecordRef` prevents history-length growth.
- Pre-fix records may name children that were never uploaded or were first committed later. Those transitive legacy edges degrade; direct missing refs, present-but-conflicting refs, and malformed record bodies still fail closed.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real-deployment cold-reopen run. The cold-load `verifyRef` gap in `hosted-harness-session.ts` remains a separate follow-up, as previously scoped.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing pre-fix snapshots remain readable; new commits ship the declared child resources.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17467

---

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 `managed-config_install` 加进 `http-managed-session-store.ts` 中决定提交闭包的两处清单：`collectNestedResourceRefs` 的遍历分支和 `isReferenceContainer`。遍历会携带记录自身声明的六条边（`bundleRef`、`rootSnapshotRef`、`previousBundleRef`、`restoresBundleRef`、`stageAckRefs`、`enableAckRefs`），但排除 `previousRecordRef`，避免每个新 revision 都重新闭合整条配置历史链。

同时保留修复前已存在记录的兼容性：

- `LEGACY_EXTENSION_CLOSURE_KINDS` 覆盖旧 `config_install` 可能指名的四类子资源；快照、native-page 与提交遍历对缺失的这类传递引用降级，不再让整个快照 fail-closed。直接声明的缺失引用仍然失败。
- 如果这类子资源由更晚的事务首次提交，快照的排序检查会忽略旧记录上的过期边；仍会执行 `requireSameRef`，所以「存在但冲突」仍然失败。
- 损坏的 `managed-config_install` body 现在抛出带标签的 `ManagedSessionRecordError`，不再是裸 `TypeError`。

## 验证

- `packages/core` 定向测试文件：246 通过。
- Prettier 与增量 ESLint：通过。
- 三个变异检查均按预期变红：移除 legacy 容忍、删除 `isReferenceContainer` 条目、恢复裸 `as` 解构。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): accept follow-up suggestions on touch composers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a touch acceptance path for follow-up suggestions in the Web Shell composer. On phones and tablets the composer is the plain-textarea backend, where a suggestion previously appeared only as dimmed placeholder text: tapping Send with an empty input submitted it directly, and typing a prefix then sending completed it, but nothing let the user put the suggestion into the input and edit it before sending, the way desktop Tab, Enter and Right Arrow do. This change adds a single touch accept surface: a chip-styled tappable bar above the input row in every composer variant, whose label is the suggestion text itself with an insert icon, plus a dismiss button; the editing row carries no follow-up key. Tapping the chip fills the textarea: the composer's outer click handler focuses it synchronously inside the tap gesture, then the host's accept defers the insert by a microtask and re-requests focus, so on real iOS the deferred focus request may land outside the tap gesture and the soft keyboard may not open (real-iOS keyboard behavior remains unverified). The user is free to edit before sending; the dismiss button stops click propagation so dismissing never pulls focus into the input, and keeps the existing ignored-outcome telemetry. The chip hides as soon as the user types. While the chip is visible the input keeps its ordinary placeholder, so the suggestion text appears on exactly one surface instead of being duplicated between bar and placeholder; the full-screen expanded editor is the one exception — with the dialog open and an empty draft, its textarea carries the suggestion as placeholder and aria-label so the suggestion never disappears from every surface. The two existing fast paths remain for ordinary-text suggestions: Send with an empty input still submits the visible suggestion, and a typed prefix still completes on send. A model-completed slash command instead first fills an editable draft without calling onSubmit and is submitted only by a second deliberate Send; replacing a prefix with that completion avoids appending the two strings. An exactly user-typed command and the desktop CodeMirror path remain unchanged. The default touch layout's editing row also gains four always-live keys on its trailing side: up/down move the caret between the displayed lines (soft-wrapped visual lines measured only around the caret with one cached mirror per textarea, removed on replacement and discarded on clear/unmount — no full-draft re-measurement and no hidden-node accumulation on long drafts, horizontal moves skip measurement entirely; grapheme-safe steps and clamps including the whole final grapheme of a wrapped line and zero-length empty next lines; preferred column held only across a vertical run and the landed displayed line anchoring the next press, so repeated Up crosses a wrap boundary like native; long drafts scrolled to keep the caret visible), right moves one grapheme or accepts the visible suggestion only when there is still text to add (desktop Right Arrow parity; an exact-match draft just moves the caret), and slash inserts a literal slash; they pause during IME composition. The optional keyboard-dismissal button immediately precedes the final Expand button. Their right-aligned group can wrap when space is limited. Workspace and branch labels collapse to icons when the composer container is at most 320px wide, without removing the selection controls. User documentation gains a touch-devices section, and a bilingual design doc records the decision and its history.

## Why it's needed

Follow-up suggestions predict the next prompt after a clean turn, and on desktop accepting one is a fill-don't-submit gesture so a suggested slash command never auto-executes. Touch users had no equivalent: they could only send the prediction blind or retype it by hand, which defeats the purpose of showing it. The mobile composer once carried simulated Tab/Esc/arrow keys, removed because Tab did nothing on the textarea backend, and later lost its up/down history stepping because the history search panel is the better touch recall path. Now that suggestions give acceptance a real job on touch, the chip offers the same fill-don't-submit gesture without reviving a dead key or naming hardware: it renders only while a suggestion is visible, and the old "no simulated keyboard keys without a suggestion" acceptance still holds. Earlier revisions paired the bar with an editing-row key (first labelled Tab, then the action word Fill in); review showed a detached verb label still costs comprehension, so the final design keeps only the content-labelled chip. History stepping is deliberately not revived, since a plain textarea restore cannot rebuild inline tag chips.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the Web Shell on a touch device, or emulate one (Playwright's Pixel 7 / iPhone profiles, or DevTools device mode; `?composer=textarea` forces the backend on desktop). Let a turn finish cleanly so the daemon pushes a suggestion, or drive the mock daemon as the new E2E spec does. With an empty input, confirm the suggestion appears as a tappable bar above the input while the input keeps its ordinary placeholder; the editing row shows no follow-up key in either variant. Tap the chip: the text lands in the input, the keyboard opens, nothing is submitted, and both touch points disappear; edit the text and send it yourself. Tap the bar's dismiss button instead: the suggestion bar disappears and Send becomes disabled. For an ordinary-text suggestion, tap Send with an empty input or a typed prefix and the completed text is submitted. For a model-completed slash command, first Send fills the editable draft without submitting; confirm `/cl` becomes exactly `/clear`, then tap Send again to submit once. A command you fully typed yourself still submits with one Send. Type anything else: the bar hides and Send submits exactly what was typed. With a multi-line draft, tap up/down/right and confirm the caret moves between the lines you see (column kept across short lines, clamped at document edges, long drafts scrolled into view); type 150 unbroken characters and confirm up/down land on the same carets as the native arrow keys; with an emoji draft confirm right steps over the whole emoji, up to a wrapped line end keeps it whole, and slash never splits it; tap down onto an empty next line and keep moving; tap up repeatedly across a wrap boundary and confirm it matches native arrows; tap right then down and confirm the column follows the new caret; type and tap right ten times and confirm no hidden measurement nodes accumulate; with a 50k draft confirm the keys answer instantly; with a visible suggestion tap right and confirm it fills without submitting, while a draft already equal to the suggestion just moves the caret; tap slash and confirm a literal '/' lands; open the expanded editor with an empty draft and confirm the suggestion is its placeholder; dismiss from an unfocused composer and confirm the keyboard control never appears. Automated coverage: `cd packages/web-shell && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=<free port> npx playwright test --project=mobile-chromium web-shell.followup.mobile.spec.ts` (thirty-one cases, all of the above plus empty-next and wrap-anchor moves, mirror lifecycle, 18px icon geometry, key-latency on a 50k draft, IME composition via CDP and the zh-CN UI; 29 tagged @smoke so they run in the PR-gating smoke job on both engines) and `npx vitest run client/utils/touchCaret.test.ts client/App.css.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.mobile.dom.test.tsx client/hooks/useComposerCore.dom.test.tsx client/components/ChatEditor.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts` (unit tests pin visibility across draft/hidden/desktop/disabled/simple-variant states, the accept/dismiss and editing-key wiring, composition and selection-reset wiring, the dynamic right-key label, the exact-match accept gate, the held column and its user-jump reset and horizontal-move recompute, scroll reveal, and the grapheme/visual-line caret math including selection-head and wrap-end edges; accept never submits).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: on the touch backend the suggestion existed only as placeholder text; there was no bar, no fill key and no dismiss control in the DOM (structural absence on main, verified by reading the touch branch and by the pre-change E2E baseline where the only acceptance was Send-with-empty-input). After, captured under Pixel 7 touch emulation with the mock daemon pushing `run the tests`:

Simple variant — chip bar with dismiss above the input row, the input keeping its ordinary placeholder (single surface), Send enabled:

![Simple variant suggestion bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-v4.png)

Default variant — the chip bar above the input with the ordinary placeholder, and an editing row whose trailing keys are caret/slash keys only (no follow-up-specific key); both default-variant shots share one unfocused state, so the conditional hide-keyboard control is absent:

![Default variant chip bar and caret keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-v9.png)

Simplified Chinese UI (`zh-CN`, suggestion 运行测试) — the chip bar with the localized dismiss label in both variants; the editing row carries no follow-up key and the input keeps its ordinary Chinese placeholder:

![Simplified Chinese simple variant bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-zh-v7.png)

![Simplified Chinese default variant chip bar and caret keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-zh-v9.png)

### Current touch-control layout

At `43c5812034a81934283540a57a9c746768f76edf`, Expand is the final control in the default touch editing row, with the optional keyboard-dismissal button immediately to its left. This layout-only follow-up does not change the command-authorization path. It wraps the editing controls internally when they cannot fit, preserving 44px targets rather than pushing them outside the viewport. At a composer container width of 320px or less, workspace and branch labels hide without removing their operable icons; the full workspace menu remains available. The following are actual Chromium-rendered UI captures with mock-daemon fixtures, not claims of model-generated suggestions or physical mobile-WebKit execution.

![Focused touch controls end with keyboard dismissal and Expand](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/editing-tail-focused-390px-v9.png)

![At 240px the editing controls wrap without separating keyboard dismissal and Expand](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/editing-tail-focused-240px-v9.png)

![At 240px long workspace and branch labels are hidden while icon selection remains available](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/mobile-compact-context-240-v9.png)

### Earlier real-environment evidence (before the layout follow-up)

The real-session images below remain evidence from earlier heads, not screenshots of the current control order. This layout follow-up does not rerun those model sessions; its own scope is validated by browser and component tests.

At head `724cdbc6a0`, an actual daemon/model session and a real Web Shell page under Pixel 7 emulation completed **62/62 custom checks**. Session `e6bec1a4-36a2-4b54-abb2-58e7195ae7c2` ended idle, with an empty prompt queue and no pending user question or permission request. Its suggestion came from the daemon rather than from the probe; these are actual-session captures, distinct from the mock-daemon fixtures above. The chip remains the only suggestion surface while the textarea keeps its ordinary placeholder.

![Actual daemon/model follow-up chip and caret keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-chip-keys-v7.png)

The same session at 240px, with the editing keys taking their own row:

![Actual mobile editing layout at 240px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-240px-v7.png)

At the earlier command-authorization head `7c56a7eb955f1d3b209d9e8987a1061dc52d8449`, a separate focused **8/8** real daemon + model + browser run, session `191b3e43-f572-4cf0-9355-c75eda0c0695`, obtained a daemon-generated `/help` chip. First Send filled the editable draft without opening Help or creating an ordinary prompt request; the second deliberate Send opened the actual Help dialog. No suggestion was injected and the device was Pixel 7 Chromium emulation, not an iPhone or mobile-WebKit.

![First real command Send fills the draft without executing Help](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-command-review-v8.png)

![Second deliberate Send opens real Help](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-command-executed-v8.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux verification uses Chromium touch emulation (mobile-chromium project); the mobile-webkit project and real iOS/Android devices were not exercised on this host (missing WebKit runtime libraries), so soft-keyboard-open height pressure from the responsive editing and context rows remains unmeasured on real hardware.

### Environment (optional)

Playwright-managed Vite dev server (`npm run dev`, source aliases for the SDK and daemon-react-sdk), Pixel 7 device emulation, mock daemon per page; jsdom unit tests run with `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` on Node 26 to avoid the host's native localStorage placeholder shadowing jsdom.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: while a suggestion is visible the bar adds one 44px row above the input; with a soft keyboard open on a short viewport this competes with the attachments strip for room. Idle layout is unchanged because the bar only renders with a visible suggestion and an empty draft.
- Not validated / out of scope: real iOS/WebKit keyboard behavior, iPad hardware-keyboard Tab/Right acceptance (deferred follow-up), and soft-keyboard-open layout measurement; history stepping stays removed by design.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public API or daemon contract changes; six new i18n keys per catalog (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian).

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

No tracking issue; the feature was requested directly in review of the touch composer's follow-up gap.

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 Web Shell 输入框的 follow-up suggestion 增加触摸接受路径。手机与平板上输入框是原生 textarea 后端,建议此前只以弱化 placeholder 灰字出现:空输入点发送会整条直发,输入前缀再发送会补全直发,但用户无法像桌面 Tab / Enter / → 那样把建议填进输入框先编辑再发送。本变更新增单一触摸接受面:覆盖所有 composer 变体的、输入行上方的 chip 样式可点按建议条,标签即建议文本本身并带插入图标,旁带忽略按钮;编辑行不带 follow-up 键。点按 chip 会填入 textarea:composer 外层点击处理先在手势内同步聚焦,宿主 accept 再经 microtask 延迟插入并再次请求 focus,故真 iOS 上延迟的 focus 请求可能落在 tap 手势之外、软键盘可能不弹(真 iOS 键盘行为仍未验证)。用户可编辑后再自行发送;忽略按钮阻止点击冒泡,忽略不会把焦点拉进输入框,并保留既有 ignored 遥测。chip 在用户开始打字后即隐藏。建议条可见时输入框保持普通占位符,建议文字只出现在一个 surface 上,不在建议条与 placeholder 之间重复;全屏展开编辑器是唯一例外——对话框打开且草稿为空时,由其 textarea 的 placeholder 与 aria-label 承载建议,保证建议不会在所有 surface 上消失。两条既有快路径仍适用于普通文本:空输入点发送仍整条直发,已输入普通前缀仍在发送时补全。模型补全的斜杠命令首次 Send 只填入可编辑草稿,不调用 onSubmit,用户检查或编辑后第二次明确 Send 才提交;前缀会被整条替换而非拼接。完整手输命令和桌面 CodeMirror 路径不变。default 触摸布局的编辑行尾侧另加四个始终有活功能的键:上/下在屏幕显示的行之间移动光标(软折行只在光标邻域用缓存镜像测量,长草稿不重测全篇,水平移动完全不测量;步进与钳制都字素安全,含折行行尾完整字素;仅连续垂直移动保持目标列,长草稿滚动保持光标可见),右移一个字素或仅在确有剩余时接受可见建议(对齐桌面 Right Arrow;完全匹配的草稿只移动光标),斜杠插字面 '/';IME 组合期间让路。可选收起键盘紧邻放大放在键组末尾,键组始终靠右并可在组内换行。composer 容器不超过 320px 时,工作区与分支的长文字收起为图标但保留选择入口。用户文档新增触摸设备一节,双语设计文档记录决策与历史。

## 为什么需要

follow-up suggestion 在干净回合结束后预测下一条 prompt,桌面接受语义是「填入但不发送」,因此建议的斜杠命令绝不会自动执行。触摸用户此前没有对等能力:只能盲发预测或手动重打,违背了展示建议的初衷。移动输入框曾带模拟 Tab/Esc/方向键,因 Tab 在 textarea 后端上是死键而被移除;后来又移除 ↑/↓ 历史步进,因为历史搜索面板是更好的触摸召回路径。如今建议让接受在触摸端第一次有了真实功能,chip 在不复活死键、不命名硬件的前提下提供同样的「填入不发送」手势:它仅在有建议时渲染,「无建议时不出现模拟键盘键」的旧验收仍然成立。早先版本曾配编辑行键(先标 Tab、后标动作词 Fill in);评审表明脱离内容的动词标签仍有理解成本,终版只保留以内容为标签的 chip。历史步进刻意不复活,因为 plain textarea 恢复无法重建 inline tag chips。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在触摸设备打开 Web Shell,或模拟触摸(Playwright Pixel 7 / iPhone profile、DevTools 设备模式;桌面可用 `?composer=textarea` 强制该后端)。让一个回合干净结束使 daemon 推送建议,或像新增 E2E spec 那样驱动 mock daemon。空输入时确认建议以输入行上方的可点按建议条出现、输入框保持普通占位符;两个变体的编辑行都不带 follow-up 键。点按 chip:文本进入输入框、键盘弹起、不提交、两个触点消失;编辑后自行发送。改点建议条的忽略按钮:建议条消失、发送键禁用。普通文本建议在空输入或已有前缀时点 Send 会提交补全文本。模型补全的斜杠命令首次 Send 只填入可编辑草稿,不提交;确认 `/cl` 精确变为 `/clear`,再次明确点 Send 才提交一次。用户完整手输的命令仍一次 Send 提交。输入其它内容:建议条隐藏,发送提交所输文本。多行草稿下点上/下/右确认光标在屏幕显示的行之间移动(短行保持列、文档边缘钳制、长草稿滚入视野);输入 150 个连续字符确认上/下与原生方向键落在同一光标;emoji 草稿确认右移跨过整个 emoji、上移到折行行尾保持完整、斜杠不拆字;下键落到空行并继续;连按上键越过折行边界与原生一致;先右再下确认列跟随新光标;输入并点右键十次确认无隐藏测量节点累积;50k 草稿确认按键即时响应;有可见建议时点右确认填入不提交,草稿已等于建议时只移动光标;点斜杠确认落入字面 '/';空草稿打开展开编辑器确认建议在其 placeholder 上;未聚焦时点忽略确认键盘控件不出现。自动化覆盖:`cd packages/web-shell && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=<空闲端口> npx playwright test --project=mobile-chromium web-shell.followup.mobile.spec.ts`(31 条用例覆盖以上全部,另含空行与折行锚点、镜像生命周期、18px 图标几何、50k 按键耗时、CDP IME 组合与 zh-CN UI;29 条带 @smoke,PR 门控 smoke 车道双引擎运行),以及 `npx vitest run client/utils/touchCaret.test.ts client/App.css.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.test.ts client/hooks/useComposerCore.mobile.dom.test.tsx client/hooks/useComposerCore.dom.test.tsx client/components/ChatEditor.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts`(单测钉住有草稿/无可见建议/桌面后端/disabled/simple 变体下的可见性、accept/dismiss 与编辑键接线、composition 与选区重置接线、右键动态标签、完全匹配接受门、列保持与用户跳选区重置及水平后重算、滚动揭示、字素/视觉行光标计算含选区 head 与折行行尾边缘;accept 绝不提交)。

### 证据(改前与改后)

改前:触摸后端上建议仅以 placeholder 文本存在,DOM 中没有建议条、填入键或忽略控件(main 上的结构性缺失,经阅读触摸分支与改动前 E2E 基线确认,当时唯一接受方式是空输入点发送)。改后截图取 Pixel 7 触摸模拟、mock daemon 推送 `run the tests`:

simple 变体——输入行上方带忽略按钮的 chip 建议条,输入框保持普通占位符(单 surface),发送键可用:

![simple 变体建议条](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-v4.png)

default 变体——输入行上方 chip 建议条与输入框普通占位符,编辑行尾侧仅光标/斜杠键(无 follow-up 专用键);两张 default 变体图统一为未聚焦态,条件渲染的收起键盘键缺席:

![default 变体 chip 建议条与光标键](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-v9.png)

简体中文 UI(`zh-CN`,建议「运行测试」)——两变体 chip 建议条带本地化忽略标签;编辑行不带 follow-up 键,输入框均保持普通中文占位符:

![简中 simple 变体建议条](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-bar-simple-zh-v7.png)

![简中 default 变体 chip 建议条与光标键](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/followup-keys-row-zh-v9.png)

### 当前触摸控件布局

当前 `43c5812034a81934283540a57a9c746768f76edf` 的 default 触摸编辑行中,放大是最后一个控件,可选收起键盘紧邻其左侧。这次仅调整布局与文字显示，不改变命令授权路径；宽度不足时控件组在内部换行，保持 44px 点击区域而不溢出。composer 容器不超过 320px 时收起工作区与分支的文字标签，但保留可操作的图标及完整工作区菜单。以下图是实际 Chromium 渲染的 UI,mock daemon 仅作测试后端,不把这些图冒充模型生成建议或真机 mobile-WebKit 运行结果。

![聚焦时收起键盘与放大位于编辑控件组末尾](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/editing-tail-focused-390px-v9.png)

![240px 下键组可换行,但收起键盘与放大仍相邻靠右](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/editing-tail-focused-240px-v9.png)

![240px 隐藏长工作区与分支文字后仍保留图标入口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/mobile-compact-context-240-v9.png)

### 较早真实环境证据(布局调整前)

下面这些真实会话图片属于此前 head 的历史证据,不是当前控件顺序的截图。本次布局调整没有重跑这些真实模型回合,它自身的验证范围由真实浏览器与组件测试证明。

在 head `724cdbc6a0` 上，以真实 daemon、真实模型和实际 Web Shell 页面执行 Pixel 7 触摸模拟，**62/62 条自建检查通过**。会话 `e6bec1a4-36a2-4b54-abb2-58e7195ae7c2` 最终 idle、请求队列为空，无待处理用户问题或权限请求。建议由 daemon 生成，探针未注入建议文字；以下图片与前面的 mock daemon 界面夹具分开，不混用证据口径。建议条显示建议时，textarea 仍保持普通占位符，建议文字不会重复出现。

![真实 daemon/模型会话中的建议 chip 与光标键](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-chip-keys-v7.png)

同一会话在 240px 宽度下，编辑键自成一行:

![真实移动端编辑布局（240px）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-240px-v7.png)

较早的命令授权 head `7c56a7eb955f1d3b209d9e8987a1061dc52d8449` 的独立真实 daemon + 模型 + 浏览器聚焦探针 **8/8** 通过，会话 `191b3e43-f572-4cf0-9355-c75eda0c0695`，由 daemon 给出 `/help` chip。首次 Send 只填入可编辑草稿，不打开 Help、不产生普通 prompt 请求；第二次明确 Send 才打开真实 Help 对话框。未注入建议；设备为 Pixel 7 Chromium 模拟，不是 iPhone 或 mobile-WebKit。

![真实命令首次 Send 填入而不执行 Help](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-command-review-v8.png)

![第二次明确 Send 打开真实 Help](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/mobile-followup-acceptance/real-command-executed-v8.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux 验证使用 Chromium 触摸模拟(mobile-chromium 项目);本机缺 WebKit 运行库,mobile-webkit 项目与 iOS/Android 真机未跑,因此不同宽度下编辑/上下文行换行带来的高度挤压,在真机软键盘弹起时仍未测量。

### 环境(可选)

Playwright 托管的 Vite dev server(`npm run dev`,SDK 与 daemon-react-sdk 走源码别名)、Pixel 7 设备模拟、逐页 mock daemon;jsdom 单测在 Node 26 下带 `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage`,避免本机原生 localStorage 占位遮蔽 jsdom。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡:建议可见时建议条在输入上方增加一行 44px;软键盘弹起的矮视口下会与附件条竞争空间。空闲布局不变,因为建议条仅在有可见建议且草稿为空时渲染。
- 未验证/范围外:iOS/WebKit 真机键盘行为、iPad 外接键盘 Tab/→ 接受(后置 follow-up)、软键盘弹起时的布局测量;历史步进按设计保持移除。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:无。无公共 API 或 daemon 契约变化;英文、简体中文、繁体中文、俄文目录各新增六个 i18n 键。

设计文档:[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-mobile-followup-acceptance.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无跟踪 issue;该功能是在评审触摸输入框 follow-up 缺口时直接提出的。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): use running color for active work
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Aligns the sidebar's active-work status with the existing green running treatment, reserving blue for completed-unread notifications. A regression assertion keeps active work on the same visual treatment as a running prompt.

## Why it's needed

An active session previously used the same blue as a completed-unread result, while a running prompt used green. This made ongoing work look like an unread notification. Using green for both active states makes the list easier to understand and keeps the blue notification distinct.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Compare a session with a running prompt and one reported as Active work in the sidebar. They should share the green running treatment.
2. Keep a completed, non-current session unread. Its dot should remain blue, distinct from the active/running green; opening the session should clear the unread indicator. Background-running work should retain its existing treatment.
3. The DOM regression assertion failed on `origin/main` before this change and passes with it. The real Web Shell browser scenario also compares computed CSS colors for running, active-work, and completed-unread sessions.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before — active work used the same blue as unread completion, rather than the running green:**

![Before: running is green, but active work and unread completion are blue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-active-dot-color/session-active-dot-color/active-work-before.png)

**After — active work and running share green, while unread completion stays blue:**

![After: running and active work are green, while unread completion stays blue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/session-active-dot-color/session-active-dot-color/active-work-after.png)

Both images use the same desktop Chromium, light theme, session state, and collapsed Recent group. The browser assertions measured running/active-work/unread colors as `rgb(31, 122, 58)` / `rgb(0, 51, 255)` / `rgb(0, 51, 255)` before and `rgb(31, 122, 58)` / `rgb(31, 122, 58)` / `rgb(0, 51, 255)` after. Both raw image links returned HTTP 200 with the same byte counts as the GitHub contents records.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux with Node.js 26.12.1, Vite, and Playwright Chromium. The real Web Shell frontend rendered sessions from the existing mock-daemon harness; no external model call was needed. Full-repository build, typecheck, and bundling passed. All 272 tests in the two relevant sidebar test files passed, along with the browser scenario. Formatting and lint checks passed for the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Active work now shares the established running visual treatment. Existing status text and separate unread/background states are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: Dark theme, mobile layouts, and WebKit were not exercised.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

N/A.

- 主要风险或取舍：活动任务现在使用既有的运行视觉效果；现有状态文字以及独立的未读、后台状态保持不变。
- 未验证或不在本次范围：深色主题、移动布局与 WebKit。
