prs.title: feat(i18n): add Arabic support for CLI and Web Shell with RTL layout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This pull request adds complete Arabic language support across both the command-line interface and the Web Shell, including right-to-left layout support in the Web Shell and exported HTML transcripts.

In core and the CLI, Arabic is registered as a shipped language option in the shared output language table and settings schema so it appears alongside existing locales in interactive language selection, slash-command completions, daemon feature advertisement, ACP integrations, and automated locale checks. A full Arabic locale catalog is included for CLI prompts, commands, tool display names, and subscription quota notices with all six Arabic cardinal plural forms.

In the Web Shell, Arabic is supported across transcript views, standalone gates, Managed agent views, slash-command subcommand completion, local command hints, toast notices, settings dialogs, and the service-worker offline fallback. Right-to-left rendering is driven automatically from the resolved UI language via document and portal direction attributes, Radix direction context propagation, conversion of layout-directional CSS and Tailwind utilities to logical properties, mirrored pointer-drag resize deltas and horizontal arrow-key navigation, flipped directional chevrons and back arrows, RTL-aware sticky DataTable pinning and Switch thumb travel, and explicit left-to-right preservation for code blocks, diffs, terminals, structured spreadsheets, charts, left-to-right plan dependency topology graphs, and interactive waiting games. Interactive-only Arabic translations are stubbed out of the read-only transcript export bundle while keeping transcript-reachable Arabic strings available in exported HTML documents, and the document export bundle budget has been updated to match the measured size.

## Why it's needed

Arabic-speaking users previously had to fall back to English in both the terminal CLI and the browser Web Shell, and Arabic text inside the Web Shell rendered inside an English left-to-right shell chrome with unmirrored spacing, borders, popovers, drawers, and directional controls. Adding full Arabic catalogs, CLDR six-form pluralization, and full RTL layout mirroring makes both interfaces natural and usable for Arabic users without inflating read-only exported HTML transcripts with interactive-only UI strings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Switch the CLI UI language to Arabic via settings or `/language ui ar`, and verify locale normalization for regional and POSIX variants such as `ar-SA` and `ar_EG.UTF-8` while confirming unrelated prefix neighbors like `armenian` do not map to Arabic. Confirm CLI menus, `/language` choices, tool display badges, and multi-form quota messages render in Arabic, and model output language settings recognize `Arabic` alongside existing options.
2. Open the Web Shell in standalone or embedded mode with Arabic selected via `?language=ar`, `/language ui ar`, `/settings`, or browser locale, and verify both the root container and the portal root carry `lang="ar"` and `dir="rtl"`.
3. Inspect key RTL surfaces in Web Shell: the sidebar docks on the start side and widens when dragging its resize handle leftward, popovers and tooltips open on the mirrored side, the floating artifact drawer slides from the left edge, the docked right panel widens when dragging its divider rightward, horizontal tab and timeline arrow navigation follows RTL order, directional back arrows and collapsed chevrons mirror visually, switches slide leftward when toggled on, and DataTable sticky leading/trailing columns pin to the right and left edges respectively.
4. Confirm code blocks, diffs, terminals, spreadsheets, ECharts, and left-to-right DAG plan dependency graphs remain legible with intentional left-to-right structural geometry while user messages isolate mixed-direction text cleanly.
5. Export a conversation to HTML while using Arabic and verify exported transcripts render localized status labels and RTL direction without pulling interactive-only Arabic dictionaries into the read-only transcript bundle.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Automated verification after the final edits confirmed green workspace builds, TypeScript typechecks across all packages and integration tests, zero-warning strict linting, CLI i18n checks showing 1976/2005 Arabic keys translated with zero missing keys, clean read-only transcript bundle builds within the updated byte ceiling, and passing unit/DOM tests covering core output-language consumers, CLI language/quota behavior, Web Shell Arabic pluralization, non-collision locale normalization, build-boundary separation, and RTL layout/resize/drawer/table behavior. Live browser screenshots were not captured locally in this turn.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22 macOS verification covering workspace builds, strict ESLint, TypeScript typechecks, Prettier formatting, CLI locale validation, and Vitest unit/DOM suites. Playwright browser E2E, integration suites, and Windows/Linux hosts remain to be validated in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Adding Arabic to the shared core output-language table affects downstream consumers across core goal verification, session title generation, the settings JSON schema, the CLI language registry and `/language` command, serve settings/feature routes, ACP integration, and the i18n check script; all downstream consumers were verified against the build, typecheck, and existing/expanded unit tests. In Web Shell, keeping synchronous translator lookups splits Arabic strings into transcript-reachable and interactive-only modules so read-only HTML exports grow by 47,120 measured bytes (including RTL runtime wiring) rather than carrying all interactive copy. Broad logical CSS/Tailwind refactoring across Web Shell components relies on automated CSS, ref-compat, and DOM suites locally and benefits from Playwright/visual spot-checks in CI.
- Not validated / out of scope: VS Code IDE companion host-chrome strings outside the embedded Web Shell remain English and Simplified Chinese only and were left untouched as requested scope focused on CLI and Web Shell; terminal RTL rendering behavior depends on the host terminal emulator; full Playwright visual tests and non-macOS runners were not executed locally; an unrelated pre-existing timing race observed in the Managed local-files bridge test suite also reproduces identically on the untouched base commit.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. English remains the fallback locale, existing partial-catalog behavior for Russian is unchanged, and existing language configuration values continue to work without migration.

## Linked Issues

None

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为命令行界面（CLI）与 Web Shell 增加了完整的阿拉伯语语言支持，并在 Web Shell 及导出的 HTML 对话记录中支持从右到左（RTL）的镜像布局。

在 Core 与 CLI 部分，我们将阿拉伯语注册为共享输出语言表及设置 Schema 中的内置语言选项，使其能够同步出现在交互式语言选择器、斜杠命令补全、守护进程特性声明、ACP 集成以及国际化校验脚本中。同时新增了完整的 CLI 阿拉伯语翻译词典，覆盖交互提示、命令说明、工具显示名称以及包含全部六种阿拉伯语基数复数形态的订阅配额提示。

在 Web Shell 部分，阿拉伯语已全面覆盖对话记录视图、独立认证门槛页、托管 Agent 视图、斜杠命令子命令补全、本地命令提示、Toast 通知、设置面板以及 Service Worker 离线回退页。系统会根据解析出的界面语言自动在根容器与 Portal 根节点设置 `lang="ar"` 与 `dir="rtl"`，并通过 Radix 方向上下文向下透传；同时将具备方向语义的 CSS 与 Tailwind 样式统一改造为逻辑属性，在 RTL 模式下镜像处理侧边栏与右侧面板拖拽调整宽度的方向符号、横向键盘方向键导航、返回箭头与折叠尖角图标方向、Switch 开关滑块位移动画以及 DataTable 固定列的吸顶方向；对于代码块、Diff、终端、电子表格、图表、有向无环计划拓扑图和等待小游戏等需要保持物理从左到右结构的内容，则显式保留 LTR 排版，并对混合方向的用户消息采用双向隔离渲染。为避免导出体积膨胀，仅交互界面使用的阿拉伯语词条会在导出 HTML 构建模式中被独立存根剔除，仅保留只读记录所需词条，并依据实测字节数同步更新了导出运行时大小预算。

## 为什么需要这个改动

此前使用阿拉伯语的用户在 CLI 与 Web Shell 中只能回退到英文界面，且 Web Shell 中的阿拉伯语文本会直接嵌入英文 LTR 界面框架里，导致边距、边框、弹出层方向、抽屉滑出方向以及箭头图标方向均与阿拉伯语阅读习惯相反。通过补充完整的阿拉伯语词条、CLDR 六形态复数规则以及全套 RTL 镜像布局，两个端都可以为阿拉伯语用户提供自然完整的使用体验，同时保证只读导出的 HTML 文件不会被仅用于交互界面的翻译文本拖累体积。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 在 CLI 中通过配置文件或 `/language ui ar` 切换界面语言为阿拉伯语，并验证 `ar-SA`、`ar_EG.UTF-8` 等区域/POSIX 标签的规范化解析，同时确认诸如 `armenian` 等共享前缀但不相干的词不会被误识别为阿拉伯语。检查 CLI 菜单、`/language` 选项、工具名称徽章、订阅配额多复数形式以及模型输出语言 `Arabic` 的显示与设置是否正常。
2. 在独立模式或嵌入模式下通过 `?language=ar`、`/language ui ar`、`/settings` 或浏览器语言切换到阿拉伯语打开 Web Shell，确认主根节点和 Portal 根节点均带有 `lang="ar"` 和 `dir="rtl"` 属性。
3. 验证 Web Shell 中的核心 RTL 交互与布局：侧边栏停靠在起始侧且向左拖拽分隔条时加宽，Tooltip 与 Popover 在镜像侧弹出，窄屏下的浮动右侧抽屉从左侧滑入，宽屏停靠下的右侧面板向右拖拽分隔条时加宽，水平 Tab 与时间轴导航遵循 RTL 方向键顺序，返回箭头和折叠箭头图标完成水平镜像，Switch 在开启时向左滑动，DataTable 固定首列与操作尾列分别吸附在右侧和左侧边缘。
4. 确认代码块、Diff 视图、终端、电子表格、ECharts 图表以及计划 DAG 拓扑图依然保持清晰的从左到右结构方向，同时包含阿英混排的用户消息可正确自动隔离文本方向。
5. 在阿拉伯语环境下导出 HTML 对话记录，确认导出文档可正确呈现本地化状态文案与 RTL 排版，且仅交互场景使用的阿拉伯语词典未被打包进只读导出产物。

### 对比证据

在最终修改完成后，我们已完成全仓工作区构建、全量 TypeScript 类型检查、零警告严格 ESLint 检查、Prettier 格式化校验、CLI 国际化脚本校验（阿拉伯语共翻译 1976/2005 项，缺失关键项为 0）、导出 HTML 运行时体积校验以及核心模块、CLI、Web Shell 与 VS Code Companion 相关单测和 DOM 测试验证。本次在本地未额外截取实时浏览器界面截图。

### 测试环境

|     系统   | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 运行环境说明

基于本地 macOS 与 Node 22 环境完成了工作区构建、严格 ESLint 检查、TypeScript 类型检查、Prettier 格式检查、CLI 语言校验与 Vitest 单元/DOM 测试；Playwright 浏览器 E2E 测试、集成测试及 Windows/Linux 环境需由 CI 进一步验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在核心公共输出语言表中新增阿拉伯语会影响目标校验、会话标题生成、设置 JSON Schema、CLI 语言注册及 `/language` 命令、daemon 设置与特性路由、ACP 集成以及 i18n 检查脚本等下游消费方；上述全部下游消费方均已通过构建、类型检查以及原有与新增单测的验证。在 Web Shell 中，为保持同步翻译读取契约，我们将阿拉伯语词条拆分为只读记录与交互界面两个模块，使导出 HTML 运行时资产实测净增 47,120 字节（包含 RTL 方向控制逻辑）而不会引入大批量交互文案。组件库及各页面级样式大量改造为 CSS 逻辑属性与 RTL 镜像规则后，本地已通过 CSS 规则、ref 兼容与 DOM 单测验证，建议 CI 中结合视觉回归进一步复核。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：VS Code 扩展宿主侧外部框架文案未在本次范围内，仍维持英文与简体中文（其中嵌入的 Web Shell 本体支持阿拉伯语和 RTL）；终端层面的双向文字排布效果取决于用户所用的终端模拟器本身；全量 Playwright 视觉测试及非 macOS 平台尚未在本地运行；在 Web Shell 全量测试运行中观察到的 Managed 本地文件桥接测试条目存在一处上游基线提交已引入的无关竞态失败（我们的改动未涉及该目录）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。英文继续作为兜底语言，俄语既有的部分词条策略保持不变，现有语言配置无需任何迁移即可继续使用。

## 关联 Issue

prs.title: test(e2e): resolve the feedback transcript path by realpath on macOS
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes the three `qwen serve — assistant feedback telemetry` integration tests so the transcript path they poll is computed from the realpath'd workspace, matching where the daemon actually writes.

## Why it's needed

Since #18021 landed, the `E2E Test - macOS` leg has failed on every main run where it actually executed (44940157874, the 3911b60fc run, and 44968941151) — the Linux legs pass, so this went unnoticed behind the build-budget failures in between. The failure is a path mismatch, not a product bug: macOS puts `os.tmpdir()` under `/var`, a symlink to `/private/var`. The daemon canonicalizes the workspace with realpath before hashing its project dir, so the feedback record lands in the `-private-var-…` directory; the tests computed the project dir from the unresolved temp path (`-var-…`), so every poll saw 0 records and timed out. The feedback POST itself succeeded (`recorded: true`) and the record was written — the tests just read a directory nothing writes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On macOS, from a built tree (`npm run build && npm run bundle`): `cd integration-tests && cross-env QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-feedback.test.ts`. Expect 7/7 passing in ~30s. On Linux the change is a no-op (realpath is the identity there).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change. Local macOS before: `3 failed | 4 passed` (each failure a 10s poll timeout, retried twice). After: `7 passed (7)` in 29s.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, node 22, repo worktree at this PR's head; the failing leg was also reproduced by reading the daemon's actual write location in a one-off diagnostic run (record present under the realpath'd project dir, absent under the unresolved one).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none — test-only change; the mirrored realpath matches the harness's existing mcpApprovals keying and `qwen-serve-generated-ui-state.test.ts`'s storage setup.
- Not validated / out of scope: `qwen-serve-session-cd.test.ts` computes a project dir from an unresolved path too, but it writes rather than reads through that path and passes on macOS today; left untouched. Whether the daemon should expose its canonical storage root instead of tests mirroring realpath is a follow-up design question.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #18021 (the PR that introduced these tests).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

## 为什么需要

#18021 合入后，`E2E Test - macOS` leg 在每一个真正执行到的 main run 上都失败（44940157874、3911b60fc 的 run、44968941151）——Linux leg 全过，加上中间几天被 build budget 的红盖住了，所以没人注意到。失败原因是路径不匹配，不是产品 bug：macOS 的 `os.tmpdir()` 在 `/var` 下，而 `/var` 是指向 `/private/var` 的符号链接。daemon 先把 workspace realpath 再算项目目录哈希，feedback 记录写进 `-private-var-…` 目录；测试用未解析的临时路径（`-var-…`）算目录，轮询永远看到 0 条记录直到超时。feedback POST 本身是成功的（`recorded: true`），记录也确实写了——只是测试读了一个没人写的目录。

## 评审验证

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：无——纯测试改动；realpath 的做法与 harness 的 mcpApprovals 键控和 `qwen-serve-generated-ui-state.test.ts` 的 storage 构造一致。

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): tolerate busy agents in channel liveness and capture failure evidence
prs.body:
## What this PR does Teaches the daemon's ACP channel liveness monitor to tell a temporarily busy agent apart from a dead one, and to leave forensic evidence behind whenever it does tear a channel down. When a liveness probe times out, the monitor now samples the agent child's CPU accounting at probe start and at timeout; if the process consumed CPU across the window, the timeout is charged as a bounded "busy extension" (at most six consecutive) instead of a failure strike, so a healthy-but-stalled agent survives GC pauses, heavy synchronous work, and scheduling delays. Zero-CPU stalls keep the existing two-consecutive-timeout fast path, and an agent stuck in a busy loop is still killed — just about 40 seconds later, with the grace bounded so its sessions are always eventually recovered. Every liveness failure, including protocol-error failures, now captures the agent's pid, process state, kernel wait channel, CPU-tick delta, RSS, and the monitor's counters, and writes them to the daemon log and telemetry before the SIGKILL destroys the scene. On non-Linux platforms, with unreadable process accounting, or for in-process channels, behavior is exactly as before. The change ships with a bilingual design document, a focused unit matrix (including mutation-pinned fixtures for the sample-pair guard and the evidence sample side), and a real-process plus real-daemon E2E test plan. ## Why it's needed The liveness monitor SIGKILLs the entire agent channel after two unanswered probes, and a channel hosts several sessions at once — so one false positive tears down every session on it: in-flight turns die, the prompt ledger records an error, and the next Web Shell load shows the "The previous request was interrupted before the response completed." recovery banner. On one 32-core development machine this happened four times in a single day (01:28, 03:38, 17:18, 17:34 local), each time interrupting active work; machine-wide CPU starvation was ruled out (load ≈ 9 on 32 cores) and worker heaps were modest, so the kills were false positives against temporarily unresponsive agents. Worse, SIGKILL left no trace of why the agent stalled, making the root cause undiagnosable. This PR removes the common false-kill class and turns every remaining kill into triageable evidence. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Unit matrix: from `packages/acp-bridge`, run `npx vitest run src/channel-liveness.test.ts src/channel-process-sample.test.ts` — 28 tests cover the busy-grace limit (five logged extensions, failure on the sixth busy window with evidence), the unchanged zero-CPU two-strike path, counter resets on success and on local timer delay, one-sided sample-missing fixtures (agent dies inside the probe window), and evidence on protocol-error failures. Three mutation witnesses were executed during development: deleting either conjunct of the sample-pair guard, or swapping the evidence sample to the probe-start baseline, each turns the corresponding test red (the last with cpuTicks 110 vs 120); all mutants were reverted. The bridge wiring block additionally pins the exact stderr evidence strings (including real wchan/RSS passthrough with non-empty wchan and non-zero RSS), the pre-shutdown killed flag, and the sampler argument; constant-renderer mutants for wchan and RSS each turn its passthrough case red. 2. Real daemon, stopped agent: build and bundle, start an isolated loopback daemon (`node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port

--no-web --workspace ` with a private runtime dir), create a session via `POST /session`, locate the channel child with `ps --ppid `, then `kill -STOP `. Within ~40 s the daemon log must show `channel liveness failed (acp_channel_liveness_timeout) pid= state=T wchan=… cpuDelta=0 busy=0 timeouts=2 rssMB=…; killing channel` followed by `channel exited (… signal=SIGKILL …)`. Before this PR the same procedure produced the failure line with no evidence fields at all. 3. Real daemon, healthy control: leave a fresh session idle for ≥ 70 s (four probe cycles); expect zero liveness failure lines and a live channel child. 4. Busy grace with a real process: spawn a CPU-spinning child that never answers probes and drive the monitor with the real sampler (rig in the E2E plan); expect five busy-extension callbacks and a failure at ~75 s carrying `busy=6`, a positive CPU delta, and state `R`, while a SIGSTOPped sibling still fails at ~35 s with `timeouts=2`, delta 0, state `T`. 5. Permanent real-process regression: from `integration-tests`, run `QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-liveness-grace.test.ts` (Linux-gated, real timers, real CPU-burning and SIGSTOPped children through the production sampler and startup wiring, no mocks): expect five logged grace extensions and an evidence-bearing kill at ~75 s for the busy child, and a two-strike evidence-bearing kill at ~35 s for the stopped child. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before (global install, pre-fix): a busy agent is killed exactly like a dead one at ~35 s, and the kill line carries no process evidence. ![Before: busy agent killed like a dead one, no evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/liveness-busy-grace/channel-liveness/before.png) After (this PR): the stopped agent's kill line carries pid/state/wchan/CPU delta/counters/RSS; the busy agent survives five logged grace extensions and is then killed with evidence at ~75 s; the zero-CPU fast path is unchanged; 106 focused tests pass (liveness 19, sampler 9, startup 3, spawnChannel 75); the bridge liveness wiring block adds 6 more. ![After: bounded busy grace + failure evidence before SIGKILL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/liveness-busy-grace/channel-liveness/after.png) ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested (sampler is Linux-gated; other platforms keep today's behavior by construction) | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested (same platform gate) | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ unit matrix + real-process rig + real-daemon E2E (Node v26.12.1) | ### Environment (optional) Local build (`npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle`), isolated loopback daemons with private runtime dirs on ephemeral ports, no sandbox; baseline dry-run against the globally installed CLI first. Full build/typecheck/bundle green; ESLint and Prettier clean on all changed files. A 10-agent medium code review ran on the monitor change (0 Critical, 6 findings, 4 fixed); the external round-2 review at the merge head then raised three correctness fixes and two optional suggestions, all addressed in this PR at 6ae90e4bdd — including the telemetry wiring assertions, now committed in the bridge liveness suite instead of deferred. Deduplicating the process-stat parser into core remains a documented design decision, not a review request. Internal medium review verdict: Comment (medium tier caps below Approve). ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: an agent hung in a CPU-burning busy loop is now torn down ~40 s later than before (grace bounded at six extensions); zero-CPU hang detection latency is unchanged (~20 s after it stops answering). The busy signal is kernel CPU accounting, which an agent cannot forge without actually burning CPU, and burning CPU forever still ends in a kill. - Not validated / out of scope: the root cause of the agent stalls themselves (the new evidence is the input to that follow-up); real-daemon runs on macOS/Windows; an operator tuning knob for the cadence/thresholds; deduplicating the process-stat parsing into the shared core helper (core contract and maintainer-gate constraints, documented in the design). The telemetry/stderr wiring assertions requested in review round 2 are committed (bridge liveness suite) and a real-wiring rig with the real /proc sampler measured the busy-grace and stopped paths end to end; inducing a busy agent inside a real daemon child from outside remains disclosed as not measured. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The channel contract gains an optional pid, the monitor gains optional injected callbacks, and the failure type gains an optional evidence argument; all existing callers and tests are unaffected, and platforms without process accounting keep the previous accounting exactly. Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/channel-liveness-busy-grace/docs/design/2026-11-21-channel-liveness-busy-grace.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/channel-liveness-busy-grace/docs/design/2026-11-21-channel-liveness-busy-grace.zh-CN.md) — both complete and synchronized (problem, current state, goals, scope, solution, decisions, constraints, risks, validation, acceptance criteria, open questions). ## Linked Issues None — motivated by observed local incidents (four false-positive channel kills in one day on a shared development daemon); no tracking issue existed. Follow-ups from the code review (shared process-stat parser, integration wiring assertions) are recorded in the design document and the saved review report.

中文说明 ## 本 PR 做什么 让 daemon 的 ACP 通道 liveness 监控区分"暂时忙碌的 agent"与"已死的 agent"，并在每次拆除通道时留下取证证据。探测超时时，监控在探测起点与超时点各采一次 agent 子进程的 CPU 记账；若进程在该窗口内消耗了 CPU，则该超时记为有界的"忙碌宽限"（连续至多 6 次）而非失败 strike，使健康但暂时停摆的 agent 能扛过 GC 暂停、重同步工作与调度延迟。零 CPU 停摆保持原有的连续 2 次超时快路径；卡在 busy loop 的 agent 仍会被杀——只是晚约 40 秒，且宽限有界，其会话终将被回收恢复。每次 liveness 失败（含 protocol-error 失败）都会采集 agent 的 pid、进程状态、内核等待通道、CPU tick 增量、RSS 与监控计数器，并在 SIGKILL 销毁现场之前写入 daemon 日志与遥测。非 Linux 平台、进程记账不可读、进程内通道的情形下行为与之前完全一致。改动附带双语设计文档、聚焦单元矩阵（含对采样对守卫与证据样本侧的变异钉住夹具）以及真实进程 + 真实 daemon 的 E2E 测试计划。 ## 为什么需要 liveness 监控在两次探测无应答后 SIGKILL 整个 agent 通道，而一个通道同时承载多个会话——因此一次误杀会撕掉其上全部会话：在飞回合死亡、prompt ledger 记入 error、下一次 Web Shell 加载显示"The previous request was interrupted before the response completed."恢复横幅。在一台 32 核开发机上这曾在一天内发生 4 次（本地时间 01:28、03:38、17:18、17:34），每次都打断正在进行的工作；整机 CPU 饥饿被排除（32 核 load ≈ 9）、worker 堆也不大，因此这些是对暂时无应答 agent 的误杀。更糟的是 SIGKILL 不留任何 agent 停摆原因的痕迹，使根因无法诊断。本 PR 消除常见误杀类别，并把每一次剩余 kill 变成可分诊的证据。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 单元矩阵：在 `packages/acp-bridge` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/channel-liveness.test.ts src/channel-process-sample.test.ts`——28 个用例覆盖忙碌宽限上限（5 次宽限日志、第 6 个忙碌窗口带证据失败）、不变的零 CPU 两次 strike 路径、成功与本地定时器迟到时的计数器重置、单边样本缺失夹具（agent 在探测窗口内死亡）、protocol-error 失败带证据。开发期间执行了 3 个变异见证：删除采样对守卫的任一合取项、或把证据样本换成探测起点基线，都会使对应用例转红（最后一个表现为 cpuTicks 110 对 120）；所有变异体均已还原。bridge 接线块另钉精确 stderr 证据串（含非空 wchan 与非零 RSS 的真值透传）、shutdown 前 killed 标志与采样器参数；wchan/RSS 常量渲染变异体各使其透传用例转红。 2. 真实 daemon、被 STOP 的 agent：构建并 bundle，启动隔离 loopback daemon（`node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port

--no-web --workspace `，私有 runtime 目录），`POST /session` 创建会话，`ps --ppid ` 定位 channel 子进程，然后 `kill -STOP `。约 40 s 内 daemon 日志应出现 `channel liveness failed (acp_channel_liveness_timeout) pid= state=T wchan=… cpuDelta=0 busy=0 timeouts=2 rssMB=…; killing channel`，随后 `channel exited (… signal=SIGKILL …)`。本 PR 之前同流程产生的失败行没有任何证据字段。 3. 真实 daemon、健康对照：新会话静置 ≥ 70 s（4 个探测周期）；期望 0 条 liveness 失败行、channel 子进程存活。 4. 真实进程的忙碌宽限：spawn 一个烧 CPU 且从不应答探测的子进程，用真实采样器驱动监控（E2E 计划中的 rig）；期望 5 次忙碌宽限回调、约 75 s 时带 `busy=6`、正 CPU 增量、状态 `R` 失败；而被 SIGSTOP 的兄弟进程仍在约 35 s 以 `timeouts=2`、增量 0、状态 `T` 失败。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before（全局安装、修复前）：忙碌 agent 与死 agent 一样在约 35 s 被杀，kill 行无任何进程证据。 ![Before：忙碌 agent 被当作死 agent 杀掉，无证据](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/liveness-busy-grace/channel-liveness/before.png) After（本 PR）：被 STOP agent 的 kill 行携带 pid/state/wchan/CPU 增量/计数器/RSS；忙碌 agent 扛过 5 次 logged 宽限后于约 75 s 带证据被杀；零 CPU 快路径不变；106 个聚焦测试通过（liveness 19、sampler 9、startup 3、spawnChannel 75）；bridge liveness 接线块另 6 个。 ![After：SIGKILL 前的有界忙碌宽限 + 失败证据](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/liveness-busy-grace/channel-liveness/after.png) ### 测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试（采样器按 Linux 门禁；其他平台按构造保持今天的行为） | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试（同一平台门禁） | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 单元矩阵 + 真实进程 rig + 真实 daemon E2E（Node v26.12.1） | ### 环境 本地构建（`npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle`），私有 runtime 目录、临时端口的隔离 loopback daemon，无 sandbox；先对全局安装 CLI 做基线 dry-run。全量 build/typecheck/bundle 绿；改动文件 ESLint 与 Prettier 干净。对监控改动跑了 10-agent medium 代码评审（0 Critical、6 条发现、4 条修复）；合并 head 上的外部第二轮评审又提出 3 条正确性修复与 2 条可选建议，全部在本 PR 于 6ae90e4bdd 处理——含遥测接线断言（已提交进 bridge liveness 套件，不再延期）。把进程 stat 解析去重到 core 仍是记录在案的设计决策，非评审要求。内部 medium 评审裁决：Comment（medium 层级封顶低于 Approve）。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险/取舍：卡在烧 CPU 的 busy loop 的 agent 如今比之前晚约 40 s 被拆除（宽限以 6 次为界）；零 CPU 卡死的检测延迟不变（停止应答后约 20 s）。忙碌信号是内核 CPU 记账，agent 不实际烧 CPU 就无法伪造，而永远烧 CPU 仍终将被杀。 - 未验证/范围外：agent 停摆的根因本身（新证据是该 follow-up 的输入）；macOS/Windows 的真实 daemon 运行；节奏/阈值的运维调优开关；把进程 stat 解析去重到 core 共享 helper（core 契约与 maintainer 门禁约束，见设计文档）。第二轮评审要求的遥测/stderr 接线断言已提交（bridge liveness 套件），并以真实 /proc 采样器的真实接线 rig 端到端实测 busy 宽限与 stopped 路径；从外部在真实 daemon 子进程内诱导 busy agent 仍披露为未实测。 - 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。通道契约新增可选 pid，监控新增可选注入回调，失败类型新增可选 evidence 参数；所有既有调用方与测试不受影响，无进程记账的平台保持原记账方式。 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/channel-liveness-busy-grace/docs/design/2026-11-21-channel-liveness-busy-grace.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/channel-liveness-busy-grace/docs/design/2026-11-21-channel-liveness-busy-grace.zh-CN.md)——双语完整同步（问题、现状、目标、范围、方案、决策、约束、风险、验证、验收标准、开放问题）。 ## 关联 Issue 无——动机为观察到的本地事故（共享开发 daemon 一天内 4 次误杀通道）；此前无跟踪 issue。代码评审的 follow-up（共享进程 stat 解析器、接线集成断言）记录在设计文档与存档评审报告中。

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(acp-bridge): tolerate busy agents in channel liveness and capture failure evidence (#18028)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(acp-bridge): tolerate busy agents in channel liveness and capture failure evidence

The channel liveness monitor SIGKILLs the whole agent channel after two
consecutive 10s probe timeouts, tearing down every session it hosts. A
temporarily busy agent (GC pause, heavy synchronous work, scheduling
delay) cannot answer the ping either, so healthy sessions were killed
as if dead: on one 32-core dev machine this happened four times in a
day, each kill interrupting in-flight turns and surfacing the
"previous request was interrupted" recovery banner in the Web Shell.

Sample the agent's /proc CPU ticks at probe start and on timeout. When
CPU advanced across the window, charge the timeout as a bounded busy
extension (up to six) instead of a failure strike; zero-CPU stalls keep
the existing two-strike fast path, and a busy-looping hung agent is
still killed, just ~40s later. Non-Linux platforms, unreadable /proc,
and in-process channels keep today's behavior exactly.

Capture process evidence (pid, state, wchan, CPU delta, RSS, counters)
on every liveness failure — including protocol errors — and log it
before the SIGKILL destroys the scene, so the next incident is
triageable instead of leaving no trace of why the agent stalled.

Verified: 104 focused unit tests (incl. three mutation witnesses),
real-process rig (busy child survives 75s with five logged extensions,
stopped child still killed at 35s), and real-daemon E2E (healthy
control clean; SIGSTOP produces the evidence-bearing kill line).
Design: docs/design/2026-11-21-channel-liveness-busy-grace.md (EN/ZH).

* fix(acp-bridge): guard liveness telemetry keys and re-baseline after local delay

Review round 2 on #18028:

- Guard every channel.liveness_failed telemetry attribute per field so no
  undefined value reaches the attribute contract. Numeric guards use
  !== undefined, keeping a zero-CPU stall's cpu_delta_ticks 0 and
  rss_bytes 0 as evidence; an empty wchan is omitted. Two bridge wiring
  tests pin the exact key set and the zero preservation.
- Refresh the CPU baseline when a local delay opens a fresh probe window,
  so CPU burned before the delay cannot credit the new window as busy.
  Pinned by a focused monitor test (removing the refresh turns it red).
- Skip the evidence read in the rejected-probe branch once the monitor
  stopped during the microtask yield; fail() already guarded the failure
  itself, this avoids a wasted /proc read after the child exited.
- Align the wchan JSDoc with the sampler's actual '0' / '' semantics.

Mutation witnesses: a truthy guard on cpu_delta_ticks and the removed
baseline refresh each turn their new test red; both reverted. The
rejected-yield guard carries no dedicated fixture: its stop window is one
microtask wide and external injection depends on promise-adoption order
(two attempts proved vacuous); disclosed in the PR thread instead of
committing a fake pin.

* fix(acp-bridge): pin liveness pid plumbing, evidence lines and interleaved accounting

Review round 3 on #18028 (six inline suggestions, all addressed here):
pin the published channel pid and the sampler argument; assert the
operator-facing kill and grace stderr lines (including a busy-extension
bridge case with advancing ticks); exercise the rejected-probe evidence
sample; pin that a busy extension neither charges nor clears strikes;
widen the busy-extension payload with the timeout-side sample so grace
lines carry state/wchan/RSS like the kill line; add a forward pointer in
the superseded transport-liveness design plus its full Chinese pair; and
add a Linux-gated real-process integration test (real CPU-burning and
SIGSTOPped children through the production sampler and wiring).

* test(acp-bridge): fix stderr spy scope and telemetry helper generics in liveness pins

The stderr spy was declared inside try but restored in finally (TS2304
under tsc --build), and the integration telemetry helper lacked the
generic signatures BridgeTelemetry requires. Both surfaced as real
build/typecheck failures, not as test failures; fixed and re-verified
(focused 106 + bridge liveness 5 green, five-mutant arm red on exactly
the five pinned tests, real-process integration 2/2, real-daemon E2E
healthy control clean and SIGSTOP evidence line intact).

* test(ci): register the liveness grace real-process test in the no-AK lane

The unit lane's selection ledger (scripts/tests/no-ak-integration-ci)
requires every runnable integration test to be selected or exempted;
the new real-process liveness test was neither, reding Linux unit
shard 1/2 and the Test aggregator. Select it in the no-AK shard script
and its pin list so CI actually runs it, and make the integration
timing upper bounds load-tolerant (local-delay forgiveness can add
probe windows on busy hosts; the extension and strike counts remain
the bounded-grace pins). Pin gate 18/18 and the real-process test 2/2
green locally.

* test(acp-bridge): bind the busy-grace timing bound and point design at the committed rig

Address the two non-blocking review notes: the 140s upper bound sat above
the 120s poll cap and could never fail, so raise the poll budget to 150s
and the test timeout to 180s (the bound now binds, and a slow kill fails
on the bound rather than on a missing kill line); give the kill-line
assertions a diagnostic message. The design's validation section cited a
git-ignored .qwen/e2e-tests plan; point both language versions at the
committed real-process integration test instead.

* fix(acp-bridge): harden liveness grace tests and single-source evidence guards

Review round 3 on #18028 (seven suggestions, all addressed here):

- Integration suite: pin the reset-surviving grace shape instead of exact
  cardinality and drop load-fragile wall-clock ceilings; own child cleanup
  and stderr-spy restore from the spawn point so a rejecting handshake
  cannot orphan a core burner; keep every poll budget below its it()
  timeout; assert the channel was actually killed before shutdown; add the
  missing healthy-answering-channel case (the false-kill class this PR
  exists to prevent).
- channel-startup: share the wchan/RSS guards between the kill line and the
  grace line via two module-local helpers; field order unchanged and pinned.
- Old transport-liveness design (EN+ZH): correct the unresolved-request
  bound for busy episodes (1 + CHANNEL_LIVENESS_BUSY_EXTENSION_LIMIT, plus
  one when a strike precedes), naming the nonce echo and the 256-message
  pipe budget.
- run-e2e-tests.sh: exclude the child-heavy liveness suite from the
  three-fork bulk batch and name it in the isolated maxForks=1 invocation;
  e2e-workflow meta-test pins all of it in the same commit.

Mutation witnesses at this head, attributed per mutant: shared wchan
fallback mutant turns both pinned stderr strings red in one run;
kill-suppression mutant turns the pre-shutdown killed pins red;
isValidResponse mutant turns the success-reset pin red. All reverted
byte-identically; suites re-run green afterwards.

* fix(web-templates): reset export renderer budget to the merge-tree measurement

Merging main 8e7d1e37c9 (ChatSurface chat-column i18n, #17952) into this
branch measures 2,151,847 renderer JS bytes, exactly matching CI run
44965176587's merge-ref measurement that turned both tui-parity Build cli
steps red against the stale 2,151,577 ceiling. This PR's diff touches no
web-shell/web-templates source, so the growth is entirely main's i18n.

Reset warning/ceiling to measurement + 713 / + 1,713 per house precedent
(2,152,560 / 2,153,560) and record the merge measurement in the budget
comment instead of taking either side's stale cap. Local re-measure passes
the gate and the forbidden-input guard; web-templates workspace build green.

* test(acp-bridge): pin real wchan and RSS passthrough on liveness evidence lines

Review round-4 finding 2 on #18028: every committed fixture used wchan ''
and rssBytes 0, where the correct rendering is already '?'/'0', so constant
renderers for both fields survived the whole matrix. Add a wiring case with
a non-empty wchan (do_signal_stop) and non-zero RSS (44,040,192 -> rssMB=42)
asserting the exact grace and kill lines. Witnessed: constant-'?' wchan and
constant-'0' RSS mutants each turn this case red; restored byte-identically
and re-green. Focused four-file set stays 106; the two liveness files 28.

prs.title: test(sdk): run session-id cases in no-AK CI
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Runs the SDK session-id integration suite on the repository's fake OpenAI-compatible backend and enrolls it in the existing no-AK pull-request integration lane. The coverage includes custom and generated IDs, CLI argument propagation, multi-turn consistency, validation, and duplicate detection. The lane's meta-test now requires the file and no longer exempts it as requiring a real model.

## Why it's needed

These tests previously ran only in release or post-merge paths, so a change that broke the CLI-echoed session ID could merge without any pull-request signal. The assertions concern session identity rather than model output, so the fake backend preserves the signal while making the suite deterministic and credential-free.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that every query in the session-id suite receives the fake endpoint and credentials, and that the file appears in the existing no-AK integration command. Breaking the CLI-echoed session ID must fail the corresponding init-message assertion in a pull-request lane rather than waiting for release or post-merge CI.

Local evidence: all 15 session-id tests passed against the fake backend; the no-AK wiring meta-test passed 14 tests with 4 platform-specific skips; the full build, bundle, integration typecheck, Prettier, and pre-commit ESLint passed. The first Windows run hit a shared-directory EBUSY cascade, so the successful local verification used temporary per-case directories; that workaround was removed and is not in this diff.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test and CI coverage only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally; covered by CI |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 26.13.1 on Windows, repository bundle, and the local fake OpenAI-compatible server.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The no-AK lane now runs 15 additional SDK cases, adding about two minutes in the local run. No production code changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: The complete no-AK suite was not run locally; its wiring and the full session-id file were run separately.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14721

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

让 SDK session-id 集成套件运行在仓库自带的伪造 OpenAI 兼容后端上，并加入现有的 no-AK 拉取请求集成通道。覆盖自定义与自动生成的 ID、CLI 参数传递、多轮一致性、校验和重复检测。该通道的元测试现在要求包含此文件，并不再以「需要真实模型」为由豁免它。

## 为什么需要此更改

这些测试此前只在发布或合并后的路径上运行，因此破坏 CLI 回显 session ID 的改动可能在没有任何拉取请求信号的情况下合入。这些断言关注的是会话身份而不是模型输出，因此伪造后端既保留信号，也让套件确定且无需凭证。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认 session-id 套件中的每个 query 都使用伪造端点和凭证，并确认该文件出现在现有 no-AK 集成命令中。破坏 CLI 回显的 session ID 必须在拉取请求通道中让相应的 init 消息断言失败，而不是等到发布或合并后的 CI。

本地证据：全部 15 个 session-id 测试在伪造后端上通过；no-AK 接线元测试通过 14 个、平台相关跳过 4 个；完整构建、打包、集成类型检查、Prettier 和 pre-commit ESLint 均通过。首次 Windows 运行出现共享目录 EBUSY 级联，因此成功的本地验证临时按用例拆分目录；该临时处理已移除，不在本 diff 中。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用——仅涉及测试和 CI 覆盖。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |

| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Windows 上的 Node.js 26.13.1、仓库 bundle 和本地伪造 OpenAI 兼容服务器。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): unify unbound Session authority under the ownership row [16023 A/2]
prs.body:
Split from #16023 at source commit `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935` (base `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e` on `main`); candidate A: `24a02a0165494`. This is **[16023 A/2]** — the unbound Session principal ownership migration extracted from #16023 so it can be reviewed and verified independently of the shared resident external Workspace runtime changes in #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**). Both A/2 and B/2 target `main` directly with zero runtime dependency between them.

## What this PR does

Unifies unbound (non-Workspace) Session ownership under an immutable ownership record written in the Session creation transaction. Every new unbound Session persists its verified caller principal (tenant, user, and optional business actor subject) in `ma_session_principal`. When an ownership row is present, that row is the sole authority for reading, listing, replaying, and mutating the Session, and a caller whose principal does not match receives a fail-closed `404 session_not_found`. Genuine legacy row-less Sessions remain tenant-wide so pre-existing records continue to work, while actorless creation of new unbound Sessions is closed across all routes.

It also widens `actor_id` to `VARBINARY(2048)` on the user-message queue tables so raw Workspace actors that exceed the 512-byte principal component bound continue to work on Workspace-bound routes without eagerly constructing a byte-bounded `SessionPrincipal`, and decomposes the store collaborators so every class stays below its class-size ratchet ceiling with zero ceiling increases.

## Why it's needed

Previously, #16023 bundled this 99-file unbound Session principal ownership migration together with the 70-file shared resident external Workspace lifecycle changes (+12,319 lines total). Because unbound Session ownership changes who may create, read, list, replay, and mutate non-Workspace Sessions across every controller and store surface, it is a distinct trust boundary that deserves dedicated review and standalone CI execution against `main`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the ownership, route-authority, transaction-boundary, and class-size ratchet tests from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=SessionPrincipalOwnershipTest,SubjectActorRouteOwnershipTest,PrincipalEntryTransactionBoundaryTest,ManagedTaskActorBoundaryTest,TenantContextFilterTest,ManagedStoreDecompositionTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

Expected:
- A newly created unbound Session writes one row in `ma_session_principal` and is visible only to its owning principal; another user or another business actor subject of the same user receives `404 session_not_found`.
- Idempotent replay of Session creation, turn submission, cancellation, rename, and lifecycle mutations checks the caller principal before returning a recorded receipt, and cross-Session key collisions do not leak foreign Session existence.
- Bound Workspace routes defer principal construction so a 1,536-byte UTF-8 Workspace actor continues to read and operate its bound Session without hitting `400 invalid_actor`.
- `ClassSizeRatchetTest` passes with zero ceiling raises.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend authority and schema change with no TUI/UI surface.

Local verification on macOS (JDK 21):

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) for offline reactor compilation and unit tests; Linux and MySQL 8.4 lanes run in CI against `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changing read/write/replay authority for unbound Sessions can break callers that omit the trusted actor header or reuse idempotency keys across Sessions. Row-less legacy Sessions keep their existing tenant-wide behavior, and Workspace-bound routes keep raw-actor compatibility.
- Not validated / out of scope: the shared resident external Workspace lifecycle, `reattach`, and `EPHEMERAL` storage registration from #16023 are split into #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**) and are intentionally absent here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: adds `ma_session_principal` to `V1__managed_schema.sql` (following the pre-release baseline policy where `ManagedSchema.schemaVersion()` is 1) and closes actorless creation of new unbound Sessions (`401 actor_required`).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15512, #15247. Split from #16023 (`[16023 A/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #16023 的源码提交 `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935`（基于 `main` 的 `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e`）拆分而来；候选提交 A 为 `24a02a0165494`。本 PR 是 **[16023 A/2]** —— 将无绑定（非 Workspace）Session 的 principal 归属迁移从 #16023 中独立出来，以便与 #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**)（常驻外部 Workspace 跨会话共享）分别评审与验证。A/2 与 B/2 均直接以 `main` 为 base，两者之间零运行时代码依赖。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

将无绑定（非 Workspace）Session 的归属权统一收敛到创建事务内写入的不可变归属记录中。每个新建的无绑定 Session 都会在 `ma_session_principal` 表中持久化经过校验的调用方 principal（tenant、user 以及可选的业务 actor subject）。当归属行存在时，该行即为读取、列表、幂等重放与变更该 Session 的唯一权限依据；principal 不匹配的调用方会收到 fail-closed 的 `404 session_not_found`。真正无归属行的存量旧 Session 保持租户内可见以兼容历史数据，而所有新建无绑定 Session 的无 actor 创建路径均已关闭。

同时将用户消息队列表上的 `actor_id` 拓宽为 `VARBINARY(2048)`，使超过 512 字节 principal 限制的原始 Workspace actor 在绑定 Workspace 的路由上继续正常工作（不会提前构造受字节限制的 `SessionPrincipal`），并拆解了 Store 协作类，使所有类均保持在 class-size ratchet 上限之内且零上限上调。

## 为什么需要它

此前 #16023 将这部分涉及 99 个文件的无绑定 Session principal 归属迁移与 70 个文件的常驻外部 Workspace 跨会话生命周期改动绑在了同一个 PR（共 +12,319 行）。由于无绑定 Session 归属变更直接决定谁能创建、读取、列表、重放和修改非 Workspace 会话，属于独立的安全与信任边界，拆出后可以单独评审并直接针对 `main` 跑全量 CI。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

prs.title: fix(core): honor path-scoped Read deny rules in grep and glob results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A path-scoped deny rule such as `Read(./secret.env)` now also applies to what the search tools return. Content search and file search drop result files the deny rules claim, keep everything else, and append a short note naming how many files were omitted so a quiet result is distinguishable from an empty one. This covers both content-search backends (the default ripgrep one and the fallback) and file search. Only deny rules filter results; ask rules do not prompt during a search.

## Why it's needed

The documented contract says a `Read` rule covers all four read tools, and the settings reference shows `Read(./secrets/**)` as the way to keep a subtree out of the agent's context. Today only the direct read is blocked: the input-side check for the search tools evaluates rules against the search root, which can never match a rule that targets an individual result file, so a workspace-wide search hands the model the denied file's content lines and its name. Hosts that rely on deny rules to keep material out of the model context get no protection from search. Reported in #15129 with a maintainer-confirmed root cause.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create a workspace with two files containing the same marker word, and a project settings file with `"permissions": { "deny": ["Read(./secret.env)"] }` where secret.env is one of the two files.
2. Ask the agent to search the workspace for the marker. Before this change both files' lines come back, including the denied file's content. After it, only the allowed file's lines come back, and the output ends with a bracketed note that one file was omitted by permission rules.
3. Repeat with a filename search that matches both files: the denied file's name no longer appears in the listing, with the same omission note.
4. Repeat with a directory rule such as `Read(./sub/**)`: every result under that directory is dropped.
5. Confirm a session without deny rules returns identical output to before, with no note.

The behavior is pinned by unit tests next to both tools: a file-level deny, a directory-level deny, the all-results-denied case, and the no-permission-manager baseline.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Unit level, before this change (content search over a temp workspace with `Read(./fileA.txt)` denied):

```
Found 2 matches for pattern "hello" in the workspace directory:
---
File: fileA.txt
L1: hello world
---
File: fileB.js
L2: function baz() { return "hello"; }
---
```

After:

```
Found 1 match for pattern "hello" in the workspace directory:
---
File: fileB.js
L2: function baz() { return "hello"; }
---
 [1 file omitted by permission rules]
```

Full runs on b100a0c4bb (main merged in), each command from the repo root:

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/grep.test.ts src/tools/glob.test.ts src/tools/ripGrep.test.ts src/tools/grepReadTracking.test.ts src/core/permission-helpers.test.ts src/memory/memory-scoped-agent-config.test.ts src/memory/skillReviewAgentPlanner.test.ts`: 329 of 329
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions/`: 1357 of 1357
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts src/core/permissionFlow.test.ts`: 575 of 575
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-permission-policy.test.ts`: 4 of 4 (the CLI package tests need `npm run build` first)
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/toolFormatting.test.ts`: 105 of 105
- `node scripts/lint.js --eslint` and `node scripts/lint.js --prettier` with `LINT_BASE_SHA` set to main (CI's incremental scope, all 20 files in this PR), the workspace build, and the core, CLI and Web Shell typechecks with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` pass.

No user-facing UI change, so no screen recording.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; no daemon, sandbox, or model requests involved.

### Update after review

The default ripgrep backend now drops denied files before counting, truncation and read tracking. A capped glob keeps the hint to narrow the search. The omission count also shows in the terminal, a relevance check skips rule evaluation when no rule can apply, and a git grep subdirectory test covers result paths. Batch matching and cancellation are left for a follow-up.

Round 4 (2026-11-05): `zoom_image` is now in the Read docs, and the `formatPermissionOmissionNote` doc comment says why the omission count is model-facing. On the new head, build, typecheck, lint, formatting, the focused grep, ripGrep, glob, read tracking and permission helper tests (261) and `src/permissions/` (1,236) pass. The full core suite passes apart from two environment-only tests this change doesn't touch: an SSH push to `example.invalid` and a cold-scan timing check.

Rounds 5 and 6 (2026-11-06): both scoped permission-manager shims implement `hasDenyRules`, restricted memory-scoped configs apply the same read boundary to glob results, the backend tests pair an ask-matched file with a denied one, and the web shell's two summary parsers share one omission-note pattern.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: content search checks every distinct result file before truncation, so a search that returns many files does proportionally more work. Each file is canonicalized once per search and then matched against the rules in memory. With 8,000 matching files and 10 deny rules this adds about 156 ms on my machine.
- Not validated / out of scope: `ask` rules still do not pause a search for confirmation, only `deny` drops results; the directory listing tool has the same input-shape and is left to a follow-up, matching the scope of the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Sessions without path-scoped deny rules get byte-identical output.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15129.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

路径作用域的拒绝规则（例如 `Read(./secret.env)`）现在同样作用于搜索工具的返回结果。内容搜索与文件名搜索会丢弃被拒绝规则命中的结果文件，保留其余结果，并在输出末尾以方括号注明被省略的文件数量，使"无结果"与"结果被省略"可以区分。这同时覆盖两个内容搜索后端（默认的 ripgrep 与后备实现）以及文件名搜索。只有 deny 规则会过滤结果，ask 规则不会在搜索中弹出确认。

## 为什么需要

文档约定 `Read` 规则覆盖全部四个读取类工具，设置参考中也以 `Read(./secrets/**)` 作为将子目录排除在上下文之外的方式。但当前只有直接读取被拦截：搜索工具的入参检查只针对搜索根目录评估规则，永远无法命中指向单个结果文件的规则，于是在整个工作区搜索时，被拒文件的内容行和文件名仍会交还给模型。依赖拒绝规则隔离内容的宿主在搜索路径上得不到任何保护。#15129 报告了该问题，根因已由维护者确认。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 建一个包含两个含相同标记词文件的工作区，项目设置写入 `"permissions": { "deny": ["Read(./secret.env)"] }`，其中 secret.env 是两个文件之一。
2. 让 agent 在工作区搜索该标记词。修改前两个文件的行都会返回，包括被拒文件的内容；修改后只返回允许文件的行，输出末尾带有"1 个文件因权限规则被省略"的注记。
3. 用能同时匹配两个文件的文件名搜索重试：被拒文件名不再出现在列表中，注记相同。
4. 用目录规则（如 `Read(./sub/**)`）重试：该目录下的全部结果被丢弃。
5. 确认没有拒绝规则的会话输出与之前逐字节一致，且无注记。

该行为已由两个工具旁边的单元测试钉住：文件级拒绝、目录级拒绝、全部结果被拒、以及无权限管理器的基线。

### 证据（修改前/后）

单元层面，修改前（临时工作区，`Read(./fileA.txt)` 被拒）：

```
Found 2 matches for pattern "hello" in the workspace directory:
---
File: fileA.txt
L1: hello world
---
File: fileB.js
L2: function baz() { return "hello"; }
---
```

修改后：

```
Found 1 match for pattern "hello" in the workspace directory:
---
File: fileB.js
L2: function baz() { return "hello"; }
---
 [1 file omitted by permission rules]
```

完整运行（b100a0c4bb，已合并 main，每条命令都从仓库根目录执行）：

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/grep.test.ts src/tools/glob.test.ts src/tools/ripGrep.test.ts src/tools/grepReadTracking.test.ts src/core/permission-helpers.test.ts src/memory/memory-scoped-agent-config.test.ts src/memory/skillReviewAgentPlanner.test.ts`：329/329
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions/`：1357/1357
- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts src/core/permissionFlow.test.ts`：575/575
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-permission-policy.test.ts`：4/4（CLI 包的测试需要先执行 `npm run build`）
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/messages/toolFormatting.test.ts`：105/105
- 在 `LINT_BASE_SHA` 指向 main 时，`node scripts/lint.js --eslint` 与 `node scripts/lint.js --prettier`（CI 的增量范围，覆盖本 PR 的全部 20 个文件）、工作区构建，以及 core、CLI 与 Web Shell 在 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` 下的类型检查均通过。

无用户可见的界面变化，故无录屏。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试；不涉及 daemon、沙箱或模型请求。

### 审阅后的更新

默认的 ripgrep 后端现在会在计数、截断与读取记录之前丢弃被拒文件。达到上限的 glob 会保留缩小搜索范围的提示。省略数量也会显示在终端，没有可适用规则时会跳过规则求值，并新增了 git grep 子目录测试覆盖结果路径。批量匹配与取消留待后续处理。

第四轮（2026-11-05）：Read 文档已补充 `zoom_image`，`formatPermissionOmissionNote` 的文档注释说明了省略计数为什么面向模型。在新的 head 上，build、typecheck、lint、格式检查、相关的 grep、ripGrep、glob、读取记录与权限辅助测试（261 个）以及 `src/permissions/`（1,236 个）均通过。完整的 core 测试套件中只有两个与本次改动无关的环境相关测试未通过：一个向 `example.invalid` 发起的 SSH push 测试，以及一个冷扫描计时检查。

Fixes #15129。

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): preflight execution approvals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an execution preflight for maintainer-driven local `/verify-pr` rounds. Legacy watcher commands that omit `--execution` retain their container meaning, while a host or VM selection is now explicit and is validated before artifacts are created or untrusted PR code runs. A maintainer can trust their own or a same-repository PR locally with `--trust-pr-head` after an explicit decision, without publishing an approval comment. For another fork, an approval comment is coupled with a real in-flight watch registration bound to the matching repository, PR, head, and round. Reusing a completed round's comment no longer authorizes another execution. Publication compares the artifact declaration with prepare's host-held approval, requires the context digest, checks eligibility again, and canonicalizes the entire registration path so an intermediate symlink cannot redirect it into the PR clone.

## Why it's needed

The local workflow already said that host execution required a maintainer's approval, but the only executable check was performed while preparing the publication comment. A host round could therefore run the entire battery before asking for evidence that should have existed beforehand. This moves the supported workflow's checks earlier, makes approval externally auditable, and avoids turning a private trust decision for a maintainer's own or shared-repository PR into a mandatory public comment.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.md) and [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.zh-CN.md). They cover the compatibility choices, approval model, trust boundaries, test plan, and deferrals.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Confirm that a legacy coordinate prepare without `--execution` completes in container mode and does not create `executionApproval` or a host declaration. Verify that host or VM still requires an explicit execution selection and cannot silently inherit this compatibility default.
2. For a maintainer's own fork and for a same-repository collaboration PR, check explicit `--trust-pr-head`. The authenticated maintainer's own identity and write/maintain/admin permission are verified, the approval names the exact current head and round, and another fork or read-only identity fails before the artifact directory appears. Author or repository matching alone is not an automatic waiver.
3. For another fork, register the exact head and round, then use a marked maintainer approval comment with `--approval` and its PR-external `--state-root`. Preparing a retry while that registration is in flight works. After the real watch completion, repeating the same command fails with exit 3 rather than replaying the old approval into a later execution. Wrong heads, rounds, comment targets, permissions, and missing or nested-symlinked registration paths also fail before preparation succeeds.
4. Inspect a host/VM publication. The artifact declaration and the host-held `executionApproval` must be deeply equal and its context must match `--context-sha256`; a missing digest, altered permission/source/basis/comment/head/round, or forged PR-side context is refused. Existing container and CI-lane declarations should remain unaffected.
5. Run the six affected suites (`verify-pr-prepare`, `verify-pr-check`, `verify-pr-model-proxy`, `verify-pr-watch-state`, `verify-pr-guard`, and `qwen-triage-workflow`): 657 tests passed and 16 skipped on macOS. The real helper E2E matrix passed 81/81 cells, followed by a separate symlink-containment regression that failed before its fix and passed afterward. Four removal controls became red when the container default, registration check, declaration-write error handling, or containment guard was removed, then returned green after exact restoration.

Verification also passed `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, `node dist/cli.js --version` (0.28.0), `npm run format`, `npm run lint`, and `git diff --check`. A full scripts run with the macOS temporary-directory alias removed reported 5048 passed, 89 skipped, and one infrastructure-rerun timeout in an unchanged autofix test; that same test passed in isolation in 16.2 seconds. No assertion or timeout was weakened. The local E2E used disposable clones and fake `gh`, never a real PR battery or a GitHub write API.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for this non-UI change. The supporting local E2E log is `verify-pr-execution-preflight-revised-20261122-022953/report.md`; it records command exits, completed watch registrations, publication tamper cases, and the original in-flight retry versus completed-round replay. It is a git-ignored fixture log, not a PR code artifact.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 24.18.1 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

Local Node.js 24.18.1 with a frozen-lockfile install, full workspace build, targeted tests, real helper CLIs, disposable git clones, and fake GitHub responses. The `/var` to `/private/var` macOS alias was reproduced separately in the baseline lint-scope fixture; its unmodified test passes with `TMPDIR=/private/tmp`. No daemons, persistent watches, real approval comments, external-image uploads, or PR-battery execution were used in the E2E harness.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This is a fail-closed workflow around trusted prepare and publish commands, not an operating-system sandbox. It cannot prove that subsequent commands stay inside the chosen boundary or prevent a caller from bypassing prepare and opening a shell. It also validates maintainers through live GitHub identity and permission APIs, so transient preflight failures reject VM/host execution rather than silently degrading it.
- Not validated / out of scope: Prepare does not revalidate a comment's later deletion or the revocation of permission after the preflight. Mandatory execution confinement is deferred. The unrelated, load-sensitive autofix timeout remains an existing test-budget issue and is disclosed above rather than hidden.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: Legacy container coordinate calls remain compatible, including old watch snapshots. Legacy host/VM artifacts without the host-held approval and verified context digest are intentionally rejected: use a real container or run the new preflight. Comment-backed fresh rounds also need a real watch registration; a verifier for a maintainer's own or same-repository PR can instead use explicit `--trust-pr-head` without a public approval comment.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次改动

为维护者在本地发起的 `/verify-pr` 轮次增加执行预检。旧 watch 命令即使省略 `--execution`，仍保留原有 container 语义；宿主或 VM 则必须显式选择，并在创建产物或运行不可信 PR 代码之前完成验证。维护者明确决定后，可用 `--trust-pr-head` 在本地信任本人或同仓 PR，不必公开发布批准评论。对于他人的 fork，批准评论必须与真实 in-flight watch 注册配合，绑定对应的仓库、PR、head 和 round，完成后复用旧评论不能再授权新的执行。发布时把产物声明与 prepare 写入宿主侧的批准进行对账，强制核对 context digest 并重新检查资格；注册路径的完整规范化也会阻止中间软链把它带回 PR 克隆。

## 为什么需要

本地工作流原本就要求宿主执行前获得维护者批准，但唯一的机器检查在生成发布评论时才执行。宿主轮次因此可能先运行完整测试，再补上本应在执行前具备的批准证据。本 PR 将受支持流程中的检查前移，使批准可审计，并避免把维护者对本人或同仓 PR 的私人信任决定强制变成公开评论。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.md) 与 [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.zh-CN.md)，覆盖兼容选择、批准模型、信任边界、测试计划与后续事项。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 确认不带 `--execution` 的旧 coordinate prepare 仍能以 container 模式完成，且不产生 `executionApproval` 或宿主声明。宿主/VM 仍必须显式选择执行方式，不能通过该兼容默认值静默获得豁免。
2. 对维护者本人的 fork 与同仓协作 PR，验证显式 `--trust-pr-head`：会核验当前认证维护者以及其 write/maintain/admin 权限，批准绑定当前完整 head 和 round；他人 fork 或只读身份在创建产物目录之前失败。作者或仓库匹配单独并不构成自动豁免。
3. 对他人 fork，先注册精确 head 与 round，再将带标记的维护者批准评论连同 `--approval`、位于 PR 外的 `--state-root` 一起使用。原注册仍在 in-flight 时允许重试 prepare；真实 watch 完成后，同一命令必须以 exit 3 拒绝，不能把旧批准重放到后续执行。错误 head、round、评论目标、权限，以及缺失或嵌套软链的注册路径，也都会在 prepare 成功前失败。
4. 检查宿主/VM 发布内容：产物声明与宿主持有的 `executionApproval` 必须深度相同，context 必须匹配 `--context-sha256`；缺少 digest，篡改 permission/source/basis/comment/head/round，或伪造 PR 侧 context，都必须被拒绝。原有 container 与 CI-lane 声明不受影响。
5. 运行六套受影响测试（`verify-pr-prepare`、`verify-pr-check`、`verify-pr-model-proxy`、`verify-pr-watch-state`、`verify-pr-guard`、`qwen-triage-workflow`）：macOS 上 657 passed、16 skipped。真实 helper E2E 通过 81/81 格，随后另行的软链 containment 回归在修复前失败、修复后通过。四个去修复对照分别在移除 container 默认值、注册校验、声明写入异常处理或 containment 守卫时转红，恢复原实现后转绿。

同时已通过 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、`node dist/cli.js --version`（0.28.0）、`npm run format`、`npm run lint` 与 `git diff --check`。移除 macOS 临时目录别名后的全量脚本测试报告 5048 passed、89 skipped、1 个既有 autofix 基础设施重跑用例超时；同一用例独立运行以 16.2 秒通过。没有弱化任何断言或超时。全部 E2E 使用一次性克隆与 fake `gh`，未执行真实 PR 电池或 GitHub 写接口。

### Before / After 证据

本改动不涉及 UI。辅助证据留存于本地 `verify-pr-execution-preflight-revised-20261122-022953/report.md`，包含命令退出状态、完整 watch 注册、发布篡改矩阵，以及原 in-flight 重试与完成后重放的区别。该文件是 git-ignored 测试日志，不属于要提交的代码产物。

### 已测试系统

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 24.18.1 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

本机 Node.js 24.18.1，按 lockfile 安装依赖，完整构建工作区，并运行目标测试、真实 helper CLI、一次性 git 克隆与 fake GitHub 响应。已在基线 lint-scope 夹具中单独复现 macOS 的 `/var` 到 `/private/var` 路径别名；未修改的测试在 `TMPDIR=/private/tmp` 下通过。E2E 没有使用 daemon、持久 watch、真实批准评论、外部图床或 PR 电池。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：这是围绕可信 prepare 与发布命令的 fail-closed 流程，不是操作系统沙箱。它不能证明后续命令始终在所选边界内，也不能阻止调用方绕过 prepare 另开 shell。预检还通过实时 GitHub 身份与权限 API 验证维护者，若 API 暂时失败，VM/宿主执行将失败而不是静默降级。
- 未验证或不属于本次范围：prepare 不重新验证评论后来被删除或权限后来被撤销的情况；强制 confinement 留给后续工作。上述无关且受负载影响的 autofix 超时仍是既有测试预算问题，已披露而不是隐藏。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：旧 container coordinate 调用以及旧 watch 快照保持兼容。缺少宿主批准及已验证 context digest 的旧宿主/VM 产物会被有意拒绝，应使用真实容器或执行新的预检。评论批准的新轮次还需要真实 watch 注册；验证维护者本人或同仓 PR 时，可以改为显式 `--trust-pr-head`，无需公开批准评论。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): wire external foreground Shell into Broker and Control Plane [17357 B/2]
prs.body:
Split from #17357 at source commit `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219`; candidate B: `5f746c523b309`. This is **[17357 B/2]** — the Runtime Broker dispatch/cancel/reconcile/close fences and Control Plane profile negotiation for the external foreground-Shell lane, stacked on #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**) (`split/16023-resident-workspace`) and #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) (`split/17357-worker-and-producer`).

## What this PR does

Wires the external foreground-Shell profile (`hosted-workspace-external-shell/1`) through the Control Plane, External Workspace Provisioner, and Runtime Broker:
- **Broker move-before-settle fences**: extracts `RuntimeExecutionExternalShell`, `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission`, and `RuntimeToolAcknowledgements` from `RuntimeBrokerService` and `RuntimeExecutionDispatcher` (lowering `RuntimeBrokerService` from 2028 to 2006). Before dispatching a foreground Shell on an external worker, the Broker opens the worker's capture channel; after the worker finishes, the Broker moves the captured bytes into the control plane's publication via `ExternalShellPublication` and rebuilds the result envelope before settling the execution row.
- **Cancel, reconcile, and close drain proofs**: prevents a worker's raw settled status from settling an un-moved external Shell record on the cancel or reconcile paths, while allowing a proven `not_started` receipt or an already-finished publication to settle cleanly. Session close and Workspace drain require the worker's drained-stop proof and refuse to release storage while an external Shell execution is unsettled.
- **Control Plane & Provisioner negotiation**: gates `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` behind `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` (default `false`), requires durable tool publication and `default` or `auto-edit` approval mode, pins handle version 2 on `ExternalWorkspaceProvisioner`, and verifies worker publication readiness during placement establishment/reconcile without adding an extra HTTP exchange to every live dispatch confirm.

## Why it's needed

Even with the worker capture routes and producer store from #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**), the Broker and Control Plane must guarantee that a worker's local completion never settles the execution record or releases storage before the captured bytes have been durably published in the control plane. Splitting these 53 Broker/Control-Plane files (+2,782/−468) from the 31 worker/producer files in A/2 isolates the state-machine and lifecycle fences for focused review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Broker dispatch lane, drain proof, close recovery, and profile unit tests from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest,ExternalShellDrainProofTest,ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

And against disposable MySQL 8.4:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dit.test=ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

Expected:
- `ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest` (9 tests), `ExternalShellDrainProofTest` (6 tests), `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest` (6 tests on H2), and `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT` (6 tests on MySQL 8.4) all pass.
- Requesting `toolProfile` without a bound Workspace returns `400 invalid_tool_profile`, and replaying a recorded Session creation succeeds before the live 409 capability check.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend Broker and Control Plane wiring with generated OpenAPI client types.

```text
ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest        Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellDrainProofTest          Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest       Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (H2)
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT    Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (MySQL 8.4.11)
WorkspaceToolProfilesTest            Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                  BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) and disposable MySQL 8.4.11 on macOS.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Broker sits on the byte-moving critical path before settling any external foreground Shell execution, so an unreachable or unacknowledged worker capture keeps the execution recoverable (`UNKNOWN`) and blocks Session close rather than losing output.
- Not validated / out of scope: worker capture routes and `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` implementation details are covered in #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**). Background Shell and `monitor` remain out of scope for external workers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing placements. `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` defaults to `false`.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512 (phase 2, slice C). Split from #17357 (`[17357 B/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #17357 的源码提交 `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219` 拆分而来；候选提交 B 为 `5f746c523b309`。本 PR 是 **[17357 B/2]** —— 包含外部前台 Shell 通道在 Runtime Broker 的派发/取消/对账/关闭围栏以及控制面 profile 协商，堆叠在 #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**)（`split/16023-resident-workspace`）与 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**)（`split/17357-worker-and-producer`）之上。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

将外部前台 Shell profile（`hosted-workspace-external-shell/1`）贯通至控制面、External Workspace Provisioner 与 Runtime Broker：
- **Broker「先搬运后结算」围栏**：从 `RuntimeBrokerService` 与 `RuntimeExecutionDispatcher` 中抽离 `RuntimeExecutionExternalShell`、`RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` 和 `RuntimeToolAcknowledgements`（将 `RuntimeBrokerService` 从 2028 行降至 2006 行）。在向外部 worker 派发前台 Shell 前，Broker 先打开 worker 的 capture 通道；待 worker 执行结束后，Broker 通过 `ExternalShellPublication` 将捕获字节搬入控制面 publication 并重建结果信封，随后才结算执行记录。
- **取消、对账与关闭排空证明**：防止取消或对账路径仅凭 worker 返回的 settled 状态直接结算尚未完成搬运的外部 Shell 记录，同时允许已证实的 `not_started` 回执或已完成搬运的 publication 正常结算。Session 关闭与 Workspace 排空要求校验 worker 的 drained-stop 证明，在外部 Shell 执行未结算前拒绝释放存储。
- **控制面与 Provisioner 协商**：将 `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` 置于独立开关 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled`（默认 `false`）之后，强制要求启用持久化 tool publication 以及 `default` 或 `auto-edit` 审批模式；在 `ExternalWorkspaceProvisioner` 上使用独立的 handle 版本 2，并在建立或对账 placement 时校验 worker 的 publication 就绪状态（日常存活确认不增加额外 HTTP 往返）。

## 为什么需要它

在 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 提供了 worker 捕获路由与 producer 存储的基础上，Broker 与控制面还必须确保：绝不能在捕获字节持久化到控制面之前仅凭 worker 的本地完成状态就结算记录或释放存储。将这 53 个 Broker/控制面文件（+2,782/−468）从 A/2 的 31 个 worker/producer 文件中拆出，便于集中评审状态机与生命周期围栏。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行 Broker 派发通道、排空证明、关闭恢复与 profile 单元测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest,ExternalShellDrainProofTest,ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

以及基于 MySQL 8.4 的集成验证：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dit.test=ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

预期行为：
- `ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest`（9 个用例）、`ExternalShellDrainProofTest`（6 个用例）、`ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest`（H2 6 个用例）与 `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT`（MySQL 8.4 6 个用例）全部通过。
- 未绑定 Workspace 时请求 `toolProfile` 返回 `400 invalid_tool_profile`，且已记录的 Session 创建幂等重放在实时 409 能力检查前直接返回。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯后端 Broker 与控制面编排及自动生成的 OpenAPI 类型）。

```text
ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest        Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellDrainProofTest          Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest       Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (H2)
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT    Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (MySQL 8.4.11)
WorkspaceToolProfilesTest            Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                  BUILD SUCCESS (全部 15 个模块通过)
```

### 测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
|  🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明（可选）

macOS 本地 JDK 21（`openjdk@21`）与临时 MySQL 8.4.11。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Broker 位于每次外部前台 Shell 结算前的字节搬运关键路径上；若 worker 捕获通道不可达或未完成确认，记录将保持可恢复的 `UNKNOWN` 状态并阻止关闭 Session，而不会丢失输出。
- 未验证 / 范围外：worker 捕获路由与 `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` 的实现细节由 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 覆盖；后台 Shell 与 `monitor` 仍不在外部 worker 支持范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对存量 placement 无影响。`qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` 默认为 `false`。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #15512（phase 2, slice C）。拆自 #17357（`[17357 B/2]`）。
