prs.title: feat(cli): refuse new sessions under sustained host load
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds load-based admission to the daemon's fresh-session path. A periodic monitor samples host load (load average per core) and the daemon's own event-loop lag; while either signal stays past conservative enter thresholds for three consecutive samples, new child spawns — session create, load, resume, and branch — are refused with `503 system_overloaded` and `Retry-After: 15`. Existing sessions and the control plane (prompt, cancel, detach, status, SSE) are never gated. The decision is observable on `GET /daemon/status` through a `runtime.loadAdmission` section and a `system_overloaded` issue, and operators can opt out with `--no-load-admission`. The design is documented in [English](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.md) and [简体中文](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Under heavy host load the daemon kept admitting new tasks. Each task spawns a full ACP child process, so every admission deepens the saturation until the daemon's single event loop starves and even cancel and status stop responding in time — the daemon appears hung, and continuing to create tasks makes it worse. Every existing admission gate is count-based (per-workspace and daemon-wide session caps, per-session prompt caps) and says nothing about what the machine can actually run; the memory budget module is explicitly descriptive only. Failing fast with a retryable refusal keeps the control plane usable during overload and lets load drain instead of compounding the freeze.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: from `packages/cli`, run `npx vitest run src/serve/load-admission.test.ts src/serve/load-admission-signals.test.ts src/serve/total-session-admission.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve-load-admission.test.ts src/serve/server-default-bridge-wiring.test.ts` — these cover the per-signal enter/exit/debounce matrix, the nanosecond-to-millisecond conversion and histogram enable/reset/disable lifecycle, gate refusal without consuming a reservation, monitor dispose on daemon close, the opt-out gate on both the orchestrator and the standalone app factory, and the REST/RPC error mappings.

Live level: build and bundle, then run `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4191 --workspace <fresh-tmp-dir>` with an isolated `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. Create a session while the host is healthy. Raise host load (for example CPU burners totaling twice the core count) until `load1 / cores` stays at or above 2 for about six seconds, then `POST /session` again: expect `503` with `Retry-After: 15` and a body carrying `code: "system_overloaded"`, `reason: "cpu_load"`, `loadRatio`, and `eventLoopLagP99Ms`, and expect no new child process. While overloaded, the healthy session's prompt admission, cancel, status, and SSE stream must still work, and `GET /daemon/status` must report `runtime.loadAdmission.overloaded: true` plus the `system_overloaded` issue. Stop the load and wait for the average to decay below the exit threshold plus the debounce: creates are admitted again and the issue disappears. Re-run the same load against a daemon started with `--no-load-admission`: creates are admitted and status reports `enabled: false`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (baseline 0.28.3, host load ratio 2.23): `POST /session` returns 200 and spawns a child — no gate exists. After (this branch, same load shape): `POST /session` returns 503 `system_overloaded` with the readings, the control plane stays usable, and the full E2E matrix passes 17/17 including opt-out and recovery. Screenshots below.

![Baseline 0.28.3 admits a new session under host load ratio 2.23](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/before.png)

![This branch refuses the same create with 503 system_overloaded and Retry-After 15](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/after-503.png)

![Full E2E matrix on the main-base bundle: 17/17 pass including control plane, opt-out, and recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/e2e-pass.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Windows note: `os.loadavg()` is zero there by platform design, so the CPU signal is inert and the event-loop lag signal carries the gate; this is documented in the design's constraints.

### Environment (optional)

Local build (`npm run build && npm run bundle`), loopback bind, isolated `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` and workspace per daemon; load produced by nice-19 CPU burners so the run queue fills without starving unrelated work on the shared host.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: false refusals on IO-heavy hosts (Linux load average counts uninterruptible IO wait) or cgroup-constrained containers (load average is host-wide). Conservative thresholds (ratio 2.0 enter / 1.0 exit, lag p99 1000 ms enter / 250 ms exit, three 2-second samples to flip) plus `--no-load-admission` bound the impact; every refusal is visible in the status issue, the daemon log, and the client toast, and the gate never touches work already admitted.
- Not validated / out of scope: live macOS/Windows runs; cgroup-scoped CPU pressure and a memory-pressure signal are follow-ups; the Web Shell overload banner and create-button disabling driven by the new status section are a separate follow-up slice.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new flag defaults on, the status field is additive, and the new 503 code only appears under sustained saturation that previously compounded into a freeze.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 daemon 的新建会话路径增加基于负荷的准入。周期监视器采样主机负荷（每核 load average）与 daemon 自身事件循环延迟；任一信号连续三次采样超过保守进入阈值期间，新建子进程——会话 create、load、resume、branch——以 `503 system_overloaded` 与 `Retry-After: 15` 拒绝。已有会话与控制面（prompt、cancel、detach、status、SSE）永不设闸。决策通过 `GET /daemon/status` 的 `runtime.loadAdmission` 节与 `system_overloaded` issue 可观测，运维可用 `--no-load-admission` 退出。设计文档见 [English](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.md) 与 [简体中文](docs/design/load-based-session-admission.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

主机高负荷时 daemon 仍继续放行新建任务。每个任务 spawn 一个完整 ACP 子进程，于是每次放行都在加深饱和，直到 daemon 的单事件循环被饿死、连 cancel 与 status 都无法及时响应——表现为 daemon 卡死，而继续新建只会更糟。现有准入闸门全部是计数型的（每 workspace 与全局会话上限、每会话 prompt 上限），无法反映机器实际能运行多少；内存预算模块明确只是描述性的。以可重试的拒绝快速失败，能让过载期间控制面保持可用、让负荷消退，而不是把卡死越叠越深。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

单元级：在 `packages/cli` 下跑 `npx vitest run src/serve/load-admission.test.ts src/serve/load-admission-signals.test.ts src/serve/total-session-admission.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve-load-admission.test.ts src/serve/server-default-bridge-wiring.test.ts`——覆盖逐信号进入/退出/去抖矩阵、纳秒到毫秒换算与直方图 enable/reset/disable 生命周期、不消耗预留名额的闸门拒绝、daemon 关闭时监视器 dispose、编排器与独立 app 工厂两条路径的 opt-out 闸门、REST/RPC 错误映射。

实机级：build 并 bundle 后，以隔离 `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` 跑 `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4191 --workspace <新临时目录>`。主机健康时创建一个会话。抬高主机负荷（例如总计两倍核数的 CPU burner）使 `load1 / cores` 持续 ≥ 2 约六秒，再 `POST /session`：应得 `503`、`Retry-After: 15`、body 带 `code: "system_overloaded"`、`reason: "cpu_load"`、`loadRatio`、`eventLoopLagP99Ms`，且无新子进程。过载期间健康会话的 prompt 准入、cancel、status、SSE 流必须仍可用，`GET /daemon/status` 必须报告 `runtime.loadAdmission.overloaded: true` 与 `system_overloaded` issue。停止负荷并等均值衰减到退出阈值以下再加去抖时间：新建重新放行、issue 消失。同一负荷下对以 `--no-load-admission` 启动的 daemon 重跑：新建放行、status 报告 `enabled: false`。

### 证据（前后对照）

前（基线 0.28.3、主机负荷比 2.23）：`POST /session` 返回 200 并 spawn 子进程——不存在闸门。后（本分支、同负荷形态）：`POST /session` 返回 503 `system_overloaded` 带实测读数，控制面保持可用，完整 E2E 矩阵 17/17 通过（含 opt-out 与恢复）。截图见下。

![基线 0.28.3 在主机负荷比 2.23 下仍放行新建会话](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/before.png)

![本分支对同形态新建返回 503 system_overloaded 与 Retry-After 15](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/after-503.png)

![main 基 bundle 的完整 E2E 矩阵：17/17 通过，含控制面、opt-out 与恢复](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/load-admission/e2e-pass.png)

### 测试平台

Linux ✅ 实测；macOS ⚠️ 未实测；Windows ⚠️ 未实测（该平台 `os.loadavg()` 恒零属平台设计，CPU 信号失效、由事件循环延迟信号承担闸门，已写入设计约束）。

### 环境

本地构建（`npm run build && npm run bundle`）、loopback 绑定、每 daemon 隔离 `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` 与 workspace；负荷由 nice-19 CPU burner 产生，占满运行队列但不饿死共享主机上的无关工作。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：IO 密集主机（Linux load average 计入不可中断 IO 等待）或 cgroup 受限容器（load average 是主机-wide）可能误拒。保守阈值（ratio 2.0 进入 / 1.0 退出、lag p99 1000 ms 进入 / 250 ms 退出、3 次 2 秒采样才翻转）加 `--no-load-admission` 限定影响；每次拒绝在 status issue、daemon 日志、客户端 toast 可见，且闸门绝不触碰已放行的工作。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows 实机；cgroup 作用域 CPU 压力与内存压力信号为后续；由新 status 节驱动的 Web Shell 过载横幅与新建按钮禁用是独立后续切片。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。新 flag 默认开启，status 字段为加性，新 503 码只在持续饱和（此前会叠成卡死）时出现。

## 关联 Issue

无

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): share resident external Workspace across sessions [16023 B/2]
prs.body:
Split from #16023 at source commit `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935` (base `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e` on `main`); candidate B: `87766f263a51a`. This is **[16023 B/2]** — the shared resident external Workspace lifecycle, read-only concurrent dispatch, reattach, recovery/retirement services, and `EPHEMERAL` storage registration, separated from the unbound Session principal ownership migration in #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**). This PR targets `main` directly and compiles and runs independently of A/2.

## What this PR does

Adds the resident external-Workspace increment: a Session that needs an external Workspace tool provisions one worker, and later Sessions and Turns reuse that same Workspace-scoped binding instead of each closing cycle destroying it. Closing one Session becomes a membership release rather than a teardown of the shared binding.

It also lands the admission and lifecycle machinery that increment requires:
- Durable binding lookup (`findLatestForRequest`), trusted-startup recovery (`ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryService`, `RuntimeProvisionLostRecovery`), and terminal retirement (`ExternalWorkspaceRetirementService`) that refuse active or `UNKNOWN` executions and never auto-replace a `LIVE` or indeterminate runtime.
- Provider reattachment (`reattach`) for resident external Workspaces when an `observe` returns `UNKNOWN` after a provider restart, verifying the original endpoint and identity without provisioning a replacement.
- Read-only dispatch classification (`VerifiedDispatchPayload`, `shared_dispatch_class`) so verified read-only file tools run concurrently while writes stay fenced behind the binding, with a bounded shared-dispatch wait that settles stranded `PREPARED` rows at deadline.
- `EPHEMERAL` sandbox-owned Workspace registration sharing the same admission, ownership, migration, schema-projection, and inventory-eligibility rules as `EXTERNAL`.

## Why it's needed

Today an external Workspace cannot outlive the Session that first used it: closing the Session releases the binding and the next Session pays provisioning again, while concurrent readers queue behind the same fence as writers even when they cannot mutate anything. Separating this 70-file runtime and persistence increment (+4,676/−795) from the 99-file unbound Session principal migration (+7,684/−1,052) cuts the review surface in half and keeps this PR focused strictly on external Workspace binding lifetime, concurrency, and recovery fences.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused unit and H2 persistence suites from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalWorkspaceRetirementServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceOwnershipTest,ExternalWorkspaceMaterializationTest,ExternalWorkspaceProvisionerTest,ExternalRuntimeProvisionerTest,ExternalHttpRuntimeClientTest,ExternalWorkspaceBootContractTest,RuntimeBindingSessionReleaseTest,SharedExternalDispatchTest,RuntimeExecutionDispatcherTest
```

Expected:
- A second Session joining the same external Workspace reuses the active Workspace-isolated binding; closing the first Session releases only its membership while the last member under a storage retirement fence clears `ma_storage_owner`.
- Read-only file tools run concurrently on a shared external binding while write tools and `UNKNOWN` executions fence concurrent writes until settled or deadline-refused.
- Provider `UNKNOWN` on a resident Workspace triggers an authenticated `/runtime/reattach` against the saved original endpoint without provisioning a replacement; endpoint drift or `GONE` fails closed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend runtime broker and persistence change with no TUI/UI surface.

Local verification on macOS (JDK 21):

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) for offline reactor compilation; Linux and MySQL 8.4 lanes run in CI against `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: reshaping Workspace binding lifetime and session-close semantics is security- and data-safety-critical — a bug would either tear down a Workspace while another Session still uses it or replace a worker whose state is unknown. Two class-size ratchet pins rise with explicit design-doc annotations (`JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository` 2319 → 2360 and `RuntimeBrokerService` 1909 → 2028; note that #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) subsequently extracts `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` and lowers `RuntimeBrokerService` back down to 2006).
- Not validated / out of scope: unbound Session principal ownership (`ma_session_principal`) is in #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**). Foreground external Shell execution is in #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) and #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: adds `shared_dispatch_class VARCHAR(16)` to `ma_tool_execution` in `V1__managed_schema.sql` and adds `reattach` to `ExternalRuntimeClient`.

Design:
- [Reattach the original external Workspace worker (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.zh-CN.md)
- [Retire external Workspaces after settled failures (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.zh-CN.md)
- [Class-size ratchet exception note (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #15512, #15247. Split from #16023 (`[16023 B/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #16023 的源码提交 `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935`（基于 `main` 的 `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e`）拆分而来；候选提交 B 为 `87766f263a51a`。本 PR 是 **[16023 B/2]** —— 包含常驻外部 Workspace 跨会话生命周期、只读并发派发、provider `reattach`、恢复与退役服务以及 `EPHEMERAL` 存储注册，与 #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**)（无绑定 Session principal 归属迁移）解耦。本 PR 直接以 `main` 为 base，可独立于 A/2 编译和运行。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

落地「常驻外部 Workspace」增量：某个 Session 首次需要外部 Workspace 工具时创建一次 worker，之后的其他 Session 与 Turn 复用同一个 Workspace 作用域的绑定，而不是在每次关闭周期都销毁它。关闭单个 Session 变成成员释放，而不再拆除共享绑定。

同时补齐该增量所需的准入与生命周期机制：
- 持久化绑定查询（`findLatestForRequest`）、可信启动恢复（`ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryService`、`RuntimeProvisionLostRecovery`）与终态退役（`ExternalWorkspaceRetirementService`），拒绝存在活跃或 `UNKNOWN` 执行的操作，且绝不自动替换 `LIVE` 或状态不确定的 runtime。
- 常驻外部 Workspace 的 provider 重连（`reattach`）：当 provider 进程重启后 `observe` 返回 `UNKNOWN` 时，携带原 boot、scope、handle 和 endpoint 重连原 worker，绝不新建替换实例。
- 只读派发分类（`VerifiedDispatchPayload`、`shared_dispatch_class`）：经摘要校验的只读文件工具可并发执行，写操作仍受绑定级互斥围栏保护，并为共享派发等待设置超时上限，到期自动结算滞留的 `PREPARED` 记录。
- `EPHEMERAL` 沙箱自有 Workspace 注册：与 `EXTERNAL` 共享同一套准入、归属、迁移、Schema 投影与可用性判定规则。

## 为什么需要它

此前外部 Workspace 无法跨越首次使用它的 Session 存活：关闭 Session 会释放绑定，下一个 Session 必须重新创建 worker；同时只读并发请求也会排在写锁后面。将这 70 个文件的运行时与持久化改动（+4,676/−795）与 99 个文件的无绑定 Session principal 迁移（+7,684/−1,052）拆开后，评审面缩减一半，且可以直接基于 `main` 触发全量 CI。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行常驻外部 Workspace 相关的单元与持久化测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalWorkspaceRetirementServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceOwnershipTest,ExternalWorkspaceMaterializationTest,ExternalWorkspaceProvisionerTest,ExternalRuntimeProvisionerTest,ExternalHttpRuntimeClientTest,ExternalWorkspaceBootContractTest,RuntimeBindingSessionReleaseTest,SharedExternalDispatchTest,RuntimeExecutionDispatcherTest
```

预期行为：
- 第二个 Session 加入同一外部 Workspace 时复用活跃的 Workspace 隔离绑定；关闭第一个 Session 仅释放其成员资格，只有在存储退役围栏下释放最后一个成员时才清空 `ma_storage_owner`。
- 只读文件工具在共享外部绑定上可并发执行，而写工具和 `UNKNOWN` 执行会围栏后续写操作，直到结算或超时拒绝。
- 常驻 Workspace 在 `observe` 返回 `UNKNOWN` 时会向原保存的 endpoint 发起带鉴权的 `/runtime/reattach`，不会新建替换实例；endpoint 漂移或 `GONE` 均 fail-closed。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯后端 Runtime Broker 与持久化变更）。

本地 macOS（JDK 21）验证：

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (全部 15 个模块通过)
```

### 测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
|  🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明（可选）

本地使用 JDK 21（`openjdk@21`）完成离线全模块编译校验；Linux 与 MySQL 8.4 通道由针对 `main` 的 CI 执行。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：重塑 Workspace 绑定生命周期与 Session 关闭语义涉及跨会话数据安全 —— 任何缺陷都会表现为在其他 Session 仍在使用时销毁 Workspace，或在状态未知时静默替换 worker。两个类尺寸 ratchet 上限带有明确的设计文档例外说明（`JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository` 2319 → 2360，`RuntimeBrokerService` 1909 → 2028；其中 `RuntimeBrokerService` 在后续 #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) 抽离 `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` 后进一步回落至 2006）。
- 未验证 / 范围外：无绑定 Session principal 归属（`ma_session_principal`）位于 #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**)；外部前台 Shell 执行位于 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 与 #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**)。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：在 `V1__managed_schema.sql` 的 `ma_tool_execution` 表中新增 `shared_dispatch_class VARCHAR(16)`，并在 `ExternalRuntimeClient` SPI 中新增 `reattach`。

设计文档：
- [Reattach the original external Workspace worker (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.zh-CN.md)
- [Retire external Workspaces after settled failures (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.zh-CN.md)
- [Class-size ratchet exception note (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15512、#15247。拆自 #16023（`[16023 B/2]`）。

</details>

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): design Action parking (stateless Harness phase 4)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds the pre-implementation design for Phase 4 of the stateless Hosted Harness, Action parking, in English and Chinese, and links it from the parent design's Phase 4 section. Today a Turn that waits for a tool approval or a user question pins its Session to the Harness: the waiting Turn lives in process memory, and the control-plane coordinator also holds the Turn's dispatch lease and event stream for the whole wait.

The design parks such a Turn instead. When the Session goes idle, the Harness freezes the in-process wait without aborting it, which leaves the journal exactly as a crash at the wait point would, then suspends the Session through the existing Phase 1 flow and writes a park certificate on the seal. The coordinator reads the certificate when the stream ends and parks the Turn row until the Action's expiry or the Turn deadline. A decision, a cancellation, or an approval-mode change unparks the Turn in its own transaction, and the Turn resumes on any pool member through the cold recovery that G3 step 3 already implements and fault-tests. Park eligibility shares one predicate with that recovery arm so the two cannot drift, and the first increment covers only waits that recovery accepts today: no Hooks or MCP, a captured continuation, a Turn dispatched by the control plane, and a root Session.

## Why it's needed

Phases 1 to 3 let idle Sessions, Sessions with delayed wake inputs, and Sessions with background work leave the Harness, but a Session waiting on a human decision still stays resident. That is the last common blocker before the idle period can shrink toward zero, which is the stateless end state. The design also records two findings. Under today's defaults (a 10-minute approval timeout, a 10-minute idle period, and a 30-minute Turn deadline) parking almost never triggers, so its value is mainly for the zero-idle end state and for deployments with longer deadlines. And the parent design's "Managed Runtime continue path" is not what resumes approval waits, so this PR corrects that reference in the parent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This is a documentation-only change. Confirm that both language versions have matching sections, decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and open questions; that the parent design links to the new design in both languages; and that the cited code locations match `main`.

The points that most deserve scrutiny are the argument for freezing the wait instead of aborting it, the conditions of the park compare-and-set and the transactions that unpark (including the approval revision carried in the certificate, so that a mode change committed before the park is not lost until expiry), and the dependency on wake dispatch being enabled, since the certificate rides on the wake stamp that is only sent when wake dispatch is on.

Local checks: Prettier passes on all four files, every relative link resolves, and the heading levels of the two versions match one-to-one.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — formatting and reference checks only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the benefit under default settings is small. The design does not add a shorter dedicated park delay and leaves that decision to measurement. The implementation overlaps the files that #17953 changes, so it should start after that PR merges.
- Not validated / out of scope: no code is changed. Two assumptions are marked for test confirmation before implementation: that the load triggered by decision delivery enters the cold-recovery arm (the code sets the passive recovery flag on that load, which supports it), and that the recovered driver rebuilds the approval-mode poll. Sessions with Hooks or MCP, child Sessions, Turns started by wake inputs, and team plan approvals stay resident in the first increment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none, since this is documentation only. The proposed implementation adds three nullable Session head columns by editing the V1 schema baseline in place, and a default-off setting that requires wake dispatch to be enabled.

Design document: [`docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.md`](docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.md) and [`docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

References #17527 (stateless Hosted Harness design). Related: #17953 (Phase 3b) and #17908 (wake seal stamp).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 新增无状态 Hosted Harness 第四阶段「审批停靠」的实现前设计（中英两版），并在父设计的第四阶段一节加上指向它的链接。今天，一个等待工具审批或用户提问的 Turn 会把它的 Session 钉在 Harness 上：等待中的 Turn 住在进程内存里，控制面协调器在整个等待期间也一直持有该 Turn 的派发租约和事件流。

本设计改为停靠这类 Turn。Session 空闲时，Harness 冻结进程内的等待而不 abort 它，这让 journal 的状态与"进程恰好在等待点崩溃"完全相同；随后经第一阶段已有的流程挂起 Session，并在 seal 上写一份停靠证书。协调器在事件流结束时读取证书，把 Turn 行停靠到 Action 过期或 Turn deadline 为止。决定、取消或审批模式变更在各自的事务里解除停靠，Turn 经 G3 第三步已经实现并有故障测试覆盖的冷恢复，在任意池成员上继续执行。停靠资格与该恢复臂共用一个判断函数，两者不会漂移；第一增量只覆盖恢复今天已经接受的等待：没有 Hooks 或 MCP、续跑证据已捕获、由控制面派发的 Turn、根 Session。

## 为什么需要

第一到第三阶段已经让空闲 Session、带延时 wake 输入的 Session 和带后台工作的 Session 可以离开 Harness，但等待人工决定的 Session 仍然常驻。这是空闲时长缩短到零（即无状态终态）之前最后一个常见阻塞。设计中还记录了两个发现。在今天的默认值下（审批超时 10 分钟、空闲时长 10 分钟、Turn deadline 30 分钟），停靠几乎不会触发，所以它的价值主要在于零空闲的终态，以及调长了 deadline 的部署。另外，父设计所说的"Managed Runtime continue 路径"并不是恢复审批等待的路径，本 PR 在父设计中修正了这一说法。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

这是纯文档改动。请确认两种语言版本的章节、决定、约束、验收标准与开放问题一致；父设计在两种语言中都链接到新设计；引用的代码位置与 `main` 相符。

最值得仔细审查的是：冻结等待而不是 abort 的论证；停靠 CAS 的条件与解除停靠的事务（包括证书携带的审批修订号，使先于停靠提交的模式变更不会一直丢到过期）；以及对 wake dispatch 已开启的依赖——证书挂在 wake 戳上，而 wake 戳只在 wake dispatch 开启时才发送。

本地检查：四个文件都通过 Prettier，所有相对链接都能解析，两种语言的标题层级逐一对应。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 纯文档。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ✅；🪟 Windows N/A；🐧 Linux N/A。

### 环境

N/A —— 只做了格式与引用检查。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：默认配置下收益很小。设计没有新增单独的、更短的停靠延迟，把这个决定留给测量。实现会和 #17953 改动的文件重叠，因此应在该 PR 合入后再开始。
- 未验证/范围外：没有代码改动。设计中有两个假设标注为实现前需用测试确认：决定投递触发的加载会进入冷恢复臂（代码在这次加载上设置了被动恢复标志，支持这一点），以及恢复后的 driver 会重建审批模式轮询。带 Hooks 或 MCP 的 Session、子 Session、wake 输入触发的 Turn 和团队计划审批，在第一增量中保持常驻。
- 破坏性改动/迁移：无，本 PR 只有文档。拟议的实现会通过原地修改 V1 schema 基线，为 Session head 新增三个可空列，并新增一个默认关闭、且要求 wake dispatch 已开启的设置。

设计文档：[`docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.md`](docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.md) 与 [`docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #17527（无状态 Hosted Harness 设计）。相关：#17953（Phase 3b）与 #17908（wake seal 戳）。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Re-pins the RHEL 10 rpm build root in the desktop release matrix to the CentOS Stream 10 digest currently published on quay.io (`sha256:a266f7ae…`, published 2026-11-19).

## Why it's needed

The digest pinned by #16897 (`sha256:5eaff839…`, the 2026-11-10 manifest) has been garbage-collected from quay.io. Every nightly Desktop Checks run since then — 44922669064 and the two runs before it — fails the RHEL 10 leg at "Initialize containers" with `manifest unknown`, before any build step runs. This is the same manual renewal #16261 and #16897 performed; the pin itself stays (the desktop release checks reject a mutable tag for this leg), and #16909 tracks automating the renewal.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the new digest resolves on quay.io while the old one does not:

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" https://quay.io/v2/centos/centos/manifests/sha256:a266f7ae08c4b3f5d0eaaa8a500201d40d260ecdfa81e49991fe8d27699d69e9
# → 200
```

The nightly Desktop Checks RHEL 10 leg should get past "Initialize containers" again after merge.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Verified locally: `node scripts/test-release.js` (desktop release helper checks, including the digest-pin format gate), the workflow meta-tests `scripts/tests/release-workflow.test.js`, `desktop-isolation.test.js`, `desktop-oss-workflow.test.js`, and `yamllint`/`actionlint` on the edited workflow. The manifest-200 check above was run against quay.io.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new pin rots again when CentOS Stream next prunes manifests (historically ~weekly); #16909 is the durable fix.
- Not validated / out of scope: the rpm leg itself was not built locally (it only runs in the release container); automating the renewal is out of scope and tracked by #16909.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16909 (does not close it — that issue tracks automating this renewal).

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): use plaintext identity segments in OSS object keys
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Externalized objects in the managed-agent server's private OSS bucket — oversized session resources, compacted journal packs, and tool publication outputs — are now addressed by plaintext tenant/workspace/session identity segments instead of an opaque SHA-256 scope hash, and publication slot names are kept verbatim rather than hashed. SQL identity keys, the stored object-key column, and every read path are unchanged. A bilingual design document records the layouts, the boundary validations the paths rely on, and the key-length budget.

## Why it's needed

Operators browsing the bucket console could not tell which tenant, workspace, or session an object belonged to without first querying SQL to map identities to hashes; debugging and storage audits paid that lookup for every object. Plaintext paths make the bucket browsable by tenant → workspace → session → tool call → output slot. The feature is unreleased, so no migration or compatibility with the hashed layout is needed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Non-user-visible storage refactor. From `packages/managed-agent-server` (JDK 21, Maven 3.8.9+), run the focused regressions: `mvn -pl verification -Dtest="SessionOssStorageTest,JournalPackTransactionRegressionTest,JournalPackDeletionRegressionTest" test`, then `mvn -pl verification -Dtest="ToolPublicationStoreTest" test`, then `mvn -pl persistence checkstyle:check`. Expect all green: the session-resource and pack tests now assert the exact plaintext key prefixes and round-trip the externalized bytes, and the publication suite exercises upload, verify, finish, and replay over the new keys. One publication test (`renewsTheOriginalClaimWhileScanningSlowObjectBytes`) is a pre-existing timing flake under full-suite load and passes in isolation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Local results: SessionOssStorageTest 7/7, JournalPackTransactionRegressionTest 21/21, JournalPackDeletionRegressionTest 8/8, ToolPublicationStoreTest 112/113 with the single flake passing on an isolated rerun, checkstyle clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.12, Maven 3.9.16, H2 in-memory (MySQL mode) for the focused tests; full module gates run in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: tenant/workspace/session identities become visible in OSS access logs and the console (the bucket is private and operator-only, and the identities are already visible in SQL); per-tenant key prefixes make OSS prefix partitioning coarser than hashed scopes. Both are accepted in the design.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full module suite and real-MySQL/real-OSS gates run in CI; local validation covered the focused regressions and checkstyle above.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the feature is unreleased, no object in the hashed layout exists, and SQL scope keys are unchanged.

Design: [English](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys/docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys/docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

managed-agent 服务器私有 OSS bucket 中的外置对象——超尺寸会话资源、压缩后的 journal pack、工具发布产物——现在用明文的租户/工作区/会话身份段寻址，不再使用不透明的 SHA-256 scope 哈希；发布 slot 名也原样保留而非哈希。SQL 身份键、存储的 object-key 列以及所有读取路径均保持不变。随附中英双语设计文档，记录键布局、路径所依赖的边界校验和键长预算。

## 为什么需要

运维在 bucket 控制台浏览时，无法直接看出对象属于哪个租户、工作区或会话，必须先查 SQL 把身份映射成哈希；调试和存储审计对每个对象都要多做一次查询。明文路径让 bucket 可以按 租户 → 工作区 → 会话 → 工具调用 → 输出 slot 逐级浏览。功能尚未发布，因此不需要迁移或兼容哈希布局。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

非用户可见的存储重构。在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 目录（JDK 21、Maven 3.8.9+）运行聚焦回归：`mvn -pl verification -Dtest="SessionOssStorageTest,JournalPackTransactionRegressionTest,JournalPackDeletionRegressionTest" test`，然后 `mvn -pl verification -Dtest="ToolPublicationStoreTest" test`，再 `mvn -pl persistence checkstyle:check`。预期全绿：会话资源和 pack 测试现在断言精确的明文键前缀并对外置字节做往返读取，发布套件在新键上覆盖上传、校验、finish 和重放。其中一个发布测试（`renewsTheOriginalClaimWhileScanningSlowObjectBytes`）是整套件负载下已有的时序 flake，单独运行通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（非 UI）。本地结果：SessionOssStorageTest 7/7、JournalPackTransactionRegressionTest 21/21、JournalPackDeletionRegressionTest 8/8、ToolPublicationStoreTest 112/113（单个 flake 单独重跑通过）、checkstyle 无告警。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ✅ · 🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测试 · 🐧 Linux ⚠️ 未测试

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21.0.12、Maven 3.9.16，聚焦测试使用 H2 内存库（MySQL 模式）；模块完整门禁在 CI 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：租户/工作区/会话身份会出现在 OSS 访问日志和控制台中（bucket 私有且仅运维可见，这些身份在 SQL 中本就可见）；按租户共享键前缀使 OSS 前缀分区比哈希 scope 更粗。两者均已在设计中接受。
- 未验证/范围外：模块完整套件及真实 MySQL/真实 OSS 门禁在 CI 运行；本地验证覆盖上述聚焦回归和 checkstyle。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无——功能未发布，不存在哈希布局的对象，SQL scope 键不变。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys/docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys/docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-agent-oss-plaintext-keys.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): prioritize session titles across devices
prs.body:
## What this PR does This PR gives session titles more room on both mobile and desktop. Default Pin and other optional row actions now live in the existing More menu, reducing the reserved default action width from two buttons to one. On coarse-pointer devices those actions always stay in More, while an explicit desktop `inlineItems` configuration remains honored. Sidebar PR badges use tighter margins and padding without removing the visible PR state icon or the existing link. The 85% drawer ratio is limited to `(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)`; fine-pointer/narrow desktop hosts retain the original clamped 70% rule and normal resizing. Shared visual scenarios cover long Chinese titles, a five-digit PR, both themes, both device classes, and access to Pin through More. ## Why it's needed On a 390px-wide touchscreen, visible-on-touch controls and the full PR pill left the example title showing only “优化”, with the drawer capped at 276px. Desktop rows duplicated the same competition for title space on hover: the default Pin and More buttons consumed 52px before adding the PR badge. This change preserves action availability and visible PR lifecycle state while making the conversation name the highest-priority content in the row. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify With a long-titled session and bound PR, open the workspace sidebar at 390×844 in a coarse-pointer context and at a normal desktop size. Confirm a useful title width (greater than 110px in the measured DejaVu geometry, rather than a fixed-width guarantee under every font), the PR number and its visible state icon remain present, and the PR link retains its destination. By default Pin should not be a separate inline button; open More and confirm Pin and the other permitted actions remain available. Repeat in dark and light themes. On a coarse pointer, optional inline actions remain in More even if a host supplies `inlineItems`; on desktop, a host's explicit `inlineItems` configuration should continue to render those controls inline. Mobile drawers use 85% of their container, while desktop sidebar resizing and hover/focus reveal behavior remain unchanged. ### Evidence (Before & After) The older captures use the same mock-daemon scenario against base `b62d4ab7fa` and earlier head `cbf1bbb7bd`. Captures from the current merged head are shown separately below. The earlier cross-device run passed 4/4 scenarios (iPhone + desktop, dark + light). A subsequent merged-head visual run was interrupted and is not claimed as a completed four-case batch; the new-head CI covers that revision. Base-only controls confirmed 276px versus the expected 331.5px mobile drawer and one old inline desktop Pin versus zero after the change. Light-theme and More-menu captures are included in the updated verification comment. **iPhone**
Before — latest mainAfter — this PRAfter — More menu
**Desktop**
Before — latest mainAfter — this PRAfter — More menu
### Merged-head follow-up and validation - **Drawers:** the 85% ratio is limited to coarse pointers. Fine-pointer/narrow desktop hosts retain the original clamped 70% behavior. - **Actions:** optional standard actions, and coarse-pointer Recent Pin/Archive actions, use More without removing disabled, busy, standalone, workspace or capability restrictions. Explicit fine-pointer inlineItems configurations remain supported. - **Input ownership:** live pointer-media subscriptions update when the device changes; Portal touch scrolling and Escape ownership are retained; interactive double-clicks cannot start Rename accidentally. - **Group focus:** Group now takes focus during More's deferred close-autofocus, stays focused through Portal teardown, and Escape closes only Group and restores More. A real daemon reproduced the old focus race and after-clock-delay focus steal before this specific callback ownership repair; the final binary passes it. ### Verified on merged 8cab0be05922d14050108cc4759202e713635aba - Full workspace `npm run build`: **passed**. - Full workspace `npm run typecheck`: **passed**. - Full Web Shell suite on the pre-merge fixed head `36185ee18f`: **620 files, 17,532 tests passed**; latest upstream is then merged rather than discarded. - Real isolated daemon (CLI `packages/cli/dist/index.js`): authenticated capabilities; actual session creation; metadata title and fixture PR persistence; visible PR number/state icon/link; actual Pin and Unpin PATCH requests followed by `isPinned=true` and `isPinned=false` catalog reads. Browser errors, daemon errors, prompt routes and external requests: **0**. No user daemon or existing user sessions were read or changed. - The mobile Group path retains the first radio focus after Portal unmount, then Escape leaves the drawer open and restores More. The served `/assets/index-Dbc9oZfQ.js` bytes match the merged worktree asset (SHA-256 `7458988f4cf239de5d4e6e74581656822bb27a59377f15cf8a9f48040ce49862`). - The CI visual scenarios and base-injected counterpart assert the actual old and new layout contracts rather than assuming identical expected widths/actions. A later merged-head visual run was interrupted and is not counted as a completed four-case batch. Pending CI jobs at this update: web-shell E2E Smoke (shard 2/2); web-shell E2E Smoke (shard 1/2); review-pr; Capture web-shell visuals (Node 22.x). No failed CI jobs at this update. - Original actionable inline review points were replied to individually and their corresponding threads resolved. Repeat follow-ups inside the same conversation were handled in that thread instead of being posted as unrelated findings. **Latest real-daemon desktop screenshot** ![Desktop session list at merged head](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-mobile-session-list/pr18011/8cab0be05922d14000108cc4759202e713635aba/desktop-session-list.png) **Latest real-daemon mobile screenshot (390×844 CSS-pixel touch emulation)** ![Mobile session list at merged head](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-mobile-session-list/pr18011/8cab0be05922d14050108cc4759202e713635aba/mobile-390x844-session-list.png) Both remote PNGs were reread and matched their local bytes by SHA-256. The mobile screenshot was additionally decoded from the GitHub Contents API (86,785 bytes); the desktop download matched all 48,798 local bytes.
合并后补充验证（中文） - 85% 抽屉宽度只作用于粗指针；细指针和窄桌面继续使用原有 70% 规则。 - 默认 Pin、触屏 Recent 的 Pin/Archive 均保留在 More，权限、忙碌、standalone 和禁用态守卫均保留；细指针的显式 inlineItems 配置不变。 - 菜单的 Escape、触摸滚动、双击归属与实时指针切换均有回归覆盖；普通桌面标题双击 Rename 仍保留。 - 实测曾发现 More 卸载期间会抢走 Group 焦点。现已在 More 的延迟回焦处理里保留 Group 自身选中项，再恢复 More，避免了仅凭某一帧聚焦产生的假绿。最终真实 daemon 中，Group 关闭后抽屉保持打开且 More 回焦。 - 最终合并树的 build 与全仓 typecheck 通过。合并前已修复 head 的 Web Shell 完整套件为 **620 个文件、17,532 条测试通过**；随后已干净合入上游 232496db235123c98c87fef6c675b80748f56937。 - 最终 CLI 使用隔离 HOME、token、workspace 和随机端口。真实创建会话、metadata、Pin/unpin 与真实磁盘持久化均验证通过；没有访问或修改用户共享 daemon，也没有向模型或外部服务发请求。 - 桌面和手机截图均已上传并通过字节回读核对；手机图来自真实的 390×844 Chromium 触摸仿真，不是物理 iPhone 或 iOS WebKit 认证。 - 尚在执行的 CI 作业：web-shell E2E Smoke (shard 2/2)；web-shell E2E Smoke (shard 1/2)；review-pr；Capture web-shell visuals (Node 22.x)。本次更新时没有失败的 CI 作业。合并仍需用户确认，不由验证评论代替审批。
### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux; complete workspace build and typecheck; targeted Vitest and Playwright runs; Chromium 149 / Playwright 1.61.1 with desktop 1280×800 and iPhone 13 390×844 emulation against a mock daemon. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: Default optional row actions require one more interaction on every platform, and the wider mobile drawer covers more of the conversation while open. Visible PR state is not removed to regain space. - Not validated / out of scope: Physical iPhones, iOS Safari/WebKit, native macOS, and native Windows were not tested. Explicit desktop `inlineItems` configurations are preserved, while coarse-pointer hosts always keep optional actions in More. ## Linked Issues N/A — reported interactively; no issue number was provided.

prs.title: test(channels): correct two DingTalk witness descriptions that read against the code
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Corrects two descriptions in the managed DingTalk witnesses that read against the code they sit next to. Comment and test-title only: no assertion, no fixture and no production file changes.

## Why it's needed

Both were raised as non-blocking P3 notes on #17968 just before it merged, so they could not be fixed on that branch. Each says the opposite of what the assertion actually protects:

- The group-frame case's comment called the drop "a policy decision **after acceptance**". The production contract is the reverse: `stageInbound` returns false for the group drop, so no claim is staged, and `onMessage` acks unconditionally on its non-throwing path — its own comment reads "Only a staged claim is an acceptance: a skipped frame also returns normally (it is acked)". The drop happens *before* acceptance and prevents it; the ack is not a consequence of having accepted.
- The later-segment case's title said it "settles **only that segment**", while the receipt it pins is delivery-level with no ordinal (`[undefined, 'unknown']`) — and the comment right below already said so. A reader scanning titles would expect a per-ordinal `unknown` receipt, which is the opposite of the shape being protected.

A description that inverts the contract is worse than no description: the next reader trusts it instead of the code.

A review round on this PR then caught the correction over-claiming in the other direction: only a *non-definitive* failure settles `unknown`, while a definitive one settles `rejected` (`outcome = definitive ? rejected : unknown`, applied to every segment). The title is now narrowed to the class the fixture installs — "a **transient** failure on a later segment…" — and the comment below it says so too, since the same claim had two copies. Confirmed by flipping only the fixture value: the receipt becomes `[undefined, 'rejected']`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the DingTalk channel suite from `packages/channels/dingtalk` (`npx vitest run src/managed-dingtalk-adapter.test.ts`): **127 tests pass**, unchanged from before this PR — the diff touches only a comment and a title, so no assertion moves.

Read the two corrected descriptions against the code they describe:

- `managed-dingtalk-adapter.ts` `onMessage`: the `if (this.stageInbound(...))` block only resets latches; `return true` follows it unconditionally.
- the later-segment case's own receipt assertion: `[[0, 'accepted'], [undefined, 'unknown']]`.

The reviewer's third note — that the early payload-hygiene pair is subsumed by the identical pair at the end of the case, since the log array only grows — is left as is, deliberately: the early pair localizes a failure to the first tick, which the reviewer also noted as a defensible reason to keep it. No coverage is claimed for it beyond that.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no UI surface, no behaviour change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

## Risk & Scope

- Comment and test-title only. No assertion, fixture, production file, configuration or persisted-state change; the suite count is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the redundant early assertion pair is kept on purpose (see above), and nothing else from #17968's review is reopened here.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17968 — lands the two P3 description corrections raised there just before merge. References #17173; does not close the tracker.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

改正托管钉钉见证里两处与紧邻代码相反的表述。**仅注释与用例标题**：不改断言、不改夹具、不改生产文件。

## 为什么需要

两条都是 #17968 合并前刚提出的 P3 非阻断意见，因此无法在那条分支上修。每条都说反了断言实际保护的东西：

- 群帧用例的注释把丢弃写成「**acceptance 之后**的策略决定」。生产契约恰好相反：群帧丢弃时 `stageInbound` 返回 false、没有 claim 被 staged，而 `onMessage` 在不抛错的路径上无条件 ack——它自己的注释写的是「只有 staged claim 才是 acceptance：被 skip 的帧也正常返回（它被 ack 了）」。丢弃发生在 acceptance **之前**并阻止了它；ack 不是「已接受」的结果。
- 后段失败用例的标题写「**只结算那一段**」，而它钉住的 receipt 是 delivery 级、无 ordinal（`[undefined, 'unknown']`）——正下方的注释本来就这么写。扫标题的人会期待逐 ordinal 的 `unknown` receipt，与被保护的形态相反。

把契约说反的注释比没有注释更糟：下一个读者会信它而不是信代码。

本 PR 的一轮评审随后抓到这次改正在另一个方向上过度主张：只有**非 definitive** 失败才结算 `unknown`，definitive 结算 `rejected`（`outcome = definitive ? rejected : unknown`，对每个 segment 生效）。标题现已收窄到夹具实际安装的类别——「a **transient** failure on a later segment…」——其下方注释同样收窄，因为同一主张有两处副本。只翻转夹具取值即可确认：receipt 变为 `[undefined, 'rejected']`。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/channels/dingtalk` 下跑 `npx vitest run src/managed-dingtalk-adapter.test.ts`：**127 条通过**，与本 PR 之前一致——diff 只动一处注释与一处标题，没有任何断言移动。

把两处改正后的表述与它们描述的代码对读：

- `managed-dingtalk-adapter.ts` 的 `onMessage`：`if (this.stageInbound(...))` 块只重置 latch，其后无条件 `return true`。
- 后段失败用例自己的 receipt 断言：`[[0, 'accepted'], [undefined, 'unknown']]`。

评审的第三条意见——用例末尾那对相同的载荷卫生断言已覆盖靠前那对（日志数组只增不减）——**刻意保留原样**：靠前那对能把失败定位到第一次 tick，评审也指出这是保留它的正当理由。除该定位作用外不为它主张任何覆盖面。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A——无 UI 面、无行为变化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

## 风险与范围

- 仅注释与用例标题。不改断言、夹具、生产文件、配置或持久化状态；套件条数不变。
- 未验证／范围外：冗余的靠前断言对按上述理由刻意保留；#17968 评审里的其他内容不在此重开。

## 关联 Issue

#17968 的 follow-up——落地那里合并前提出的两条 P3 表述更正。引用 #17173；不关闭该跟踪 issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): preserve recovery handles through response processing
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves tool-output recovery metadata when microcompaction removes nested media from an otherwise protected result. It also stops successful web fetches from presenting the raw page artifact as if it contained the generated summary, allowing normal finalization to persist the summary instead. Processing-failure fallback continues to reference the raw artifact.

## Why it's needed

A copied result used to lose its recovery handle after the first media-removal pass, so a later pass could erase the remaining reference. Successful summarization could likewise skip summary persistence, point recovery at the wrong content, remove the producer's saved-text pointer, or suppress persistence entirely after a spill failure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that a handle-only result with nested media retains both its text and recovery reference through two compaction passes. For successful fetches, confirm that finalization writes the summary to a new artifact while preserving the raw-text pointer; for processing failure, confirm that the original raw artifact remains the recovery target. A failed producer spill with a large summary should still yield a persisted finalized response.

The four focused suites pass with 338 tests. Removing either production fix makes the new regression cases fail. Core typecheck and build also pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI recovery and persistence behavior.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested |
| 🐧 Linux | N/A |

### Environment

Node.js 26.13.1, local unit tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: successful fetch finalization now creates a separate summary artifact instead of reusing the raw-page artifact.
- Not validated / out of scope: deferred binary-only pointer and accounting findings are intentionally unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #18042

## 必要性

复制后的结果此前会在第一次媒体移除后丢失恢复句柄，后续处理因此可能清除剩余引用。成功的摘要处理也可能跳过摘要持久化、把恢复指向错误内容、移除生产者的已保存文本指针，或在写入失败后完全阻止持久化。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

确认只有恢复句柄且含嵌套媒体的结果在两次压缩后仍保留文本和恢复引用。对于成功获取，确认收尾流程把摘要写入新产物并保留原始文本指针；对于处理失败，确认原始产物仍是恢复目标。生产者写入失败但摘要较大时，最终响应仍应被持久化。

prs.title: fix(web-templates): re-track export renderer budget for ChatSurface copy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Re-tracks the document export renderer size budget in the web-templates export build to the current CI lane measurement, restoring the green build on main and every open PR. The warning threshold moves from 2,150,577 to 2,152,560 bytes and the hard ceiling from 2,151,577 to 2,153,560 bytes, preserving the established 713- and 1,713-byte margins above the lane measurement of 2,151,847. The budget comment records the A/B runs, the byte delta, and the cause. No runtime code, no dependency, and no structural-guard change.

## Why it's needed

The ChatSurface chat column (#17952) added six `chat.*` keys to the two catalogs the document entry inlines (EN and ZH-CN; zh-TW and RU are transcript-stubbed), the `CHAT_MESSAGE_KEYS` parity export, and the transcript-reachable `pendingPermissionRevision` helper. The export bundle pulls web-shell's whole i18n table, so these legitimate first-party strings land in the document renderer: the Build lane grew from 2,151,214 bytes (main `3911b60fc4`, green) to 2,151,847 (main `580108434f`), +633, crossing the 2,151,577 ceiling by 270 and reddening every subsequent main build and PR. This is the budget-follows-measurement path the gate's own comment prescribes for transcript-reachable first-party copy, not a code leak: the ChatSurface component graph is not wired into any column and its controller hook has no importer, CSS is unchanged at 2,427,365 bytes, the third-party input mix is unchanged, and the forbidden-input structural guard passes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The Build unit-test tree lane on this PR must complete green: it re-measures the document renderer against the new ceiling and prints `Document export renderer JS is N bytes`. Expect N = 2,151,847 (the same stable measurement as the last three main runs) with the forbidden-input guard passing.

Evidence — lane A/B from the actual runs:

| Main commit | Run | Build lane | Renderer JS | CSS |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `3911b60fc4` (pre-ChatSurface) | 44953143515 | success | 2,151,214 | 2,427,365 |
| `580108434f` (ChatSurface #17952) | 44963775498 | failure (cap) | 2,151,847 | 2,427,365 |
| `d7640c9091` / `d3cdb4aa6b` / `8e7d1e37c9` (docs-only) | 44963958988 / 44965642898 / 44966997388 | failure (same cap) | 2,151,847 | 2,427,365 |

Cause isolation: `git show 580108434f` adds exactly six `chat.*` keys to `i18n.tsx` (EN) and `i18n-zh-cn.ts`, the `CHAT_MESSAGE_KEYS` export, and `pendingPermissionRevision` in `transcriptAdapter.ts`; the zh-TW/RU additions are transcript-stubbed and contribute no document bytes. `useDaemonChatController` (the only ChatSurface consumer) has no non-test importer, so no component code reaches the document entry.

Local checks run: `node --check` on the build script (syntax), Prettier clean, margin arithmetic verified (2,152,560 − 2,151,847 = 713; 2,153,560 − 2,151,847 = 1,713), and no other file pins the old constants. A local export build was not run (this worktree has no built dist chain); the lane measurement is the authoritative number these constants track, and this PR's Build lane is the verification.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `Error: Document export renderer JS is 2151847 bytes; expected <= 2151577.` (main runs above). After: the same measurement against the re-tracked ceiling passes — confirmed by this PR's Build lane.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: syntax/Prettier/arithmetic checks passed locally; the CI Build lane (Linux, Node 22.x) is the gate verification. macOS/Windows not tested locally; the change is two numeric constants and a comment in a platform-independent build script.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.x per the Build lane; the budget comment records the measurement provenance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: raising a size ceiling weakens the ratchet by exactly the measured growth (+633 bytes of first-party copy); the margins stay tight (713/1,713) and the structural forbidden-input guard — the real protection against dependency-family leaks — is untouched.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local export build (no dist chain in the worktree); the PR's Build lane provides the authoritative re-measurement. Trimming the i18n table mechanism itself is out of scope — the whole-table inclusion is by design and documented in the gate comment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; exported documents are unaffected (the renderer asset bytes do not change, only the ceiling that budgets them).

## Linked Issues

None — the failure is attributed to #17952's legitimate copy growth; no tracking issue existed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

把 web-templates 导出构建的文档渲染器体积预算重跟踪到当前 CI lane 实测值，恢复 main 与所有开放 PR 的绿构建。警告阈值 2,150,577 → 2,152,560 字节，硬上限 2,151,577 → 2,153,560 字节，在 lane 实测 2,151,847 之上保留既有的 713/1,713 字节边际。预算注释记录 A/B run、字节差与成因。无运行时代码、无依赖、无结构守卫改动。

## 为什么需要

ChatSurface 聊天列（#17952）向文档入口内联的两个目录（EN/ZH-CN；zh-TW/RU 有 transcript stub）新增 6 个 chat.* 键、CHAT_MESSAGE_KEYS parity 导出、以及 transcript 可达的 pendingPermissionRevision helper。导出 bundle 携带 web-shell 的完整 i18n 表，这些合法第一方字符串落入文档渲染器：Build lane 从 2,151,214（main 3911b60fc4，绿）涨到 2,151,847（main 580108434f），+633，超上限 270 字节，红掉此后每个 main 构建与 PR。这是体积门注释自身为 transcript 可达第一方文案规定的「预算跟随实测」路径，不是代码泄漏：ChatSurface 组件图未接入任何列、其控制器 hook 无引用方，CSS 不变（2,427,365），第三方输入混合不变，forbidden-input 结构守卫通过。

## 评审验证计划

prs.title: fix(ci): refuse verification without a prepared scratch directory
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Tightens the verify-scratch contract added in #17879, which merged before the review round on it finished.

- The agent's `TMPDIR` assignment fails loudly instead of silently falling back to the shared OS temp directory: `"TMPDIR=${VERIFY_SCRATCH:?verify scratch directory was not prepared}"`. `set -u` cannot catch this — the step-level `env:` always defines `VERIFY_SCRATCH`, so a missed step id or output yields an empty string, not an unset variable.
- Three guards that had no case failing when removed are now pinned by the workflow test: the producing step's `id: verify_scratch` that the run step reads, the `chown node:node` that makes the root-owned `mktemp` directory writable for the `node` user, and the empty-value refusal itself.

## Why it's needed

An empty `VERIFY_SCRATCH` makes every clone, A/B worktree and install tree the verification agent creates land in the shared temp directory, which is exactly the isolation #17037 was about. GitHub evaluates an unknown `steps.<id>.outputs.*` to the empty string rather than failing, and `mktemp -d` mints a root-owned 0700 directory that only that `chown` opens up, so both of those failures were silent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In `scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js`, the "verify scratch isolation" block covers the guard behaviour end to end: it executes the workflow's own `TMPDIR` literal under `bash -e -o pipefail` with an empty and a non-empty `VERIFY_SCRATCH` and expects a non-zero exit with `verify scratch directory was not prepared` versus `TMPDIR=/tmp/qwen-scratch`.

Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js -t "verify scratch isolation"` — the 4 cases in the block pass. Removing the `:?` guard, the `id:` line, or the `chown` line should each turn a test red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal CI change with no user-visible surface. The shell-level before/after replay (empty value aborts with `verify scratch directory was not prepared`; prepared value still yields `TMPDIR=/tmp/qwen-scratch`) and the focused test run are recorded in https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18040#issuecomment-7066344001.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Focused test block and shell replay verified locally on macOS; Windows/Linux are covered by CI.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests plus a `bash -e -o pipefail` literal replay only.

## Risk & Scope

- Behaviour change only on a broken path: with a prepared scratch directory the assignment is unchanged.
- No new step, permission, secret or input.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17037, follow-up to #17879

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

收紧 #17879 引入的 verify-scratch 契约——该 PR 在其审查轮次结束之前就已合并。

- agent 的 `TMPDIR` 赋值现在会显式失败，而不是静默回退到共享的操作系统临时目录：`"TMPDIR=${VERIFY_SCRATCH:?verify scratch directory was not prepared}"`。`set -u` 无法捕获这种情况——step 级 `env:` 始终会定义 `VERIFY_SCRATCH`，因此遗漏 step id 或 output 得到的是空字符串，而不是未定义变量。
- 三个此前删掉也不会有用例失败的守卫，现在由工作流测试钉住：run step 所读取的生产 step 的 `id: verify_scratch`、让 root 所有的 `mktemp` 目录对 `node` 用户可写的 `chown node:node`，以及空值拒绝本身。

## 为什么需要

`VERIFY_SCRATCH` 为空时，验证 agent 创建的所有 clone、A/B worktree 和安装目录都会落到共享临时目录，这正是 #17037 要解决的隔离问题。GitHub 对未知的 `steps.<id>.outputs.*` 求值为空字符串而不是报错，而 `mktemp -d` 生成的是 root 所有、0700 权限的目录，只有那条 `chown` 能打开它，因此这两类失败都是静默的。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js -t "verify scratch isolation"`——该用例块的 4 个用例全部通过。删除 `:?` 守卫、`id:` 行或 `chown` 行中的任意一个，都应使对应用例变红。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 内部 CI 改动，无用户可见界面。Shell 层面的前后复现（空值以 `verify scratch directory was not prepared` 中止；已准备好的值仍输出 `TMPDIR=/tmp/qwen-scratch`）与目标用例运行记录见 https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18040#issuecomment-7066344001。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

目标用例块与 shell 复现在 macOS 本地验证；Windows/Linux 由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 仅单元测试与 `bash -e -o pipefail` 字面量复现。

## 风险与范围

- 行为变化仅发生在损坏路径上：scratch 目录已准备好时，赋值行为不变。
- 不新增 step、权限、secret 或输入。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #17037，#17879 的后续。

issues.title: tui: a live reasoning card keeps growing above the tool cards appended after it

labels.name: area:tui
labels.description: Terminal UI behavior, rendering, or interaction

labels.name: area:core
labels.description: Engine core: turn loop, agent loop, runtime

issues.body:
## What happens

In the TUI, a live reasoning card can keep growing **above** the tool cards that
follow it, so new thinking appears on top of a command that is already running.
It is intermittent: it needs a response that streams reasoning, calls a tool,
and then streams more reasoning without opening a new reasoning block.

Expected: the later reasoning appears below the tool card.
Actual: the text is appended to the first reasoning card, which sits above it.

## Why

`ActiveCell` is an ordered list of entries rendered in insertion order; nothing
sorts or reorders them (`crates/tui/src/tui/active_cell.rs:87`).

1. `ThinkingStarted` opens a reasoning card. `start_block` finalizes the previous
   one and calls `ensure_active_entry`, which pushes at the end — index 0 in an
   otherwise empty cell (`crates/tui/src/tui/streaming_thinking.rs:67`).
2. The model calls a tool. `push_tool` appends at the end — index 1, below the
   card (`crates/tui/src/tui/tool_routing.rs:339`).
3. More `ThinkingDelta` arrives in the same response. `ensure_active_entry`
   returns the stored index **without checking whether anything was appended
   after it**, so the bytes land in the card at index 0.

The result is a card at index 0 whose content keeps growing after the card at
index 1 was drawn. Step 3 needs the provider to keep sending reasoning deltas
after a tool block without a new `content_block_start`; the engine forwards
`Delta::ThinkingDelta` unconditionally (`crates/tui/src/tui/core/engine/turn_loop.rs`,
the `Delta::ThinkingDelta` arm does not consult `current_block_kind`). Gateways
that interleave reasoning and tool blocks in one response produce it; a
well-behaved Anthropic stream does not.

## Steps to reproduce

Not reproducible with a scripted local provider yet; the path is read from
source. Any provider that emits, inside one response:

```
content_block_start(thinking 0) -> thinking_delta x N
content_block_start(tool_use 1) -> input_json_delta -> content_block_stop
thinking_delta x M          # same block index not restarted
```

shows the second `thinking_delta` batch written into the card above the tool.

## Expected behaviour

Later reasoning should open a new card below the tool, or be suppressed until
the next `ThinkingStarted`. It must not grow into a card that a tool card has
already been appended after.

## Notes

- P2.3 deliberately groups reasoning with the tools that follow it
  (`crates/tui/src/tui/active_cell.rs:40-47`, `push_thinking` doc). That grouping
  is about the reasoning that *precedes* the tools. It does not say a card may
  keep growing after a sibling was appended below it.
- Relation to #7123: that one is a delta landing in the wrong *kind* of cell
  (reasoning written into the assistant body). This one is a delta landing in the
  right *kind* but the wrong *position* in the list. A fix for one does not fix
  the other.
- Fix shape, if useful: `ensure_active_entry` can treat `entry_count() > index + 1`
  as "a sibling was appended below this card", finalize the card, and open a new
  one at the end.
---

## Attribution

🤖 Generated by SpikeBot 000(CodeWhale-LOCAL)

Corrective release and exact-candidate qualification. Release scope approved November 5, 2026.

issues.body:
0.10.3 puts ACP (the [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com)) first. This issue covers one direction: **Codewhale runs an installed agent CLI over ACP**, as a whole session that lives in Codewhale's sidebar, history and approvals. The other direction, an editor driving Codewhale, is #7280.

## Status

- **On main:**
  - A session can run on an installed agent.
  - Shutdown ends an agent that is still starting, restart recovery works, and approval answers are durable.
  - Discovery finds Windows `.cmd`/`.exe` shims and says *why* an agent is unavailable: missing, too old, or answering with another protocol.
  - The supported agents are listed in `crates/engine/src/fleet/agents.rs` (`AGENTS`): Claude Agent, Codex, DSH, Antigravity, OpenCode, Kimi, Mistral Vibe, Qoder, CodeBuddy and Grok.
- **How a session is started:** [docs/RUNTIME_API.md § Sessions on other agents](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/blob/main/docs/RUNTIME_API.md#sessions-on-other-agents-external-agent-threads), and `GET /v1/agents/external` for what was found on this computer.
- **Verification so far uses fixture agents.** No real installed agent has been qualified yet.

## Ways to help

**1. Try a real agent and report (no Rust needed).** Pick an agent you already have installed and comment with which one. Then:
- Start `codewhale serve` from a `main` build, check that `GET /v1/agents/external` lists your agent as runnable, and start a session on it.
- Send a prompt that edits a file and runs a command, answer an approval, cancel a turn, and quit and reopen to resume.
- Post the agent name and version, your OS, what worked, and the exact text of anything refused or broken.

Done when every step is reported for that agent.

**2. Add an agent that speaks ACP.** For example **Qwen Code** (`qwen --acp`) or **GitHub Copilot CLI** (`copilot --acp --stdio`), which are not in the registry yet. (Google's agent is already listed as Antigravity, `agy acp`; Gemini CLI was retired for personal accounts and is not added back.) This is a good first Rust contribution:
- Add one `ExternalAgent` row to `AGENTS` in `crates/engine/src/fleet/agents.rs`: `id`, `binary`, `acp_args` (how to start it in ACP mode), `min_version`, `upgrade`, `login` and `website`.
- Copy the shape of a neighbouring row. Fields you can't verify stay `None`; don't guess.
- Run `scripts/dev-test.sh crates/engine/src/fleet/agents.rs registry`. `registry_rows_are_unique_with_verified_commands` must pass.
- Say in the PR how you checked the ACP flag against the agent's own docs.

**3. Improve the docs.** A user-facing page on running other agents inside Codewhale (install, sign in, start a session, what's supported) doesn't exist yet. A PR adding one under `docs/` is welcome, and a Chinese version under `docs/zh_hans/` even more so.

## Being built by maintainers right now

These are claimed, so please don't duplicate them:
- ACP options, capability refusals and agent-reported usage.
- Consolidating to one ACP client.
- Sending extra workspace directories to agents that support them.
- Projecting plan, mode, command and config updates from agents.

Steering, compaction, forking and images in an external-agent session are reported as unavailable unless the agent supports them.

## How to take a piece

1. **Comment here first** with the piece you want (for example "I'll take row 12" or "Windows journeys on ARM64"), so two people don't build the same thing. A maintainer replies to confirm.
2. **Build and test locally.** Setup: [Getting Started](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#getting-started); fast loop: [Fast local loop](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#fast-local-loop).
   ```bash
   CODEWHALE_BUILD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" cargo build --locked -p codewhale-cli
   scripts/dev-cargo.sh check -p <crate>
   scripts/dev-test.sh <crate-or-path> <test_filter>
   ```
3. **Open a PR that says `Refs #<this issue>`.** It merges as itself with you as the author, you are credited in the changelog and [CONTRIBUTORS](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTORS.md), and a red check you didn't cause is ours to fix. Reports are contributions too: a test result posted here is credited the same way.

Questions are welcome here, in English or Chinese. Part of the overall [0.10.3 tracking issue](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/issues/7284).

milestone.title: v0.10.3
milestone.description:
Corrective release and exact-candidate qualification. Release scope approved November 5, 2026.

Keep history/undo and compaction continuity, login/model selection, worker durability and safe retries, bounded input/output, runtime responsiveness, and supported installation/client qualification here. Use release-blocker for the unresolved repair/qualification gates. Use status:awaiting-release for source fixes that are landed but still need final verification and shipment; do not close them merely because main contains the fix.

Broad refactors, optional features, full historical audit sweeps and unqualified optimization claims move to the later planning milestones. This replaces the previous all-refactors-for-0.10.3 umbrella scope; unfinished requirements are deferred, not completed or discarded. Confirmed release-critical defects must not be hidden by a future umbrella target.

Freeze the final source and binaries, finish the required platform/client evidence, then run final validation. Provider spend, signing and publication retain their separate approvals. No due date or published release is created by this milestone.

issues.body:
## Why this matters
`crates/tui-kit/src/paste_burst.rs` `PASTE_BURST_MAX_BYTES = 64*1024`: a raw (non-bracketed) paste larger than 64 KiB drops the tail silently. After PR #7398 routes non-ASCII chars through the burst buffer, a large CJK paste reaches the byte cap sooner than an ASCII one — silent data loss in the composer.

## Current behavior
Overflow chars are discarded without warning; the user sees a truncated paste with no signal.

## Desired behavior
- Preserve the data: on overflow, flush the buffer through `insert_str` and keep buffering (chunked), or commit the overflow directly — never drop.
- Or at minimum surface a visible "paste truncated at 64 KiB" notice; prefer preservation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] a >64 KiB paste lands complete in the composer (test at, e.g., 256 KiB)
- [ ] bracketed and raw paths behave identically; `cargo test -p codewhale-tui -- paste` passes

## Related
PR #7398 (paste-latency fix), user-reported large-paste slowness 2026-11-19

prs.title: fix(tui): let a session switch adopt a populated Runtime store
prs.body:
## What this changes

A session switch can now open a conversation whose Runtime store already holds history.

Before, `apply_loaded_session_with_goal` refused any target store with a non-empty `threads/` directory. The check was aimed at the wrong store. A switch never abandons the target — that store stays on disk for whichever process opens it next — and the host keeps holding the one it already has until the switch explicitly releases it. What a switch must not do is release a store that still needs *this* process, which is a property of the store being **left**.

So the check moves:

- `HasDurableWork` stops being a refusal. Only conditions that make the target unusable from here still refuse: a live process holding its lock, an unconfined or non-directory path, or a scope-pinned automation.
- `current_store_is_disposable` (async) asks whether the store being left has work in flight: a loaded engine with an active turn, or a request waiting on a decision that lives only in memory (`has_unsettled_requests`). Finished history is not work.
- A binding whose recorded scope no longer matches its own owner file is stale, not adoptable — that stays on the recover-onto-this-host path.
- `LoadedSessionOutcome` reports the store to adopt; `adopt_runtime_store` settles the old engines, releases the process-owner lock, and starts a new manager with the saved binding.
- The abandoned store goes through `retire_unbound_store_in_background`, which moves an unbound store to `.set-aside/` and refuses one any document still names.

### Why the first version of this was wrong

The initial patch reused `adoption_refusal` to judge the *current* store. That predicate answers "may a host take this store over?", and opening a store writes `owner.json`, `state.json` and the work directories — so a store that has never run a turn already reports `HasDurableWork`. Every switch out of a freshly started host would have been refused. Three existing tests caught it; `ee28d088f` is the correction.

## Verification

```
runtime_store_binding   15 passed, 0 failed   (default 2 MiB test stack)
tui::ui::tests::       941 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored
```

`main` (05a9a62e0) at the same point: 939 passed, and `picker_adoption_keeps_a_store_another_document_binds` overflows at the default stack — that group only passes with `RUST_MIN_STACK=32MiB`. This branch runs all 15 at the default stack.

`52fb7e9d4` fixes that: `adopt_runtime_store` returns a boxed future (it contains `TaskManager::start`, whose state machine inlined into the session-load path), and the exit test boxes each of its two `TaskManager::start` calls separately.

Two new tests:

- `switch_adopts_a_store_holding_finished_history` — a populated target is adopted, and the returned binding names it.
- `switch_allows_leaving_a_store_with_finished_history` — history in the store being left does not block a switch.

`cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes. Clippy reports pre-existing findings in `client.rs`, `compaction.rs`, `config.rs` and `runtime_threads.rs:13523` — none in the files this PR touches.

## Known limitations

- A turn active on *another thread* in the store being left is not visible to `session_transition_blocked` (it reads the current conversation's panel). `shutdown_and_wait` interrupts it, and the record is marked `Interrupted by process restart`. Naming the switch as the cause would need `interrupt_turn` to take a reason.
- The failure path in `adopt_runtime_store` (manager set to `None`, user told to run `codewhale resume`) has no test coverage.

Refs #6207, #6225, #6418

prs.title: fix(tui): open a new reasoning card below a tool that already followed it
prs.body:
fix(tui): open a new reasoning card below a tool that already followed it

## What and why

`ActiveCell` renders its entries in insertion order and nothing sorts them.
`ensure_active_entry` returned the stored index unconditionally, so this
sequence grew a card that was no longer the live tail:

1. `ThinkingStarted` opens a reasoning card at index 0.
2. A tool call appends at index 1, below it.
3. More `thinking_delta` arrives in the same response, with no new
   `content_block_start`. The bytes are appended to the card at index 0.

New reasoning then renders **above** a command the reader has already seen.
It is intermittent because it needs a provider that keeps streaming reasoning
after a tool block without restarting the thinking block; a strict Anthropic
stream does not.

## Issue

Closes #7454

## How I tested it

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — clean.
- `cargo check -p codewhale-tui --tests --lib` — clean.
- Five new `codewhale-tui` tests:
  - `a_beat_after_a_tool_appends_opens_a_card_below_it` — drives the real
    `commit_streaming_display_tick`, the path that leaked before the second
    commit.
  - `issue_7454_reasoning_after_a_tool_opens_a_card_below_it`
  - `issue_7454_a_stream_with_no_sibling_keeps_one_card`
  - `issue_7454_a_stale_pointer_opens_a_new_card`
  - `issue_7454_a_split_card_shows_its_text_instead_of_a_placeholder`
- **They were not run locally.** rustc cannot link the `codewhale-tui` lib test
  target on this machine: `memory allocation of 169869328 bytes failed` on a
  24 GB box with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1` and incremental off, the same limit #7137
  reported. CI owns the run.
- No live gateway was exercised. The sequence is read from source and pinned by
  the tests above, not observed against a provider.

## Known limits

- One reveal slice can land on the far side of the split: the beat commits
  before it resolves the entry, so the slice that triggers the split goes to the
  new card. It is pre-tool backlog bounded by one beat's budget (38 B at 16 ms),
  so at most one short slice of pre-tool reasoning renders below the tool. It is
  not the reported defect (no post-tool reasoning above a tool), but it is a
  seam.
- Under translation the settled card shows its original text and is never a
  translation target; the new card gets the translation. That is the trade
  against a placeholder that spins forever, and it is visible to a user with
  translation on.
- Pre-existing and untouched: the other finalize paths (`MessageStarted`,
  `ThinkingComplete`, session restore) discard a translation-mode tail and can
  strand a placeholder the same way.
- No test drives `EngineEvent::ThinkingDelta` through `run_event_loop`. The beat

prs.title: fix(tui): keep a streamed delta in the cell its own kind owns
prs.body:
fix(tui): keep a streamed delta in the cell its own kind owns

## What and why

A block's kind is decided by its start event alone. When a gateway opens a
text block in the middle of a thinking stream and then keeps sending
thinking deltas, block 0 stays marked text: `commit_streaming_display_tick`
reads `block_is_thinking(0)`, gets false, and writes the reasoning into the
assistant body. One reasoning sentence is then split across the thinking
card and the prose that follows it.

This is the same visible defect as #7123, with the two block kinds swapped:
the PR that fixed #7123 taught the display beat to route by the block's own
kind, but the kind itself is only ever set by a start event, so a gateway
that starts a block of the other kind mid-stream poisons it.

`StreamingState::set_block_kind` relabels one live block in place. Unlike
`reset` it leaves every other block and both accumulated counters alone.
`streaming_thinking::resync_block_kind` delivers the pending tail to the
cell the old kind owned first, then relabels; a relabel away from thinking
also finalizes the reasoning card and stashes its text, so the spinner stops
and replay still has the words. Both delta handlers call it before pushing,
so the normal Anthropic ordering returns after one comparison.

## Issue

Refs #7123

## How I tested it

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — clean.
- `cargo check -p codewhale-tui --tests --lib -p codewhale-tui-kit` — clean.
- `cargo test -p codewhale-tui-kit --lib` — `test result: ok. 221 passed; 0 failed; 1 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out`, including the new
  `streaming::tests::set_block_kind_reroutes_the_next_delta`.
- Four new `codewhale-tui` regression tests in `crates/tui/src/tui/ui/tests.rs`
  (`reasoning_after_an_interposed_text_block_returns_to_a_thinking_card`,
  `a_relabel_to_text_finishes_the_reasoning_card`,
  `a_relabel_to_text_keeps_the_card_alive_under_translation`,
  `prose_after_an_interposed_thinking_block_returns_to_the_assistant_cell`):
  **type-checked but not run.** rustc cannot build that lib test target on this
  machine — `memory allocation of 169869328 bytes failed` on a 24 GB box, with
  `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1`, `CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0` and incremental off. This
  is the same limit #7137 reported. CI owns the run.
- No live gateway was exercised. The defect was diagnosed from the code path
  and reproduced in the tests above, not observed against a real provider.

## Known limits

- The provider's own content-block index is still ignored: the TUI keeps one
  active block, and a gateway that interleaves two live blocks can still
  misattribute. This fixes the kind, not the indexing.
- A gateway that flips kinds twice renders one passage as two cards, the second
  without a duration stamp.
- Not addressed, both pre-existing and reachable on the same gateways: a second
  `MessageStarted` still drops a text block's uncommitted tail, and it still
  leaves the previous assistant cell marked streaming. The same handler also
  freezes a translation placeholder, because the `MessageDelta` arm calls
  `flush_active_cell` and that takes the reasoning entry before
  `ThinkingComplete` can supply a cell index. The resync is guarded under
  translation so it does not clear the buffer or the entry earlier than that
  flush already does; it does not fix the freeze.
- The two `event_loop.rs` call sites are covered only by review until CI adds a
  handler-level test; the new tests drive `resync_block_kind` and the display
  beat directly.
